5.1.129.4 bŕ̥haspátim ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.129.5 śáṃ no devī́ḥ
5.1.129.6 agna ā́ yāhi
5.1.129.7 agním īle
5.1.129.8 pūtás tasya pāré bhúvanasya mádhye nā́kasya pr̥ṣṭhé maható máhīyate
5.1.129.9 mahádbhis soṃbhasór bhúvanayór gámanayór medhyayór vibhavayór dévam abhísaṃjātam ápi brahmā́
5.1.129.10 sádā́ vedā́s tú yáśo mahā́n yáśo maha-dyutír maha-matír mahā́n púruṣo 'stu sadā-śiváḥ
children.translated_text: 5.1.129.1 I invoke the sages (<s>munis</s>). 5.1.129.2 I invoke <s>Takṣaka</s> (the serpent). 5.1.129.3 I invoke the seasons (<s>ṛtus</s>). 5.1.129.4 I invoke <s>Bṛhaspati</s>. 5.1.129.5 'May the divine waters be auspicious to us...' 5.1.129.6 'O <s>Agni</s>, come...' 5.1.129.7 'I praise <s>Agni</s>...' 5.1.129.8 Purified, beyond this world, in the midst of the universe, on the back of heaven, the great one is greatly honored. 5.1.129.9 With the two great and beautiful [qualities] of the worlds, the two courses, the two pure ones, the two glories — the divine one was born together with <s>Brahman</s>. 5.1.129.10 May the <s>Vedas</s> always [be], may there be glory, the greatly glorious, greatly intelligent, great <s>Puruṣa</s>; may he be ever-auspicious.

children.text:
5.1.130.1 imā́ óṣadhayas saṃbabhūvús tā́s tāḥ sárvāḥ pávamāne
5.1.130.2 ánugatāś śā́ntiṃ kurvantu naḥ
5.1.130.3 abhí tvā śūra nonumó dugdhā ívá dhenávaḥ
ī́śānam asyá jágatas súvardŕ̥śam ī́śānam indra tasthúṣaḥ
5.1.130.4 catvā́ri vā́k párimitā padā́ni tā́ni vidur brāhmaṇā́ yé manīṣíṇaḥ
gúhā trī́ṇi níhitā néṅgayanti turī́yaṃ vācó manuṣyā vadanti
5.1.130.5 vā́rīś cátasras sadŕ̥śaḥ kavīnā́ṃ patyuḥ pratyā́varitā kṣadáṃś ca
bhūyo bhūtyaí bhúvanasya púṣṭyai snā́yīta yas sáṃgataṃ snāpayāmi
5.1.130.6 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
5.1.130.7 iṣé tvorjé tvā
children.translated_text: 5.1.130.1 These herbs came into being; all of them, in the purifying [fire] — 5.1.130.2 having followed, may they bring peace to us. 5.1.130.3 'We sing to you, O mighty one, like milch-cows that have been milked — the lord of this moving universe, the lord of that which stands, O <s>Indra</s>, the one who sees the light.' 5.1.130.4 'Speech has been measured in four quarters; the wise <s>brāhmaṇas</s> who are thoughtful know them. Three are hidden in the secret place and do not move; the fourth quarter of speech is what mortals speak.' 5.1.130.5 'Four streams, equal to those of the sages, turned back from the master, and nourishing — for further prosperity, for the nourishment of the world, one should bathe; one who has come together, I cause to bathe.' 5.1.130.6 'O Waters, you indeed are bliss-giving...' 5.1.130.7 'For nourishment I invoke you, for vigor I invoke you...'

children.text:
5.1.131.1 ā́pa undantu
5.1.131.2 mitrás suvarṇáḥ
5.1.131.3 téjovát syāvaḥ
5.1.131.4 sómasya tanū́r asi
5.1.131.5 bhūtó bhūtéṣu
5.1.131.6 imā́s sumánasa śreṣṭhā divyá-puṣpādhivā́sitāḥ
5.1.131.7 pūtā́ brahma-pavítreṇa pūtā́s sū́ryasya rasmíbhiḥ
5.1.131.8 imé gandhā́s surabhíno divyá-gandhādhivā́sitāḥ
5.1.131.9 pūtā́ brahma-pavítreṇa pūtā́s sū́ryasya rasmíbhiḥ
5.1.131.10 imé dhūpā́s surabhíno divyá-dhūpādhivā́sitāḥ
5.1.131.11 pūtā́ brahma-pavítreṇa pūtā́s sū́ryasya rasmíbhiḥ
5.1.131.12 śubhrā́ jyótiś ca devā́nāṃ tejáś ca satata-prabháḥ
prabhās-karó mahā-tejā dīpó 'yaṃ pratigŕ̥hyātām
children.translated_text: 5.1.131.1 'May the waters surge forth...' 5.1.131.2 '<s>Mitra</s>, the golden...' 5.1.131.3 'Radiant, let it be dark-colored...' 5.1.131.4 'You are the body of <s>Soma</s>.' 5.1.131.5 'Being among beings...' 5.1.131.6 These flowers of good disposition, the best, perfumed with divine flowers — 5.1.131.7 purified by the purifier of <s>Brahman</s>, purified by the rays of the Sun. 5.1.131.8 These fragrant scents, perfumed with divine fragrances — 5.1.131.9 purified by the purifier of <s>Brahman</s>, purified by the rays of the Sun. 5.1.131.10 These fragrant incenses, perfumed with divine incenses — 5.1.131.11 purified by the purifier of <s>Brahman</s>, purified by the rays of the Sun. 5.1.131.12 Bright, and the light of the gods, radiance and ever-luminous brilliance, of great splendor — may this lamp be accepted.

children.text: 5.1.0.36 ā́vāhayāmi śivórjé tvādhivā́sitās trī́ṇi ca
children.translated_text: 5.1.0.36 [Rubric:] 'I invoke... the auspicious... for vigor I invoke you... perfumed...' — and the three [additional mantras].

children.text:
5.1.132.1 dhārāsu saptásu
5.1.132.2 kr̥ṇuṣvá pā́jaḥ prásitiṃ ná pr̥thvī́ṃ yāhí rā́jevā́mavā(g)ṃ íbhena
tr̥ṣvī́m ánu prásitiṃ drūṇānó 'stāsi vídhya rakṣásas tápiṣṭhaiḥ
5.1.132.3 táva bhramā́sa āśuyā́ patanty ánu spr̥śa dhr̥ṣatā́ śóśucānaḥ
tápū́(g)ṃṣy agne juhvā pataṅgā́n ásaṃdito ví sr̥ja víṣvag ulkā́ḥ
5.1.132.5 práti spáśo ví śr̥ja tū́rṇitamo bhávā pāyúr viśó asyā́ ádabdhaḥ
yó no dūré agháśa(g)ṃso yó ánty ágne mā́kiṣ ṭe vyáthir ā dadharṣīt
5.1.132.7 úd agne tiṣṭha práty ā́ tanuṣva ny amitrā(g)ṃ oṣatāt tigmahete
yó no árāti(g)ṃ samidhāna cakré nīcā́ táṃ dhakṣy atasáṃ ná śúṣkam
5.1.132.9 ūrdhvó bhava práti vidhyā́dhy asmád āvíṣ kr̥ṇuṣva daívyāny agne
áva sthirā́ tánuhi yātujū́nāṃ jāmím ájāmiṃ prá mr̥ṇīhi śátrū́n[*195]
[*195] The VMP text divides this verse between two sections, making the second line of this verse the first line of chapter 133. The numbering has been adjusted so that the complete verse now comes at the end of chapter 132.
children.translated_text: 5.1.132.1 'In the seven streams...' 5.1.132.2 'Exert your strength, your forward drive as broad as the earth! Go like a king with your army. Athirst, following the onward course, eager — you are an arrow; pierce the <s>rākṣasas</s> with the most burning [shafts]!' 5.1.132.3 'Your whirling [weapons] fly swiftly; touch them with your bold, blazing [flames]! O <s>Agni</s>, with your tongue, [hurl] burning flying brands; unhindered, scatter firebrands in all directions!' 5.1.132.5 'Send forth your spies, O swiftest one! Be the watchful protector of this people, undeceived! Whoever from afar, whoever from near would do us harm with evil speech — O <s>Agni</s>, may no one dare to cause you disturbance!' 5.1.132.7 'Rise up, O <s>Agni</s>! Spread forth against [the foe]; burn down the enemies, O you of sharp weapons! Whoever has committed hostility against us, O Kindled One — burn him down like dried-up brushwood!' 5.1.132.9 'Stand upright! Pierce from above, from us! Make manifest your divine [powers], O <s>Agni</s>! Destroy the firm [defenses] of those who employ sorcery; crush the enemies, both kinsmen and non-kinsmen!'

children.text:
5.1.133.1 sá te jānāti sumatíṃ yaviṣṭha yá ī́vate bráhmaṇe gātúm aírat
víśvāny asmai sudínāni rāyó dyumnā́ny aryó ví dúro abhí dyaut
5.1.133.2 séd agne astu subhágas sudā́nur yás tvā nítyena havíṣā yá ukthaíḥ
píprīṣati svá ā́yuṣi duroṇé víśvéd asmai sudínā sā́sad iṣṭíḥ
5.1.133.3 árcāmi te sumatíṃ ghóṣy arvā́k sáṃ te vāvā́tā jaratām iyáṃ gī́ḥ
sváśvās tvā suráthā marjayemāsmé kṣatrā́ṇi dhārayer ánu dyū́n
5.1.133.4 ihá tvā bhū́ry ā cared úpa tmán dóṣā-vastar dīdivā́(g)ṃsam ánu dyū́n
krī́ḍantas tvā sumánasas sapemābhí dyumnā́ tasthivā́(g)ṃso jánānām
5.1.133.5 yás tvā sváśvas suhiraṇyó agna upayāti vásumatā ráthena
tásya trātā́ bhavasi tásya sákhā yás ta ātithyám ānuṣág jújoṣat[*196]
[*196] The VMP text divides this verse between two sections, making the second line of this verse the first line of chapter 134. The numbering has been adjusted so that the complete verse now comes at the end of chapter 133.
children.translated_text: 5.1.133.1 'He knows your benevolence, O youngest one, who has opened a path for the one who seeks to offer <s>Brahman</s>. All fair days of wealth are for him; the noble one shines forth with splendors through the doors.' 5.1.133.2 'May he be fortunate and generous, O <s>Agni</s>, who seeks to please you with constant oblation, with hymns, in his own life, in his dwelling. May all fair days and oblations be established for him.' 5.1.133.3 'I sing your benevolence; may this song please you close at hand, O swift one! With good horses and good chariots may we honor you; may you uphold our dominions day after day!' 5.1.133.4 'Here may this serve you well, by itself, both evening and morning, you who shine day after day. May we, joyful-minded, attend upon you in sport, we who have established splendors among people!' 5.1.133.5 'Whoever with good horses, rich in gold, O <s>Agni</s>, approaches you with a chariot full of wealth — you become his protector, you become his friend, whoever continuously delights in your hospitality.'

children.text:
5.1.134.1 mahó rujāmi bandhútā vácobhis tán mā pitúr gótamād ánv iyāya
tván no asyá vácasaś cikiddhi hótar yaviṣṭha sukrato dámūnāḥ
5.1.134.2 ásvapnajas taráṇayas suśévā[*197] átandrāso 'vr̥kā́ áśramiṣṭhāḥ
té pāyávas sadhríyañco niṣádyā́gne táva naḥ pāntv amūra
5.1.134.3 yé pāyávo māmateyán te agne páśyanto andháṃ duritā́d árakṣan
rarákṣa tānt[*198] sukŕ̥to viśvá-vedā dípsanta íd ripávo nā́ha debhuḥ
5.1.134.4 tváyā vayá(g)ṃ sadhanyas tvotās táva práṇīty aśyāma[*199] vā́jān
ubhā́ śá(g)ṃsā sūdaya satyatāte 'nuṣṭhuyā́ kr̥ṇuhy ahrayāṇa
5.1.134.5 ayā́ te agne samídhā vidhema práti stóma(g)ṃ śasyámānaṃ gr̥bhāya
dáhāśáso rakṣásaḥ pāhy asmā́n druhó nidó mitramaho avadyā́t[*200]
[*197] Text: suśśévā
[*198] Text: tānth; TS tānt; RV tān
[*199] TS āśyāma; RV aśyāma
[*200] The VMP text divides this verse between two sections, making the second line of this verse the first line of chapter 135. The numbering has been adjusted so that the complete verse now comes at the end of chapter 134.
children.translated_text: 5.1.134.1 'I break through the great [bond] of kinship with words; this has come to me from my father <s>Gotama</s>. Attend to this our speech, O <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoker), O youngest, O skilled one, O generous one!' 5.1.134.2 'Sleepless, crossing over, beneficent, unwearied, without wolves, most indefatigable — those guards, sitting together, O <s>Agni</s>, may they, the wise ones, protect us!' 5.1.134.3 'Those guards of yours, O <s>Agni</s>, who protected the descendant of <s>Māmateya</s>, seeing the blind one, from evil course — the all-knowing well-doer protected those; even the deceitful foes who wished to harm could not [harm them].' 5.1.134.4 'By you we gain together, protected by you; led by you, may we win prizes! Fulfill both praises, O you of true nature! Bring them to fulfilment, O shameless one, with praise!' 5.1.134.5 'With this fuel, O <s>Agni</s>, may we serve you! Accept the hymn that is recited! Burn the hateful <s>rākṣasas</s>; protect us, O friend of <s>Mitra</s>, from deceit, from reproach, from disgrace!'

children.text:
5.1.135.1 rakṣo-háṇaṃ vājínam ā́ jigharmi mitráṃ práthiṣṭham úpa yāmi śárma
śíśāno agníḥ krátubhis sámiddhas sá no dívā sá riṣáḥ pātu náktam
5.1.135.2 ví jyótiṣā br̥hatā́ bhāty agnír āvír víśvāni kr̥ṇute mahītvā́
prā́devīr māyā́s sahate durévāś śíśīte śŕ̥ṅge rákṣase viníkṣe
5.1.135.3 utá svānā́so diví ṣantv agnés tigmā́yudhā rákṣase hántavā́ u
máde cid asya prá rujanti bhā́mā ná varante paribādhó ádevīḥ
5.1.135.4 mahā́(g)ṃ índro nr̥vád ā́ carṣaṇiprāḥ
5.1.135.5 trātā́ram índram
5.1.135.6 agnír ā́yuṣmān
5.1.135.7 svasti-dā́ viśás-pátiḥ
children.translated_text: 5.1.135.1 'I anoint the swift one, the slayer of <s>rākṣasas</s>; I approach the shelter of <s>Mitra</s>, the most widely extended. <s>Agni</s>, sharpened, kindled by [sacrificial] intentions — may he protect us by day, may he protect us from harm by night!' 5.1.135.2 '<s>Agni</s> shines forth with great light; by his greatness he makes all things manifest. He overcomes the godless evil sorceries; he sharpens his horns for the piercing of the <s>rākṣasa</s>.' 5.1.135.3 'And may the sounds of <s>Agni</s> reach heaven — his sharp weapons for slaying the <s>rākṣasa</s>! Even in his fury his flames break forth; the godless obstructions cannot withstand them.' 5.1.135.4 'Great <s>Indra</s>, manly, far-extending over the peoples...' 5.1.135.5 '<s>Indra</s> the protector...' 5.1.135.6 '<s>Agni</s>, the life-giving...' 5.1.135.7 'The giver of well-being, the lord of the people...'

children.text: 5.1.0.37 ágne ráthena gr̥bhā́yā́yuṣmān ékañ ca
children.translated_text: 5.1.0.37 [Rubric:] 'O <s>Agni</s>... chariot... accept... the life-giving...' — and one [more].

children.text:
5.1.136.1 védāhám etám
5.1.136.2 óṃ śéṣam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.3 mítram ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.4 átrim ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.5 víśvam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.6 śívam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.7 sánā́tánam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.8 sánáṃdánam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.9 sánát-kúmā́ram ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.136.10 sánákam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: 5.1.136.1 'I know this one...' 5.1.136.2 <s>Oṃ</s>. I invoke <s>Śeṣa</s> (the Remainder/cosmic serpent). 5.1.136.3 I invoke <s>Mitra</s> (the Friend). 5.1.136.4 I invoke <s>Atri</s>. 5.1.136.5 I invoke the All (<s>Viśva</s>). 5.1.136.6 I invoke the Auspicious One (<s>Śiva</s>). 5.1.136.7 I invoke <s>Sanātana</s> (the Eternal). 5.1.136.8 I invoke <s>Sanandana</s> (the Joyful). 5.1.136.9 I invoke <s>Sanatkumāra</s> (the Eternal Youth). 5.1.136.10 I invoke <s>Sanaka</s>.

children.text:
5.1.137.1 jáyām ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.2 víjáyām ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.3 víndām ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.4 nándām ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.5 púṣṭíkām ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.6 kúmúdvátīm ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.7 útpálíkām ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.8 víśókām ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.9 kánikradaj janúṣam
5.1.137.10 aśvínau váhatāṃ vahetāṃ[*201] vahāmi sa(g)ṃsr̥ṣṭaṃ gáruḍa-rathaṃ yathā-sthānáṃ vahāmi
5.1.137.11 ajñānajñāú dvā́v imāv ī́śānīśā́v ajaú hy éko bhoktr̥ bhojyā́rthá-yuktaḥ
5.1.137.12 anantātmā́ viśvá-rūpo hy akartā́ kr̥táṃ yathā vedáyate bráhma sampádyate
5.1.137.13 yád vaiṣṇavá(g)ṃ śáyane śayānám
5.1.137.14 śriyé jātó medínī devī́
5.1.137.15 óṃ víṣṇum ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.137.16 víṣṇor nú kaṃ vīryāṇi
5.1.137.17 agním īle puróhitam
5.1.137.18 iṣé tvorjé tvā
5.1.137.19 ágna ā́ yāhi śáṃ no devī́ḥ
[*201] 1946 edition: vahetāṃ; 1984 edition: hetāṃ va
children.translated_text: (5.1.137.1) 'I invoke <s>Jayā</s> (Victory).' (5.1.137.2) 'I invoke <s>Vijayā</s> (Triumphant One).' (5.1.137.3) 'I invoke <s>Vindā</s> (the Finder).' (5.1.137.4) 'I invoke <s>Nandā</s> (the Joyous One).' (5.1.137.5) 'I invoke <s>Puṣṭikā</s> (the Nourisher).' (5.1.137.6) 'I invoke <s>Kumudvatī</s> (the Lotus-possessing One).' (5.1.137.7) 'I invoke <s>Utpalikā</s> (the Blue-lotus One).' (5.1.137.8) 'I invoke <s>Viśokā</s> (the Sorrowless One).' (5.1.137.9) 'Neighing, [he was] born...' (5.1.137.10) 'May the <s>Aśvins</s> carry, may they bear — I carry. I carry the yoked <s>Garuḍa</s>-chariot to its proper place.' (5.1.137.11) 'These two — the unknowing and the knowing, the non-sovereign and the sovereign — both unborn. But the one enjoyer is joined with the object of enjoyment.' (5.1.137.12) 'The infinite Self, of universal form, the non-doer — when the created [Self] realizes, he attains <s>Brahman</s>.' (5.1.137.13) 'That which is the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> one, lying upon the couch...' (5.1.137.14) 'Born for <s>Śrī</s>...' '<s>Medinī</s> the goddess...' (5.1.137.15) <s>Oṃ</s>. 'I invoke <s>Viṣṇu</s>.' (5.1.137.16) 'What now of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s heroic deeds...' (5.1.137.17) 'I praise <s>Agni</s>, the household priest...' (5.1.137.18) 'For nourishment I [take] you, for vigor I [take] you...' (5.1.137.19) 'O <s>Agni</s>, come hither...' 'May the divine [waters] be auspicious to us...'

children.text: 5.1.0.38 sánákam ā́vāhayāmi sthānáṃ vahāmi náva ca
children.translated_text: (5.1.0.38) [Rubric:] 'I invoke <s>Sanaka</s>...' 'I carry to the [proper] place' — and nine [mantras].

children.text:
5.1.138.1 óṃ víṣṇum ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.2 śríyam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.3 háríṇīm ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.4 óṃ púrúṣam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.5 kápílam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.6 sátyam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.7 yájñam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.8 ácyútam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.9 nā́rā́yáṇam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.138.10 ánírúddham ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (5.1.138.1) <s>Oṃ</s>. 'I invoke <s>Viṣṇu</s>.' (5.1.138.2) 'I invoke <s>Śrī</s>.' (5.1.138.3) 'I invoke <s>Hāriṇī</s> (the Golden One).' (5.1.138.4) <s>Oṃ</s>. 'I invoke <s>Puruṣa</s> (the Cosmic Person).' (5.1.138.5) 'I invoke <s>Kapila</s>.' (5.1.138.6) 'I invoke <s>Satya</s> (Truth).' (5.1.138.7) 'I invoke <s>Yajña</s> (Sacrifice).' (5.1.138.8) 'I invoke <s>Acyuta</s> (the Imperishable).' (5.1.138.9) 'I invoke <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>.' (5.1.138.10) 'I invoke <s>Aniruddha</s>.'

children.text:
5.1.139.1 púṇyam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.139.2 várā́ham ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.139.3 súbhádram ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.139.4 nā́rásíṃham ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.139.5 ī́śítā́tmā́nam[*202] ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.139.6 vā́mánam ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.139.7 sárvódváham ā́vāhayāmi
5.1.139.8 trívíkrámam ā́vāhayāmi

children.translated_text: 5.1.149.1 <s>Oṃ</s>. O <s>Hotṛ</s> (Invoking Priest), come! We shall perform this divine worship. 5.1.149.2 O <s>Adhvaryu</s> (Officiating Priest), declare the deities — their order, [which are to be recited] aloud and [which] in a whisper. 5.1.149.3 Recite for <s>Agni</s> who is being kindled. 5.1.149.4 <s>Oṃ</s>. Obeisance to the Proclaimer; obeisance to the Overseer; obeisance to the Narrator. Who shall recite this? He shall recite this. May six broad ones protect us from distress — Heaven and Earth, Day and Night, the Waters and the Herbs. Speech [is] the well-established sacrifice, the righteous one. I take refuge in the <s>chandas</s> (sacred meters). I myself — me, <s>Śrī Viṣṇu-śarman</s>. 5.1.149.5 In the past and in the future, in the born and in the yet-to-be-born — I partake of the unpurified, the unrest of speech. Carry [it away]. 5.1.149.6 O <s>Jātavedas</s> (Knower of Births), make the animals delight in me. 5.1.149.7 May Heaven and Earth be my armor; may <s>Agni</s> be my armor; may <s>Sūrya</s> be my armor; may the cross-beams be my armor. 5.1.149.8 May I today attain the foremost of Speech, by which the gods conquered the <s>Asuras</s>. O eaters of vigor, O sacrificial ones, O five peoples — be pleased with my oblation. [Footnotes 212-224: Extensive notes on accent marks, variant readings, parallels with TS, TB, and AŚ 1.2.1, including the pattern of accent absence and resumption, and the full quotation of RV 10.53.4.]

The complete verse is as follows (I have underlined the Sanskrit and English that appears in the VMP text): ágne mahā́ṅ asīty āha mahā́n hy eṣa yad agnír brāhmaṇéty āha brāhmaṇó hy eṣa bhāratéty āhaiṣá hí devébhyo havyáṃ bharati devéddha íty āha devā́ hy etam aindhate mánviddha íty āha mánur hy etam uttaro devébhya aíndhárṣi-ṣṭuta íty āharṣayo hy etam astuvan víprānumadita íty āha (1) víprā hy ete yac chuśruvā́ṃso bráhma-saṃśita ity āha bráhma-saṃśito hy eṣa ghr̥tahavana íty āha ghr̥tāhutír hy asya priyátamā praṇī́r yajñā́nām ity āha praṇī́r hy eṣa yajñānāṃ rathī́r adhvarā́ṇām íty āhaiṣa hí deva-ratho 'tūrto hótéty āha ná hy etaṃ kaścaná (2) tárati tū́rṇir havya-vāḍ ity āha sárvaṃ hy eṣa taraty ā́spā́traṃ juhū́r devā́nām íty āha juhūr hy eṣa devā́nāṃ camasó deva-pā́na íty aha camasó hy eṣa deva-pā́no 'rā́ṃ ivāgne nemír devā́ṃs tvaṃ paribhū́r asī́ty āha devā́n hy eṣa paribhū́r yád brūyā́d ā́ vaha devān devayaté yajamānāyéti bhrā́tr̥vyam asmai (3) janayed ā́ vaha devā́n yájamānāyéty āha yájamānam evaíténa vardhayati... | Keith's translation: “`O Agni, thou art great', he says, for Agni is great. `O Brahman', he says, for he is a Brahman. `O Bhārata', he says, for he bears the sacrifice to the gods. `Kindled by the gods', he says, for the gods kindled him. `Kindled by Manu', he says, for Manu kindled him after the gods. `Praised by the R̥ṣis', he says, for the R̥ṣis praised him. `Rejoiced in by sages', he says, for learned people are sages. `Celebrated by the poets', he says, for learned people are the poets. `Quickened by the holy power (Brahman)', he says, for he is quickened by the holy power (Brahman). `With ghee offering', he says, for ghee is his dearest offering. `Leader of the sacrifices', he says, for
he is the leader of the sacrifices. `Charioteer of the rites', he says, for he is the chariot of the gods. `The Hotr̥ unsurpassed', he says, for no one surpasses him. `Surpassing, bearing the oblation', he says, for he surpasses all. `The mouth dish, the ladle of the gods', he says, for he is the ladle of the gods. `The bowl from which the gods drink', he says, for he is the bowl from which the gods drink. `O Agni, like a felly the spokes, thou dost surround the gods', he says, for he surrounds the gods. If he were to say, `Bring hither the gods to the pious sacrificer', he would produce an enemy for him. `Bring hither the gods to the sacrificer', he says; verily with that he makes the sacrificer to grow great.”
[*247] This verse is in parentheses in the Sanskrit text.
children.translated_text:
5.1.152.1 The immortal one, broad in radiance, clothed in ghee, well-offered, <s>Agni</s>, bearer of oblations at the sacrifice [RV, TB read: <s>havyavāṭ</s>], <s>Om</s>.
5.1.152.2 Him, the pressers with restrained ladles, thus with devotion, the sacrificers made <s>Agni</s> for aid [RV, TB read: <s>ūtaye</s>], <s>Om</s>.
5.1.152.3 O kindled <s>Agni</s>, being invoked, worship the gods, O one whose rite is good, for you are the bearer of oblations [text reads: <s>havyavāḷ</s>; RV, TB, TS read: <s>asi</s>], <s>Om</s>.
5.1.152.4 Offer ye, serve <s>Agni</s> as the sacrifice proceeds, choose the bearer of oblations [RV, TB read: <s>havyavāhanam</s>; 1984 edition reads: <s>juhotā</s>], <s>Om</s>.
5.1.152.5 O <s>Agni</s>, thou art great, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, O <s>Bhārata</s>.
5.1.152.6 (<s>Kāśyapa-Avatsāra-Naiddhruva</s>) [This verse is in parentheses in the Sanskrit text].
[Note: Beginning with verse 5.1.152.5 and ending with verse 5.1.154.1 is a set of <s>pratīkas</s> (citation openings) found in TS 2.5.9.1-4. The full passage from the <s>Taittirīya Saṃhitā</s> explains the significance of each epithet of <s>Agni</s>: he is great, he is a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, he is called <s>Bhārata</s> because he bears (<s>bharati</s>) the oblation to the gods, he is kindled by the gods and by <s>Manu</s>, praised by the <s>Ṛṣis</s>, rejoiced in by sages, celebrated by poets, quickened by <s>Brahman</s> (holy power), his dearest offering is ghee, he is the leader of sacrifices and charioteer of rites, the unsurpassed <s>Hotṛ</s>, the one who surpasses all, the ladle of the gods, the bowl from which the gods drink, and like a felly surrounding the spokes, he surrounds the gods.]

children.translated_text:

children.translated_text: 5.1.0.42 [Grand rubric summarizing the entire section 5.1:] 'May the <s>Bhagavān</s> be pleased; <s>Rudra</s>; the being; the <s>Rākṣas</s> burnt up; pure are these; may the <s>Bhagavān</s> come; these seeds; I invoke <s>Brahmā</s>; He who was unborn of old; the goddess <s>Medinī</s>; may <s>Viṣṇu</s> protect me; in this place; forth that <s>Viṣṇu</s>; golden-colored; purifying, the heaven-born; obeisance to the fat; come forth now <s>Indra</s>; may <s>Viṣṇu</s> protect me; to the blood; to the skin, obeisance; to the living one, obeisance; <s>Brahma</s> was born; the teacher, you, I; O <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>; to the crown-garland, <s>svāhā</s>; to the finial, <s>svāhā</s>; pure are these; you are the bright one; I praise <s>Agni</s>; I invoke the <s>Gārhapatya</s> sacrifice; for vigor, for you; waters indeed are all this; the Self, the Self, smaller than the smallest; then the gods; this <s>Viṣṇu</s>; <s>Oṃ</s>; may the <s>Bhagavān</s> come; I invoke the <s>Atharva Veda</s>; in the seven streams; I know this one; <s>Oṃ</s>; I invoke <s>Viṣṇu</s>; <s>Oṃ</s>, O <s>Hotṛ</s>, come; to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>' — forty-one [sections]. [Footnotes 270-271: Section numbering and variant reading.]

children.translated_text: 5.1.192.1 May the <s>Bhagavān</s> be pleased. To <s>Druhiṇī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! I invoke the son of <s>Rudra</s>. Here may <s>Savitṛ</s> grant well-being. O <s>Aditi</s>, be gracious. Come forth now, <s>Indra</s>. I invoke <s>Satyaka</s>. I invoke <s>Dharma-rāja</s> (the King of Righteousness). To Radiance, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Equalizing [breath], <s>svāhā</s>! To the Ear, <s>svāhā</s>! I invoke <s>Vairāgya</s> (Dispassion). Smaller than the smallest. May the waters quicken. I invoke the Bringer of Happiness. 'Greatly, O <s>Agni</s>, [grant us] good heroes...' <s>Oṃ</s>. To the Pedestal, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Sacrificial Limb, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Pure One, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Fortunate One, <s>svāhā</s>! — one hundred and ninety-one [mantras total].

children.text:

“háriḥ óṃ tat sat”
children.translated_text: May the <s>Bhagavān</s> be pleased. To the one who has become <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! '<s>Hariḥ Oṃ Tat Sat</s>' (That is the Truth).

Āvaraṇa-sáptakeṣūkta-mūrtī-homaḥ
children.translated_text: Obeisance to <s>Śrī</s>. [Title:] The <s>Homa</s> (fire-oblation) to the Deity-forms Described in the Seven <s>Āvaraṇas</s> (Enclosures).

To <s>Aṅgāraka</s> (Mars), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Crooked One (<s>Vakra</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Red One (<s>Rakta</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Son of the Earth (<s>Dharā-suta</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Budha</s> (Mercury), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Dark One (<s>Śyāma</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Gentle One (<s>Saumya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.41.1 śraviṣṭha-jā́ya svā́hā
5.2.41.2 pīta-varṇā́ya svā́hā
5.2.41.3 gúrave svā́hā
5.2.41.4 taiṣyā́ya svā́hā
5.2.41.5 bŕ̥haspátaye svā́hā
5.2.41.6 śukrā́ya svā́hā
5.2.41.7 kāvyā́ya svā́hā
5.2.41.8 bhārgavā́ya svā́hā
5.2.41.9 parisárpiṇe svā́hā
5.2.41.10 sūrya-putrā́ya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one born under <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s> (the <s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s> asterism), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Yellow-complexioned One (<s>Pīta-varṇa</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Preceptor (<s>Guru</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one associated with the month of <s>Taiṣya</s> (Pauṣa), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Śukra</s> (Venus), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Descendant of <s>Kavi</s> (<s>Kāvya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Descendant of <s>Bhṛgu</s> (<s>Bhārgava</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Slow-moving One (<s>Parisarpin</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Son of <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.42.1 mandā́ya svā́hā
5.2.42.2 raivatyā́ya svā́hā
5.2.42.3 śanaiścarā́ya svā́hā
5.2.42.4 rā́have svā́hā
5.2.42.5 daiteyā́ya svā́hā
5.2.42.6 urageśā́ya svā́hā
5.2.42.7 grā́hakāya svāha
5.2.42.8 ketáve svā́hā
5.2.42.9 kr̥ṣṇa-varṇā́ya svā́hā
5.2.42.10 raudrā́ya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the Slow One (<s>Manda</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one associated with <s>Revatī</s> (<s>Raivatya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Śanaiścara</s> (Saturn), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Rāhu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Son of <s>Diti</s> (<s>Daiteya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lord of Serpents (<s>Urageśa</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Seizer (<s>Grāhaka</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Ketu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Dark-complexioned One (<s>Kṛṣṇa-varṇa</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Fierce One (<s>Raudra</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.43.1 aprakāśíne svā́hā
5.2.43.2 nalínyai[*294] svā́hā
5.2.43.3 jāhnávyai svā́hā
5.2.43.4 gaṃgā́yai svā́hā
5.2.43.5 lóka-pāvanyai svā́hā
5.2.43.6 yamúnā́yai svā́hā
5.2.43.7 sphaṭikābhā́yai svā́hā
5.2.43.8 nadī-varā́yai svā́hā
5.2.43.9 pā́vanyai svā́hā
5.2.43.10 nármadāyai svā́hā
[*294] Text: naḷínyai
children.translated_text: To the Lightless One (<s>Aprakāśin</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Nalinī</s> (the Lotus River), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Jāhnavī</s> (daughter of <s>Jahnu</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Gaṅgā</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Purifier of the World (<s>Loka-pāvanī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Yamunā</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one with Crystal-like Lustre (<s>Sphaṭikābhā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Best of Rivers (<s>Nadī-varā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Purifier (<s>Pāvanī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Narmadā</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! [Editorial note: Text: naḷínyai]

children.text:
5.2.44.1 nadī-varā́yai svā́hā
5.2.44.2 vidyud-rūpā́yai svā́hā
5.2.44.3 viśālā́yai svā́hā
5.2.44.4 síndhave svā́hā
5.2.44.5 nadī-varā́yai svā́hā
5.2.44.6 mr̥dv-áṅgyai svā́hā
5.2.44.7 sā́dhanāyai svā́hā
5.2.44.8 durgā́yai svā́hā
5.2.44.9 kātyāyányai[*295] svā́hā
5.2.44.10 vaiṣṇávyai svā́hā
[*295] cf. 5.1.174.2, kātyāyanyai, which occurs in a similar sequence of verses (i.e. 5.1.174.1-4 cf. 5.2.44.8-45.1).
children.translated_text: To the Best of Rivers (<s>Nadī-varā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one with Lightning Form (<s>Vidyud-rūpā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Broad One (<s>Viśālā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Sindhu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Best of Rivers (<s>Nadī-varā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Soft-limbed One (<s>Mṛdv-aṅgī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Sādhanā</s> (the Accomplisher), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Durgā</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Kātyāyanī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one belonging to <s>Viṣṇu</s> (<s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! [Editorial note: cf. 5.1.174.2, kātyāyanyai, in similar sequence]

children.text:
5.2.45.1 vindhya-vāsínyai svā́hā
5.2.45.2 síddhyai svā́hā
5.2.45.3 viśvā́yai svā́hā
5.2.45.4 bhr̥gu-pátnyai svā́hā
5.2.45.5 sárasvatyai svā́hā
5.2.45.6 śríyai svā́hā
5.2.45.7 dhr̥tyai svā́hā
5.2.45.8 pávitryai svā́hā
5.2.45.9 prámódāyinyai svā́hā
5.2.45.10 bhū́r-jyeṣṭhā́yinyai svā́hā[*296]
[*296] jyeṣṭhā devyā ṣat nāma-mantrā iti marīciḥ | jyeṣṭhāṃ pañcabhir āhvayed ity atriḥ
children.translated_text: To the one dwelling in the <s>Vindhya</s> (<s>Vindhya-vāsinī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Siddhi</s> (Attainment), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Universal One (<s>Viśvā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the wife of <s>Bhṛgu</s> (<s>Bhṛgu-patnī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Dhṛti</s> (Steadfastness), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Pavitrī</s> (the Purifying One), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Pramodāyinī</s> (the Delighter), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Bhūr-jyeṣṭhāyinī</s> (<s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> of the <s>Bhūḥ</s> realm), <s>svāhā</s>! [Editorial note: <s>Marīci</s> states: six name-<s>mantras</s> of the goddess <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>. <s>Atri</s> states: one should invoke <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> with five (mantras)]

children.text:
5.2.46.1 bhúvar-jyeṣṭhā́yinyai svā́hā
5.2.46.2 súvar-jyeṣṭhāyinyai svā́hā
5.2.46.3 kali-rājā́yinyai svā́hā
5.2.46.4 kálí-patnyai svā́hā
5.2.46.5 dhā́tryai svā́hā
5.2.46.6 mahódáryai svā́hā
5.2.46.7 raúdryai svā́hā

5.2.46.9 surā́yai svā́hā
[*297] Text: kā̀ḷyai
children.translated_text: To <s>Bhuvar-jyeṣṭhāyinī</s> (<s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> of the <s>Bhuvaḥ</s> realm), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Suvar-jyeṣṭhāyinī</s> (<s>Jyeṣṭhā</s> of the <s>Suvaḥ</s> realm), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Kali-rājāyinī</s> (the Queen of <s>Kali</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the wife of <s>Kali</s> (<s>Kali-patnī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Dhātrī</s> (the Supporter), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Mahodarī</s> (the Great-bellied One), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Fierce One (<s>Raudrī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Mahākālī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Surā</s> (the Goddess), <s>svāhā</s>! [Editorial note: Text: kā̀ḷyai]

children.text:
5.2.47.1 sumúkhyai svā́hā
5.2.47.2 vidyud-rūpā́yai svā́hā
5.2.47.3 subhagā́yai svā́hā
5.2.47.4 sundáryai svā́hā
5.2.47.5 viśālā́yai svā́hā
5.2.47.6 padmā́kṣyai svā́hā
5.2.47.7 pádma-varṇiṇyai svā́hā
5.2.47.8 svāhā́yai svā́hā

5.2.47.10 mr̥dv-áṅgyai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To <s>Sumukhī</s> (the Fair-faced One), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one with Lightning Form (<s>Vidyud-rūpā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Fortunate One (<s>Subhagā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Beautiful One (<s>Sundarī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Wide-eyed One (<s>Viśālā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lotus-eyed One (<s>Padmākṣī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lotus-complexioned One (<s>Padma-varṇinī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the goddess <s>Svāhā</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the One with Auspicious Limbs (<s>Śubhāṅgī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Soft-limbed One (<s>Mṛdv-aṅgī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.48.1 sādhanā́yai svā́hā
5.2.48.2 svadhā́yai svā́hā
5.2.48.3 sámr̥ddhyai svā́hā
5.2.48.4 kula-vr̥ddhínyai svā́hā
5.2.48.5 sánnatyai svā́hā
5.2.48.6 māyā́yai svā́hā
5.2.48.7 mā́taṅgyai svā́hā
5.2.48.8 varā́hyai svā́hā
5.2.48.9 varānanā́yai svā́hā
5.2.48.10 saṃhlādínyai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To <s>Sādhanā</s> (the Accomplisher), <s>svāhā</s>! To the goddess <s>Svadhā</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Samṛddhi</s> (Abundance), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Kula-vṛddhinī</s> (the Increaser of the Family), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Sannati</s> (Humility), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Māyā</s> (Illusion), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Mātaṅgī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Vārāhī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Fair-faced One (<s>Varānanā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Saṃhlādinī</s> (the Gladdener), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.49.1 varārohā́yai svā́hā
5.2.49.2 māyā́ṅgyai svā́hā
5.2.49.3 múdvárthinyai svā́hā
5.2.49.4 rākā́yai svā́hā
5.2.49.5 mukhyā́yai svā́hā
5.2.49.6 raktā́ṅgyai svā́hā
5.2.49.7 varānanā́yai svā́hā
5.2.49.8 sinī́vā́lyai svā́hā
5.2.49.9 gábhástinyai svā́hā
5.2.49.10 hita-dā́yai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To <s>Varārohā</s> (the One with Beautiful Hips), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Māyāṅgī</s> (the One with an Illusory Form), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Mudvarthinī</s> (the Joyous One), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Rākā</s> (the Full Moon Goddess), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Chief One (<s>Mukhyā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Red-limbed One (<s>Raktāṅgī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Fair-faced One (<s>Varānanā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Sinīvālī</s> (the New Moon Goddess), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Gabhastinī</s> (the Radiant One), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Hita-dā</s> (the Bestower of Good), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.50.1 puṇya-dā́yai svā́hā
5.2.50.2 havi-rakṣakā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.3 āgneyā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.4 śailūṣā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.5 pacanā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.6 puṣpa-rakṣakā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.7 haritā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.8 adhivāsā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.9 phullā́ya svā́hā
5.2.50.10 púruṣāya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To <s>Puṇya-dā</s> (the Bestower of Merit), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Protector of Offerings (<s>Havi-rakṣaka</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one belonging to <s>Agni</s> (<s>Āgneya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Actor (<s>Śailūṣa</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Cooker (<s>Pacana</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Protector of Flowers (<s>Puṣpa-rakṣaka</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Green One (<s>Harita</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Perfumer (<s>Adhivāsa</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Blossoming One (<s>Phulla</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Puruṣa</s> (the Cosmic Person), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.51.1 parama-purúṣā́ya svā́hā
5.2.51.2 púrúṣā́tmakā́ya svā́hā
5.2.51.3 dharma-mayā́ya svā́hā
5.2.51.4 tváṣṭre svā́hā
5.2.51.5 rū́pa-jātāya svā́hā
5.2.51.6 nidhi-jā́ya svā́hā
5.2.51.7 plotā́dhipataye svā́hā
5.2.51.8 gadā́yai svā́hā
5.2.51.9 kaumodákyai svā́hā
5.2.51.10 puṇyā́yai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the Supreme Person (<s>Parama-puruṣa</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose essence is <s>Puruṣa</s> (<s>Puruṣātmaka</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one consisting of <s>Dharma</s> (<s>Dharma-maya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> (the Divine Craftsman), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one born of Form (<s>Rūpa-jāta</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one born of Treasure (<s>Nidhi-ja</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lord of the Raft (<s>Plotādhipati</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Mace (<s>Gadā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Kaumodakī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Meritorious One (<s>Puṇyā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.52.1 prabalā́yai svā́hā
5.2.52.2 sarveśvarā́ya svā́hā
5.2.52.3 jágannāthā́ya svā́hā
5.2.52.4 cāmuṇḍā́ya svā́hā
5.2.52.5 sarvataś-cárāya svā́hā
5.2.52.6 bali-rakṣakā́ya svā́hā
5.2.52.7 daṇḍyā́ya svā́hā
5.2.52.8 sarva-jñā́ya[*298] svā́hā
5.2.52.9 samā́ya svā́hā
5.2.52.10 gaviṣṭhā́ya svā́hā
[*298] cf. 5.1.188.3, sarvadāya, which occurs in a similar sequence of verses (i.e.5.1.188.1--4 cf. 5.2.52.6-9).
children.translated_text: To the Mighty One (<s>Prabalā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lord of All (<s>Sarveśvara</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Lord of the World (<s>Jagannātha</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Cāmuṇḍa</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who moves everywhere (<s>Sarvataścara</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Protector of Offerings (<s>Bali-rakṣaka</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one worthy of punishment (<s>Daṇḍya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Omniscient One (<s>Sarva-jña</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Impartial One (<s>Sama</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Gaviṣṭha</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! [Editorial note: cf. 5.1.188.3, sarvadāya, in similar sequence]

children.text:
5.2.53.1 traiṣṭubhā́ya svā́hā
5.2.53.2 guhyā́ya svā́hā
5.2.53.3 ākāśā́ya svā́hā
5.2.53.4 háriṇyai svā́hā
5.2.53.5 paúṣṇyai svā́hā
5.2.53.6 kṣóṇyai svā́hā
5.2.53.7 máhyai svā́hā
5.2.53.8 pavitrā́ya svā́hā
5.2.53.9 amr̥tā́ya svā́hā
5.2.53.10 toyā́ya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one connected with <s>Triṣṭubh</s> metre (<s>Traiṣṭubha</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Secret One (<s>Guhya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Ākāśa</s> (Space), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Hariṇī</s> (the Golden One), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one connected with <s>Puṣan</s> (<s>Pauṣṇī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Kṣoṇī</s> (the Earth), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Great One (<s>Mahī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Pure One (<s>Pavitra</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the Immortal One (<s>Amṛta</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Toya</s> (Water), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
5.2.54.1 gahvarā́ya svā́hā

5.2.54.3 ābhuraṇyā́ya svā́hā

5.2.54.5 agnáye svā́hā

5.2.54.10 r̥g-vedā́ya svā́hā

5.2.55.1 madhúne svā́hā
5.2.55.2 sómāya svā́hā
5.2.55.3 krátave svā́hā
