(8.1.46.5) To <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>huṃ phaṭ svāhā</s>! (8.1.46.6) I dissolve wind into space. (8.1.46.7) I meditate upon the <s>Puruṣa</s> form [of <s>Viṣṇu</s>]. (8.1.46.8) He who is the foremost, supreme, principal — the goal whose being was truth, whose superiority the sages perceive — to that chief <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! [Editorial note: VMP divides this verse at the chapter break.]

children.text:
8.1.47.1 ā́kā́śám ahaṅkāré právílāpayāmí
8.1.47.2 ahaṅkāráṃ mahat-tatvé právílāpayāmí
8.1.47.3 mahat-tatváṃ prákŕ̥taú právílāpayāmí
8.1.47.4 tā́ṃ prakŕ̥tiṃ pára-brahmaṇi právílāpayāmí
8.1.47.5 víṣṇu-mūrtíṃ dhyāyāmi
8.1.47.6 ā́ vāta vāhi bheṣajáṃ ví vāta vāhi yád rápaḥ
tvá(g)ṃ hí viśvá-bheṣajo devā́nāṃ dūtá ī́yase
8.1.47.7 ágne rákṣā ṇo á(g)ṃhasaḥ prati ṣma devá rī́ṣataḥ
tápiṣṭhair ajáro daha[*804]
[*804] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 48. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 47.
children.translated_text: (8.1.47.1) I dissolve space into ego (<s>ahaṅkāra</s>). (8.1.47.2) I dissolve ego into the Great Principle (<s>mahat-tattva</s>). (8.1.47.3) I dissolve the Great Principle into <s>Prakr̥ti</s> (primordial nature). (8.1.47.4) I dissolve that <s>Prakr̥ti</s> into <s>Para-Brahman</s> (the Supreme <s>Brahman</s>). (8.1.47.5) I meditate upon the <s>Viṣṇu</s> form. (8.1.47.6) O <s>Vāta</s> (Wind), blow hither healing; O <s>Vāta</s>, blow away disease — for you are the universal remedy, you move as the messenger of the gods. (8.1.47.7) O <s>Agni</s>, protect us from distress; O god, ward off those who would harm [us] — with your most burning [flames], the ageless one, burn [them]! [Editorial note: VMP divides the verse at the chapter break.]

children.text:
8.1.48.1 ágne há(g)ṃsi ny atriṇam
8.1.48.2 yád adó vāta te gr̥he 'mr̥tásya nídhir hitáḥ
táto no dehi jīváse táto no dhehi bheṣajám
8.1.48.3 syonā́ pr̥thivī bhávānr̥kṣarā nivéśanī
yáccā naś śárma sapráthāḥ
8.1.48.4 yó vā gáviṣṭhaḥ
8.1.48.5 ātmana ākā́śas sámbhūtaḥ
8.1.48.6 paramātmánaḥ prakr̥tíṃ trí-gúṇā́tmíkā́ṃ prátiṣṭhāpayāmí
8.1.48.7 prakr̥tér mahā́ntám útpādayāmí
children.translated_text: (8.1.48.1) O <s>Agni</s>, you destroy the devourer. (8.1.48.2) O <s>Vāta</s>, in your house a treasure of immortality is placed — from that, give us life; from that, give us healing. (8.1.48.3) May the earth be comfortable, free from thorns, a dwelling-place — may it grant us wide shelter. (8.1.48.4) 'He who is the foremost...' [<s>Viṣṇu</s> mantra incipit]. (8.1.48.5) From the self, space was born. (8.1.48.6) I establish from the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self) the three-<s>guṇa</s>-natured <s>Prakr̥ti</s> (primordial nature), <s>Oṃ namaḥ</s>. (8.1.48.7) From <s>Prakr̥ti</s> I produce the Great [Principle] (<s>Mahat</s>).

children.text:
8.1.49.1 maható 'háṅkāram utpādayāmí
8.1.49.2 ahaṅkārā́d ā́kā́śáṃ prátiṣṭhāpayāmí
8.1.49.3 yó vā vā́yuḥ
ākāśā́d vāyúṃ prátiṣṭhāpayāmí
8.1.49.4 tvám agne trí-guṇo variṣṭháḥ
vāyór agníṃ prátiṣṭhāpayāmí
8.1.49.5 tváṃ jī́vaḥ
agnér apáḥ prátiṣṭhāpayāmí
8.1.49.6 bhū́mer vítanván
adbhyáḥ pr̥thivī́ṃ prátiṣṭhāpayāmí
children.translated_text: (8.1.49.1) From the Great [Principle] I produce ego (<s>Ahaṅkāra</s>). (8.1.49.2) From ego I establish space (<s>Ākāśa</s>). (8.1.49.3) 'He who as <s>Vāyu</s>...' — from space I establish wind (<s>Vāyu</s>). (8.1.49.4) 'You are <s>Agni</s>, threefold, the greatest...' — from wind I establish fire (<s>Agni</s>). (8.1.49.5) 'You are the life-force...' — from fire I establish the waters (<s>Āpas</s>). (8.1.49.6) 'Extending the [crevices of the] earth...' — from the waters I establish the earth (<s>Pr̥thivī</s>).

children.text:
8.1.50.1 ásunīte púnar asmā́su cákṣuḥ púnaḥ prāṇám ihá no dhehi bhógam
jyók paśyema sūryám uccáraṃtam ánumate mr̥láyā nas svastí
8.1.50.2 amr̥taṃ vaí prānā́ amŕ̥tam ā́paḥ prāṇā́n evá yathā-sthānám úpahvayate
8.1.50.3 mámá prā́ṇá íhá prāṇáḥ
8.1.50.4 mámá jī́vá íhá jī́vás sthitáḥ
8.1.50.5 mámá sárvéndríyā́ṇí vā́ṅ-mánó-búddhy-áháṃkā́rá-kā́ma-rāgāntáṃ
8.1.50.6 pŕ̥thívy-áp-téjó-vā́yv-ā́kā́śá-śábdá-spárśá-rū́pá-rásá-gándhá-tvák cákṣúś-śrótrá-jíhvā́-ghrā́ṇá-vā́k-pā́ṇí-pā́dá-pā́yū́pásthá-prā́ṇā́ ihaivā́gátyá súkháṃ círaṃ tiṣṭhantú hrī́ṃ svāhā́
8.1.50.7 máma hŕ̥daye páramātmanas sakākā́j jī́vā́tmā́náṃ prátiṣṭhāpayāmy ón námaḥ
8.1.50.8 haṃsa-haṃsā́ya vidmáhe parama-haṃsā́ya dhīmahi
táṃn no haṃsaḥ pracodáyāt
children.translated_text: (8.1.50.1) O <s>Asunīti</s> (restorer of life), place again into us sight; place again breath and enjoyment here for us — may we long see the sun rising; O <s>Anumati</s>, be gracious to us, [grant us] well-being! (8.1.50.2) The breaths are indeed immortal; the waters are immortal — one calls back the breaths to their proper place. (8.1.50.3) My breath — let breath be here! (8.1.50.4) My life — let life abide here! (8.1.50.5) All my faculties — speech, mind, intellect, ego, desire, and passion to their end. (8.1.50.6) Earth, water, fire, wind, space — sound, touch, form, taste, smell — skin, eye, ear, tongue, nose — speech, hands, feet, anus, generative organ — the breaths — having come here, may they abide happily for a long time, <s>hrīṃ svāhā</s>! (8.1.50.7) I install the <s>Jīvātman</s> (individual self) from the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self) in my heart, <s>Oṃ namaḥ</s>. (8.1.50.8) We know the <s>Haṃsa</s> (the Swan-Soul); we meditate upon the supreme <s>Haṃsa</s> — may that <s>Haṃsa</s> inspire us [<s>Haṃsa Gāyatrī</s>].

children.text:
8.1.51.1 yó vā sáṃyogas saṃjúṣamāṇas sandhús sandhúkṣaṇānām
saṃyógaṃ sándadhānaḥ[*805] puṇyáḥ puṇyā́nāṃ puṇyā́ya svā́hā
8.1.51.2 saha saṃpāyā́s tvam āśíṣam āśīr bhūtābhūtám
āśíṣam āśī-rāsī́r[*806] āśir ánubhūmis[*807] svā́hā
8.1.51.3 yó vā téjas téjasāṃ téjas téja ā́dadhānaḥ
satyás téjas téjasāṃ téjas téjas téjase svā́hā
8.1.51.4 yó vā ā́yuḥ páramātmānaṃ mīḍhúṣaḥ paraṃparyā́t paráḥ parāyaṇáḥ
paró lokā́nāṃ paramā́ dadhānaḥ parátaḥ parāya svā́hā
8.1.51.5 víṣṇus sárveṣām ádhipatiḥ paramáḥ purāṇáḥ
paró lokā́nām ájító jítātmán bhávaté 'bhavāya svā́hā
[*805] Text: sándhadhānaḥ
[*806] Text: āsī-rāsī́r
[*807] Text: ánubhūmi
children.translated_text:
He who is indeed the union, delighting in joining, the junction-point of those who kindle,
establishing the union, the meritorious among the meritorious — to merit, <s>svāhā</s>!
Together with the draughts, you [are] the blessing; the blessing is for what has been and what has not been;
the blessing, the giver of blessings, the blessing experienced, <s>svāhā</s>!
He who indeed establishes radiance, the radiance of radiances, the radiance among radiances,
truly the radiance, the radiance of radiances — to the radiance of radiances, <s>svāhā</s>!
He who is indeed the life-force, the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self), of the bountiful one, beyond succession, the supreme refuge,
beyond the worlds, establishing the highest — beyond, to the supreme, <s>svāhā</s>!
<s>Viṣṇu</s> is the overlord of all, the supreme, the ancient,
beyond the worlds, unconquered — O self-conquered one, for existence and non-existence, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.1.52.1 yó védādíḥ páramaḥ paro brahmā́ tri-mā́tras tráyi-mūrtikáḥ
śabdáś śabdātigáḥ paraṃ-bráhmaṇe páraṃ-jyótiṣe svā́hā
8.1.52.2 yó vā gáviṣṭhaḥ
8.1.52.3 parā́ya párameṣṭhy-ātmane víṣṇave ā́kāśāya námaḥ
8.1.52.4 yó vā vā́yuḥ
8.1.52.5 parā́ya púruṣātmane púruṣāya vā́yave námaḥ
8.1.52.6 tvám agne trí-guṇo variṣṭháḥ
8.1.52.7 parāya víśvātmane sátyāyāgnáye námaḥ
8.1.52.8 tváṃ jī́vas tvám ā́paḥ
8.1.52.9 parā́ya nívr̥ty-ātmane ácyutāyadbhyó námaḥ

8.1.53.1 bhū́mer vítanvánn
8.1.53.2 parāya sárvātmane 'níruddhāya pŕ̥thivyai námaḥ
8.1.53.3 bráhmá bráhmāntarātmā́ bráhmá-pū́tāntarātmā́ bráhmaṇi bráhma-niṣṭhó bráhma-gupto gupto 'ham asmi
8.1.53.4 dyaúr dyaúr asi sárva imé prāṇā́ sthāṇáva āsann
8.1.53.5 śikhé udvártayāmi
8.1.53.6 sá-védās sa-mantrās sā́rṣās sá-sómā devā́ḥ parivartáyantām
8.1.53.7 devā́nām ayudhaíḥ[*808] páribādhayāmi
8.1.53.8 bráhmaṇo mántrair ī́śasyójasā bhŕ̥gūṇām áṅgirasāṃ tápasā sárvam ā́tanomi
8.1.53.9 nārāyaṇā́ya vidmáhe vāsudévā́ya dhīmahi
tán no viṣṇuḥ pracodáyāt
[*808] Text: ayuthaíḥ
children.translated_text:
Spreading over the earth;
homage to the supreme, to the Self of all, to <s>Aniruddha</s> (the Irresistible), to the Earth!
<s>Brahman</s>, the inner Self of <s>Brahman</s>, the inner Self purified by <s>Brahman</s>, established in <s>Brahman</s>, devoted to <s>Brahman</s>, protected by <s>Brahman</s> — I am protected.
Heaven, you are heaven; all these <s>prāṇas</s> (vital breaths) were like pillars.
O crest-lock, I raise up!
May the <s>devas</s> (gods), with the <s>Vedas</s>, with the <s>mantras</s>, with the <s>ṛṣis</s> (seers), with <s>Soma</s>, revolve [the cosmic order]!
With the weapons of the <s>devas</s>, I repel [all evil]!
With the <s>mantras</s> of <s>Brahman</s>, with the might of <s>Īśa</s> (the Lord), with the <s>tapas</s> (austerity) of the <s>Bhṛgus</s> and <s>Aṅgirasas</s>, I pervade all!
We know <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, we meditate on <s>Vāsudeva</s>;
may that <s>Viṣṇu</s> inspire us!

children.text:
8.1.54.1 sudarśanám abhígr̥hṇāmi
8.1.54.2 rávipām abhígr̥hṇāmi
8.1.54.3 sū́ryo 'si sū́ryāntarātmā́
8.1.54.4 cákṣur asi sárvam asi sárvaṃ dhehi
8.1.54.5 cándro 'si yajño 'si yajñā́yādhā́nam asi
8.1.54.6 yajñásya moṣád asi
8.1.54.7 ā́bhuraṇyaṃ vídhiṃ yajñáṃ brahmā́ṇaṃ devendrám
8.1.54.8 antár asminn imé lokā́ḥ
8.1.54.9 áto devā́ idáṃ víṣṇus trī́ṇi padā́ víṣṇoḥ kármāṇi tád víṣṇoḥ paramáṃ tád víprāsaḥ
8.1.54.10 jñā́nā́yá hŕ̥dayāya námaḥ
children.translated_text:
I take hold of the <s>Sudarśana</s> (the Beautiful-to-behold, Viṣṇu's discus)!
I take hold of the sun's [radiance]!
You are <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun), the inner Self of the Sun.
You are the eye, you are all — bestow all!
You are <s>Candra</s> (the Moon), you are the sacrifice, you are the kindling of the sacrifice.
You are the stealer of the sacrifice.
The ornamental rite, the sacrifice, <s>Brahmā</s>, the lord of the <s>devas</s>;
within this [are contained] these worlds.
Therefore the <s>devas</s> [worship] this <s>Viṣṇu</s>; the three strides of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s> — that supreme [abode] of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, that the wise ones [behold].
Homage to <s>Jñāna</s> (Knowledge), to the heart!

children.text:
8.1.55.1 śáktyaí śírase svāhā́
8.1.55.2 bálā́yá śíkhāyai vaṣáṭ
8.1.55.3 aíśváryā́yá kávacāya húm
8.1.55.4 vī́ryā́yá nétrá-tráyāya vauṣáṭ
8.1.55.5 téjásé ástrāya pháṭ
8.1.55.6 bhū́r bhúvas súvar óm[*809]
8.1.55.7 keśavāya námaḥ
8.1.55.8 nārāyaṇā́ya námaḥ
8.1.55.9 mādhavā́ya námaḥ
8.1.55.10 govindā́ya námaḥ
[*809] śrī́ṃ óṃ hŕ̥dayāya námáḥ | drā́ṃ óṃ śírase svāhā | ā́ṃ óṃ śíkhāyai vaṣáṭ | hrā́ṃ óṃ kávacāya húm | klī́ṃ óṃ nétrá-tráyāya vauṣáṭ | rā́ṃ óṃ ástrāya pháṭ | bhū́r bhúvas súvár óm | áṃ ā́ṃ íṃ ī́ṃ úṃ ū́ṃ ŕ̥ṃ r̥̄́ṃ l̥'ṃ l̥̄'ṃ éṃ aíṃ óṃ aúṃ ā́ṃ ā́ḥ | govindā́ya námaḥ | mahīdharā́ya námaḥ | hr̥ṣīkeśā́ya námaḥ || trivikramā́ya námaḥ | víṣṇave námaḥ | mādhavā́ya námaḥ ||
children.translated_text:
To <s>Śakti</s> (Power), to the head, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Bala</s> (Strength), to the crest-lock, <s>vaṣaṭ</s>!
To <s>Aiśvarya</s> (Sovereignty), to the armor, <s>hum</s>!
To <s>Vīrya</s> (Heroic Valor), to the three eyes, <s>vauṣaṭ</s>!
To <s>Tejas</s> (Splendor), to the missile, <s>phaṭ</s>!
<s>Bhūr bhuvas suvar oṃ</s> (earth, atmosphere, heaven, <s>Oṃ</s>)!
Homage to <s>Keśava</s>!
Homage to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>!
Homage to <s>Mādhava</s>!
Homage to <s>Govinda</s>!

children.text:
8.1.56.1 víṣṇave námaḥ
8.1.56.2 madhusūdanā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.3 trivikramā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.4 vāmaṇā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.5 śrīdharā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.6 hr̥śīkeśā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.7 padmanābhā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.8 dāmódarā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.9 saṅkarṣaṇā́ya námaḥ
8.1.56.10 vā́sudevāya námaḥ
children.translated_text:
Homage to <s>Viṣṇu</s>!
Homage to <s>Madhusūdana</s> (the Slayer of Madhu)!
Homage to <s>Trivikrama</s> (the Three-strider)!
Homage to <s>Vāmana</s> (the Dwarf)!
Homage to <s>Śrīdhara</s> (the Bearer of <s>Śrī</s>)!
Homage to <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s> (the Lord of the Senses)!
Homage to <s>Padmanābha</s> (the Lotus-naveled One)!
Homage to <s>Dāmodara</s> (the Rope-bellied One)!
Homage to <s>Saṅkarṣaṇa</s> (the Drawer-together)!
Homage to <s>Vāsudeva</s>!

children.text:
8.1.57.1 pradyumnā́ya námaḥ
8.1.57.2 aniruddhā́ya námaḥ
8.1.57.3 puruṣottamā́ya námaḥ
8.1.57.4 adhokṣajā́ya námaḥ
8.1.57.5 nā́rasiṃhāya námaḥ
8.1.57.6 ácyutāya námaḥ
8.1.57.7 janārdanā́ya námaḥ
8.1.57.8 upendrā́ya námaḥ
8.1.57.9 háraye námaḥ
8.1.57.10 śrī-kr̥ṣṇā́ya námaḥ
children.translated_text:
Homage to <s>Pradyumna</s>!
Homage to <s>Aniruddha</s> (the Irresistible)!
Homage to <s>Puruṣottama</s> (the Supreme Person)!
Homage to <s>Adhokṣaja</s> (the One beyond the Senses)!
Homage to <s>Nārasiṃha</s> (the Man-Lion)!
Homage to <s>Acyuta</s> (the Imperishable)!
Homage to <s>Janārdana</s> (the Agitator of People)!
Homage to <s>Upendra</s> (the Younger Brother of <s>Indra</s>)!
Homage to <s>Hari</s>!
Homage to <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>!

children.text:
8.1.58.1 ékākṣaraṃ
8.1.58.2 víśve nímagnaḥ
8.1.58.3 prāṇáḥ prásūtir
8.1.58.4 vitátya bāṇáṃ
8.1.58.5 tvám vajra-bhŕ̥d
8.1.58.6 dhātā́ vidhātā́
8.1.58.7 ŕ̥co yájū́(g)ṃṣi
8.1.58.8 sá éṣá devás
8.1.58.9 sá sárvá-vettā́
8.1.58.10 sāmaíś cá sāṅgáṃ[*810]
8.1.58.11 tvá(gg)ṃ strī pumān
8.1.58.12 mitrás suparṇás
8.1.58.13 tváṃ víṣṇur bhūtā́ni
8.1.58.14 tváṃ bhū́r bhúvas tva(g)ṃ
8.1.58.15 ya eváṃ nítyaṃ
8.1.58.16 buddhimatāṃ párāṃ gátim
8.1.58.17 óṃ dhánuṣe námaḥ
8.1.58.18 śáktyaí svāhā́
8.1.58.19 gádāyai vaṣáṭ
8.1.58.20 khaḍgā́ya húm
8.1.58.21 cakrā́ya vaúṣaṭ
8.1.58.22 vā́sukaye pháṭ
8.1.58.23 víṣṇur mā́ṃ rakṣatu
8.1.58.24 jāmbūnada-prabhā́ya cakra-dharā́ya kéśavāya námaḥ
8.1.58.25 candra-prabhā́ya dhanur-dharā́ya góvindāya svāhā́
[*810] Ek Up (US, SU, OU): cid-antaḥ in place of cá sāṅgáṃ

8.1.59.1 nīla-jīmūta-sánnibhā́ya śaṅkha-dharā́ya[*811] nā́rāyaṇāya váṣaṭ
8.1.59.2 padma-kíñjalka-sánnibhā́ya hala-dharā́ya víṣṇave húm
8.1.59.3 aravindābhā́ya musala-dharā́ya madhusū́danāya vaúṣaṭ
8.1.59.4 jvalana-prábhā́ya khaḍga-dharā́ya trivíkramāya pháṭ
8.1.59.5 taruṇāditya-sánnibhā́ya vajra-dharā́ya vā́manāya námaḥ
8.1.59.6 puṇḍarīkā́kṣā́ya paṭṭasa-dharā́ya śrī́dharāya svāhā́
8.1.59.7 indīvara-dála[*812]-śyā́māya kaumodakī-dharā́ya gádā-dharāya váṣáṭ
8.1.59.8 vidyut-prabhā́ya mudgara-dharā́ya hŕ̥śīkeśāya húm
8.1.59.9 citra-varṇa-dharā́ya pāśa-hastā́ya víṣṇave vauṣáṭ
8.1.59.10 indra-nīla-prabhā́yā́parājitāya vyāpi-nārāyaṇā́ya pháṭ
[*811] Text: -tharā́ya
[*812] Text: dáḷa
children.translated_text:
<s>Vaṣaṭ</s> to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the bearer of the conch, whose complexion resembles a dark rain-cloud!
<s>Hum</s> to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the bearer of the plough, whose complexion resembles the filaments of a lotus!
<s>Vauṣaṭ</s> to <s>Madhusūdana</s> (the Slayer of Madhu), the bearer of the mace, whose radiance is like a lotus!
<s>Phaṭ</s> to <s>Trivikrama</s> (the Three-strider), the bearer of the sword, whose radiance is like blazing fire!
Homage to <s>Vāmana</s> (the Dwarf), the bearer of the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), whose complexion resembles the young sun!
<s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Śrīdhara</s> (the Bearer of <s>Śrī</s>), the lotus-eyed one, the bearer of the shield!
<s>Vaṣaṭ</s> to <s>Gadādhara</s> (the Mace-bearer), the bearer of <s>Kaumodakī</s> (Viṣṇu's mace), dark as the petal of a blue lotus!
<s>Hum</s> to <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s> (the Lord of the Senses), the bearer of the hammer, whose radiance is like lightning!
<s>Vauṣaṭ</s> to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the bearer of varied colors, the holder of the noose!
<s>Phaṭ</s> to the all-pervading <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the unconquered one, whose radiance is like indigo sapphire!

children.text:
8.1.60.1 bhū́r bhúvas súvar óm
8.1.60.2 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
8.1.60.3 bráhmaivá bhūtā́nāṃ jyéṣṭhaṃ téna ko 'rhati spárdhitum
8.1.60.4 tátth savitúr váreṇyam
8.1.60.5 ā́tmātmā páramāntarātmā́
8.1.60.6 súvar bhúvar bhū́ḥ
8.1.60.7 śriyé jātáḥ
8.1.60.8 medínī devī́
8.1.60.9 saṃyuktam etát kṣar̥áte 'kṣaran tu vyaktā́vyáktaṃ bhávate víśvam asmā́t
8.1.60.10 ā́nīśa ātmā́ báddhyate bhoktr̥-bhāvā́d jñātvā́ dévaṃ múcyate sarva-pāpaiḥ
children.translated_text:
<s>Bhūr bhuvas suvar oṃ</s> (earth, atmosphere, heaven, <s>Oṃ</s>)!
<s>Oṃ</s>! Homage to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>!
<s>Brahman</s> indeed is the eldest of all beings — who is worthy of competing with him?
That of <s>Savitṛ</s>, the most excellent —
The Self, the Self, the supreme inner Self.
<s>Suvar</s>, <s>bhuvar</s>, <s>bhūḥ</s> (heaven, atmosphere, earth)!
Born for <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity).
<s>Medinī</s> (the Earth), the goddess.
This combined [universe], the perishable and the imperishable, the manifest and unmanifest — the universe [proceeds] from him;
the powerless Self is bound by the condition of being an enjoyer — knowing the <s>deva</s> (god), one is released from all sins.

children.text:
8.1.61.1 idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
8.1.61.2 ā́yā́tú bhágávā́n
8.1.61.3 óṃ víṣṇum ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.61.4 púrúṣam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.61.5 sátyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.61.6 ácyútam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.61.7 ánírúddham ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.61.8 śriyé jātáś śriyá ā́ nír iyāya śríyaṃ váyo jaritŕ̥bhyo dadhāti
śríyaṃ vásānā amr̥tatvám āyan bhávanti satyā́ samidhā́ mitádrau
8.1.61.9[*813] āyātu bhagavatī śrīs svarṇa-varṇā sa-gaṇā sa-sainya śrī parama-puruṣa-sahāyā saha devatābhir anumanyatām
[*813] There are no accent marks in the text from 8.1.61.9 through 8.1.62.1.
children.translated_text:
This <s>Viṣṇu</s> [strode forth];
may the Blessed One (<s>Bhagavān</s>) come!
<s>Oṃ</s>! I invoke <s>Viṣṇu</s>!
I invoke <s>Puruṣa</s> (the Cosmic Person)!
I invoke <s>Satya</s> (Truth)!
I invoke <s>Acyuta</s> (the Imperishable)!
I invoke <s>Aniruddha</s> (the Irresistible)!
Born for <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity), from <s>Śrī</s> he came forth; he bestows <s>Śrī</s> upon the worshippers;
clad in <s>Śrī</s>, they attain immortality — they become true, [offering] fuel on the measured altar.
May the Blessed <s>Śrī</s> come, of golden color, with her retinue, with her army — <s>Śrī</s>, accompanied by the Supreme <s>Puruṣa</s> — may she, together with the deities, give her approval!

children.text:
8.1.62.1 yā padmāsanā padma-hastā haṃsa-niryākhya-vāhinī nityam r̥ṣibhiś cānugāminī tām ajāṃ puṇḍarīka-netrīṃ bhagavatīṃ śrīm
8.1.62.2 óṃ śríyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.62.3 dhŕ̥tim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.62.4 pavítrīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.62.5 pramódā́yínīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.62.6 medínī devī́ vasúndharī syād vásudhā devī́ vāsávī
brahma-varcasáḥ pitr̥̄ṇā́(g)ṃ śrótraṃ víṣṇur mánaḥ
8.1.62.7[*814] āyātu bhagavatī hariṇī śyāma-varṇā sa-gaṇā sa-sainyā śrī parama-puruṣa-sahāyā saha devatābhir anumanyatām
8.1.62.8 yā nīlotpalāsanā nīlotpala-hastā mahā-cātaka-vāhinī nityam r̥ṣibhiś cānugāminī tām ajāṃ nīlotpala-netrīm bhagavatīṃ[*815] lam
8.1.62.9 óṃ háríṇīm ā́vāhayāmi
[*814] There are no accent marks in the text from 8.1.62.8 through 8.1.62.9.
[*815] Text: bhagavatī
children.translated_text: 8.1.62.1 She who is seated on a lotus, lotus-handed, borne on a vehicle called the swan (<s>haṃsa</s>), always followed by the <s>ṛṣis</s> (seers) — that unborn, lotus-eyed, blessed <s>Śrī</s> — 8.1.62.2 <s>Oṃ</s>. I invoke <s>Śrī</s>. 8.1.62.3 I invoke <s>Dhṛti</s> (Steadfastness). 8.1.62.4 I invoke <s>Pavitrī</s> (the Purifier). 8.1.62.5 I invoke <s>Pramodāyinī</s> (the Delighter). 8.1.62.6 <s>Medinī</s> (Earth) is the goddess, the treasure-bearer (<s>Vasundharī</s>); may <s>Vasudhā</s> (Earth) be the goddess <s>Vāsavī</s> (consort of <s>Indra</s>); of the splendor of <s>Brahman</s>, the ear of the ancestors, <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the mind. 8.1.62.7 May the blessed <s>Hariṇī</s> (the Golden One) come — dark-complexioned, with her retinue, with her army, <s>Śrī</s>, the companion of the Supreme <s>Puruṣa</s> — together with the deities, may she approve! 8.1.62.8 She who is seated on a blue lotus, blue-lotus-handed, borne by the great <s>cātaka</s> bird, always followed by the <s>ṛṣis</s> (seers) — that unborn, blue-lotus-eyed, blessed one — 8.1.62.9 <s>Oṃ</s>. I invoke <s>Hariṇī</s>.

children.text:
8.1.63.1 paúṣṇīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.63.2 kṣónīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.63.3 máhīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.63.4 oṃ máhyai námaḥ
8.1.63.5 sárvādhārāya námaḥ
8.1.63.6 sánātanāya námaḥ
8.1.63.7 divyā́ya námaḥ
8.1.63.8 kamáṭha-rūpiṇe [*816]námaḥ
8.1.63.9 ā́di-kūrmāya námaḥ
8.1.63.10 śéṣā́ya námaḥ
8.1.63.11 díg-gajebhyo námaḥ
8.1.63.12 ā́dhāra-śaktyai námaḥ
8.1.63.13 saptā́rṇavebhyo námaḥ
8.1.63.14 sáhásrá-pátrá-yútá-kámalāya námaḥ
8.1.63.15 ráktā́mbújá-máṇí-yámá-pádma-pīṭhāya námaḥ
8.1.63.16 śrī́mán-nā́rāyaṇāya námaḥ
[*816] The texts inserts the word ya here which we have omitted.
children.translated_text: 8.1.63.1 I invoke <s>Pauṣṇī</s>. 8.1.63.2 I invoke <s>Kṣoṇī</s> (the Earth). 8.1.63.3 I invoke <s>Mahī</s> (the Great Earth). 8.1.63.4 <s>Oṃ</s>. Obeisance to <s>Mahī</s>. 8.1.63.5 Obeisance to the Support of All (<s>Sarvādhāra</s>). 8.1.63.6 Obeisance to the Eternal One (<s>Sanātana</s>). 8.1.63.7 Obeisance to the Divine One. 8.1.63.8 Obeisance to the one in the form of a tortoise (<s>Kamaṭha-rūpin</s>). 8.1.63.9 Obeisance to the Primordial Tortoise (<s>Ādi-kūrma</s>). 8.1.63.10 Obeisance to <s>Śeṣa</s> (the Cosmic Serpent). 8.1.63.11 Obeisance to the directional elephants (<s>dig-gajas</s>). 8.1.63.12 Obeisance to the foundational power (<s>Ādhāra-śakti</s>). 8.1.63.13 Obeisance to the seven oceans. 8.1.63.14 Obeisance to the lotus of a thousand and ten thousand petals. 8.1.63.15 Obeisance to the lotus-throne of ruby, gem, and <s>Yama</s>-[colored] lotuses. 8.1.63.16 Obeisance to <s>Śrīman Nārāyaṇa</s>.

children.text:
8.0.4 sa(gg)ṃśrayā́ya námo bhū́s svá-guṇair jyótir āsīd deva-rī́ṣata útpādayāmí prátiṣṭhāpayāmí prácodáyāt svā́hā námaḥ pracodáyān námo námo devāya námaś śrī́ kr̥ṣṇā́ya námas svāhā́ pháṭ[*817] sárvá-pāpaír ánúmányátā́m ā́vāhayāmi namaṣ ṣáṭ ca
[*817] Text: páṭ
children.translated_text: 8.0.4 [Rubric:] 'To the Refuge, <s>namaḥ</s>! <s>Bhūḥ</s>, by one's own <s>guṇas</s> (qualities), light it was, the <s>deva</s> (god) established; I generate, I install, may [<s>Savitṛ</s>] impel, <s>svāhā</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>; may he impel, <s>namaḥ</s>, <s>namaḥ</s> to the <s>deva</s>, <s>namaḥ</s> to <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>, <s>phaṭ</s>! From all sins, may it be approved; I invoke, <s>namaḥ</s>' — and six [more mantras].

children.text:
8.1.64.1 prá tád víṣṇuḥ
8.1.64.2 astv āsanáṃ śubhaṃ loké brusī́ śúddhas tapo-mayam
8.1.64.3 tápaś cāyús tathā yogám astú te paramáṃ padám
8.1.64.4 viśvādikā́nāṃ jánanādi-kártre dhā́tre tápo-yajña-súveda-mūrté
8.1.64.5 susvāgatáṃ yátra taṃ tátra yásmāt tát te pádá(g)ṃ[*818] sūríbhis svāgatan te
8.1.64.6 mano 'bhimantā́ mā́navas sudhármā yán mātáraṃ vácaso mā́naseṣu
amogham ogháṃ práti veda-vedya-svákaṃ jánānām ánumanyatām idám
8.1.64.7 tvá(gg)ṃ strī tváṃ púmān mānasī[*819] tváṃ déva-kumārá idáṃ nā́daḥ kumārī́
8.1.64.8 tváṃ jī́rṇas tváṃ jániṃ gacchasi tváṃ jātó nivāsīr viśváto mukhaḥ
8.1.64.9 trī́ṇi padā́
[*818] Text: pádág corrected to pádágṃ
[*819] 1946 edition: mānasī; 1984 edition: mānasi
children.translated_text: 8.1.64.1 'Forth that <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' 8.1.64.2 May there be an auspicious seat in the world — a cushion (<s>brusī</s>), pure, made of <s>tapas</s> (austerity). 8.1.64.3 May <s>tapas</s>, lifespan, and <s>yoga</s> be your supreme abode. 8.1.64.4 To the creator of the origin of all, beginning with the universal — the Ordainer (<s>Dhātṛ</s>), whose form is <s>tapas</s>, sacrifice, and the excellent <s>Veda</s> — 8.1.64.5 a warm welcome wherever he is, from wherever he comes — that step of yours, [acclaimed] by the wise ones — welcome to you! 8.1.64.6 The one who sanctifies by mind, the human one, of good <s>dharma</s> — who [places] the mother of speech in the minds — the unfailing flood, the one to be known through the <s>Vedas</s>, his own, of people — may this be approved! 8.1.64.7 You are a woman, you are a man, you are the mind-born one, you are the divine youth — this is the sound, the maiden. 8.1.64.8 You are the aged, you go to birth, you, once born, dwell with face in all directions. 8.1.64.9 'Three steps...'

children.text:
8.1.65.1 índro 'bhimantā́ manávo vā́yavaś cā́pas samagrā́ abhíto yásya dadyā́t
8.1.65.2 víṣṇo imā́n vaiṣṇavā́(g)ṃs tarpayāmi prásīda devā́dhika-téjasainam
8.1.65.3 agnír índro váruṇo mitró aryamā́ vāyúḥ pūṣā́ sárasvatī sa-jóṣasaḥ
8.1.65.4 ādityā́ víṣṇur marútaḥ svar br̥hat-sómo rudró áditir bráhmaṇaspátiḥ
8.1.65.5 trír deváḥ[*820]
8.1.65.6 indriyā́ṇí śátá-kráto yā́ te jáneṣu pañcásu
índra tā́ni ta ā́ vr̥ṇe
8.1.65.7 ágann índra śrávo br̥hád dyumnáṃ dádhiṣva duṣṭáraṃ
út te śuṣmáṃ trirāmasi
8.1.65.8 yóge-yoge śáṃ no devī́
8.1.65.9 ghatā́t pári maṇḍa ivā́psu snehás sárvā́dhikas sarva-dhátteṣu śarváḥ
8.1.65.10 sá cetánáś cetáyate sva-śaktyā́
8.1.65.11 éko lokā́n gárbhavat pātu sárvān
8.1.65.12 vícakrame pr̥thivī́
[*820] Text: dreváḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.65.1 '<s>Indra</s> is the sanctifier; the humans and the <s>Vāyus</s> (winds) and the complete waters — to whomever he would give [of these].' 8.1.65.2 'O <s>Viṣṇu</s>, I satisfy these <s>Vaiṣṇavas</s>; be pleased, O <s>deva</s> (god) — with radiance surpassing [all] gods, upon him.' 8.1.65.3 '<s>Agni</s>, <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Aryaman</s>, <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s> — delighting together.' 8.1.65.4 'The <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the <s>Maruts</s>, <s>Svar</s> (heaven), the great <s>Soma</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Brahmaṇaspati</s>.' 8.1.65.5 'Thrice the god...' 8.1.65.6 'The senses, O <s>Śatakratu</s> (Hundred-sacrificer), which are yours among the five peoples — O <s>Indra</s>, those I choose for you.' 8.1.65.7 'You have won great fame, O <s>Indra</s>; seize the irresistible brilliance! We raise your fury threefold.' 8.1.65.8 'In every <s>yoga</s>, auspicious to us, O Goddess...' 8.1.65.9 'From the pot, like cream upon waters, the affection surpasses all — <s>Śarva</s> (the Archer) in all vessels.' 8.1.65.10 'That conscious one awakens [all] by his own power.' 8.1.65.11 'May the one [god] protect all the worlds like an embryo.' 8.1.65.12 'He strode across the earth...'

children.text: 8.0.5 trī́ṇi padā́ śáṃ no devī́ś catvā́ri ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.5 [Rubric:] 'Three steps... Auspicious to us, O Goddess...' — and four [more mantras].

children.text:
8.1.66.1 bhū́ḥ prápadye
8.1.66.2 védāhám etáṃ púruṣaṃ mahā́ntam ādityá-varṇaṃ támasas tú pāré
sárvāṇi rūpā́ṇi vicítya dhī́raḥ nā́māni kr̥tvā́bhivádan yádā́ste
8.1.66.3 trī́ṇi padā́
8.1.66.4 ā́ mā vā́jasya prasavó jagamyād ā́ dyāvā-pŕ̥thivī́ viśvá-śambhū
ā́ mā gantāṃ pitárā mātárā cā́ mā sómo amŕ̥tatvā́ya gamyāt
8.1.66.5 śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.66.6 upānáhāv adhyávarohāmi
children.translated_text: 8.1.66.1 'I take refuge in <s>Bhūḥ</s> (Earth).' 8.1.66.2 'I know this great <s>Puruṣa</s> (Cosmic Person), of the color of the sun, beyond darkness. The wise one, having discerned all forms, having made names, who thus sits [and speaks].' 8.1.66.3 'Three steps...' 8.1.66.4 'May the impetus of vigor come to me; may heaven and earth, universally beneficent, [come to me]; may the two parents, father and mother, come to me; may <s>Soma</s> come to me for immortality.' 8.1.66.5 'Auspicious to us, O Goddesses...' 8.1.66.6 'I mount the sandals.'

children.text:
8.1.67.1 svastí no mimītām
8.1.67.2 páraṃ raṃha ā́sthāsye
8.1.67.3 prá tád víṣṇus trī́ṇi padā́ śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.67.4 annā́dyāya vyūhadhvaṃ dīrghāyúr ahám annādó bhūyāsam
8.1.67.5 téna me tapá téna me jvalá téna me dīdihi yā́vad devā́ḥ
8.1.67.6 idáṃ bráhma punīmahe brahmá punātu
8.1.67.7 yóge-yoge tavástaraṃ vā́je-vāje havāmahe
sákhāya índram ūtáye
8.1.67.8 yán me gárbhe vásataḥ pāpám ugráṃ yáj jā́yamānasya ca kíñca dairghyám
pāpáṃ jātásya yásya bhúvi vártato me tásya tát pāvamānī́bhir aháṃ punāmi
children.translated_text: 8.1.67.1 'May [the gods] measure out well-being for us.' 8.1.67.2 'I shall attain the supreme swiftness.' 8.1.67.3 'Forth that <s>Viṣṇu</s>... Three steps... Auspicious to us, O Goddesses...' 8.1.67.4 'For the eating of food, array yourselves! May I be long-lived, may I become a food-eater!' 8.1.67.5 'With that, blaze for me, with that, shine for me, with that, gleam for me — as long as the gods [endure]!' 8.1.67.6 'We purify this <s>Brahman</s>; may <s>Brahman</s> purify [us].' 8.1.67.7 'In every <s>yoga</s>, [we call upon] the most excellent; in every contest we invoke <s>Indra</s>, [our] friend, for aid.' 8.1.67.8 'Whatever evil sin [clings to me] dwelling in the womb, whatever impurity at birth, whatever sin of the born one living on earth — from that I purify myself with the <s>Pāvamānī</s> verses.'

children.text:
8.1.68.1 śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.68.2 áto devā́ḥ idáṃ víṣṇus trī́ṇi padā́ víṣṇoḥ kármāṇi tád víṣṇoḥ paramáṃ tád víprāsaḥ
8.1.68.3 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
8.1.68.4 kás tvā satyó mádānāṃ má(g)ṃhiṣṭho mathsad ándhasaḥ
dr̥ḍhā́ cid ārúje vásu
8.1.68.5 párilikhita(g)ṃ rákṣaḥ párilikhitā árātayáḥ
8.1.68.6 párilikhitas so 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yáñ ca vayáṃ dviṣmáḥ
8.1.68.7 vā́rīś cátasraś śán no devī́ḥ
8.1.68.8 námo váruṇaś śuddháś śuddho 'ham asmi
8.1.68.9 śuddhó bráhma-vīró hárir yáthā śuddháḥ páñca-bhūtās táthā śuddhā́ś śuddho 'ham asmi
children.translated_text: 8.1.68.1 'Auspicious to us, O Goddesses...' 8.1.68.2 '<s>Ato devāḥ</s>... This <s>Viṣṇu</s>... Three steps... The deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>... That supreme [abode] of <s>Viṣṇu</s>... That the inspired ones...' 8.1.68.3 '<s>Oṃ namo Nārāyaṇāya</s>.' 8.1.68.4 'Who among the true exhilarations, O most bountiful one, shall churn from the pressed [<s>Soma</s>] juice? He breaks open even firm [barriers] for wealth.' 8.1.68.5 'Marked off is the <s>rākṣas</s> (demon), marked off are the enemies.' 8.1.68.6 'May he be marked off who hates us, and whom we hate.' 8.1.68.7 'The four waters... Auspicious to us, O Goddesses...' 8.1.68.8 'Obeisance to <s>Varuṇa</s>; pure, I am pure.' 8.1.68.9 'Pure, the <s>Brahman</s>-hero, <s>Hari</s> — as that one is pure, [as] the five elements are pure, so I am pure.'

children.text:
8.1.69.1 bráhmāhám asmi hárir asmi
8.1.69.2 īśá īśo 'smi bhávaṃ bhávāmahe
8.1.69.3 sínīvāli-pŕ̥thuṣṭuke yā́ devā́nām ási svásā
juṣásva havyám ā́hutaṃ prajā́ṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ
8.1.69.4 bhū́r anílayā bhū́tayā bhū́tayā páriṣiñcāmi bhúvas suṣumnáyā prāṇávatyā páriṣiñcāmi svar amŕ̥távatyā jyótiṣmatyā ca páriṣiñcāmi
8.1.69.5 tā́(g)ṃ savitúr váreṇyasya citrā́m aháṃ[*821] vr̥ṇe sumatíṃ viśvá-janyām yā́m asya káṇvo áduhat prápīnā(g)ṃ sahásra-dhārāṃ páyasā mahī́ṃ gā́m
8.1.69.6 ágním īḷa iṣé tvorjé tvā gándha-dvārā́ṃ sahásra-śīrṣā púruṣaḥ
8.1.69.7 sahasra-śī́rṣaṃ devám áto devā́
[*821] 1984, 1946 editions: āháṃ, corrected to aháṃ.
children.translated_text: 8.1.69.1 'I am <s>Brahman</s>, I am <s>Hari</s>.' 8.1.69.2 'The Lord (<s>Īśa</s>), I am the Lord; I become Being (<s>Bhava</s>).' 8.1.69.3 'O <s>Sinīvālī</s>, broad-braided one — you who are the sister of the gods — accept the oblation offered; O Goddess, grant us offspring!' 8.1.69.4 'With the breath of <s>Bhūḥ</s> (Earth), with prosperity, with prosperity, I sprinkle; with the <s>Suṣumnā</s> of <s>Bhuvas</s> (Atmosphere), with life-breath, I sprinkle; with the immortal and luminous [breath] of <s>Svar</s> (Heaven), I sprinkle.' 8.1.69.5 'That wondrous favor of <s>Savitṛ</s>, the choicest — I choose the all-embracing wisdom; the one which <s>Kaṇva</s> milked forth, brimming, the great cow of a thousand streams of milk.' 8.1.69.6 'I praise <s>Agni</s>; for food I [invoke] you, for vigor I [invoke] you; the fragrance-gated one; the thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>.' 8.1.69.7 'The thousand-headed god... From here the gods...'

children.text:
8.1.70.1 mitrás suparṇáś cándra índro 'tha rudrás tváṣtā víṣṇus savitā́ gó-patis tvám
tváṃ víṣṇur bhūtā́ni tatrā́si daítyas tváyā vr̥taṃ jágad úlbena garbháḥ
8.1.70.2 áthā vayám āditya vraté távā́nāgaso áditaye syāma
8.1.70.3 yuváṃ vástrāṇi pīvasā́ vasāthe yuvór ácchidrā mántavo ha sárgāḥ
ávātiratam ánr̥tāni víśvā r̥téna mitrā varuṇā sacethe
8.1.70.4 trī́ṇi padā́ śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.70.5 bhū́r asi bhūḥ pratiṣṭhityai trír deváḥ
8.1.70.6 áto devā́ óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
children.translated_text: 8.1.70.1 '<s>Mitra</s>, <s>Suparṇa</s> (the Fair-winged One), <s>Candra</s> (the Moon), <s>Indra</s>, then <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, the lord of cattle — you are! You, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, are the beings; there you are the <s>Daitya</s> (demon); by you the world is covered as a membrane [covers] the embryo.' 8.1.70.2 'Then, O <s>Āditya</s>, may we be sinless in your ordinance, [devoted] to <s>Aditi</s>.' 8.1.70.3 'You two wear rich garments; your mantras have no gaps, your courses [are complete]. You have conquered all untruths; by cosmic order (<s>ṛta</s>), O <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, you are united.' 8.1.70.4 'Three steps... Auspicious to us, O Goddesses...' 8.1.70.5 'You are <s>Bhūḥ</s> (Earth); <s>Bhūḥ</s>, for the establishment. Thrice the god...' 8.1.70.6 '<s>Ato devāḥ</s>... <s>Oṃ namo Nārāyaṇāya</s>.'

children.text: 8.0.6 ávarohāmy aháṃ punāmy ahám asmi devám áto devā́ nā́rāyaṇāyá
children.translated_text: 8.0.6 [Rubric:] 'I descend; I purify; I am; the god; from here the gods; to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.71.1 téjo vátsyāvas savitúḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhúbhyāṃ pūṣṇó hástābhyām
8.1.71.2 sómasya tanū́r asi tanúvaṃ me pāhi
svā́ mā tanū́r ā́ viśa
8.1.71.3 śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.71.4 idáṃ bráhma punīmahe
8.1.71.5 brahmá punātu
8.1.71.6 śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.71.7 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
8.1.71.8 víṣṇor nú kam
8.1.71.9 agníṃ dūtáṃ vr̥ṇīmahe hótāraṃ viśvá-vedasam
asyá yajñásya sukrátum
children.translated_text: 8.1.71.1 'Radiance — O son of <s>Vatsyava</s>, at the impelling of <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the arms of the <s>Aśvins</s>, with the hands of <s>Pūṣan</s>.' 8.1.71.2 'You are the body of <s>Soma</s>; protect my body. May my own body enter [me].' 8.1.71.3 'Auspicious to us, O Goddesses...' 8.1.71.4 'We purify this <s>Brahman</s>.' 8.1.71.5 'May <s>Brahman</s> purify [us].' 8.1.71.6 'Auspicious to us, O Goddesses...' 8.1.71.7 '<s>Oṃ namo Nārāyaṇāya</s>.' 8.1.71.8 '<s>Viṣṇor nu kam</s>...' (Now the heroic deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>...) 8.1.71.9 'We choose <s>Agni</s> as messenger, as <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoker), the knower of all; the one of good works in this sacrifice.'

children.text:
8.1.72.1 bhūtó bhūtéṣu carati práviṣṭas sá bhūtā́nām ádhipatir babhūva
8.1.72.2 tásya mr̥tyaú carati rā́jasū́ya(g)ṃ sá rā́jā rājyám ánumanyatām idám
8.1.72.3 tád víṣṇoḥ paramám
8.1.72.4 imā́s sumánasaś śreṣṭhā́ divyá-puṣpādhivā́sitāḥ
8.1.72.5 pūtā́ brahma-pavítreṇa pūtā́s sū́ryasya raśmíbhiḥ
8.1.72.6 tád víprāsaḥ
8.1.72.7 imé gandhā́s[*822] surabhíno divyá-gandhādhivā́sitāḥ
8.1.72.8 pūtā́ brahma-pavítreṇa pūtā́s sū́ryasya raśmíbhiḥ
8.1.72.9 yádā́ñjanaṃ traikakudáṃ jātá(g)ṃ himávata upári
8.1.72.10 téna vāmāñje téjase várcase bhágāya ca
[*822] Text: ganthā́s
children.translated_text: (8.1.72.1) 'Having become a being, he moves entered into beings; he became the lord of beings.' (8.1.72.2) 'In his [realm], the <s>Rājasūya</s> (royal consecration) proceeds even in death. May that king approve of this kingdom.' (8.1.72.3) 'That supreme [abode] of <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' (8.1.72.4) 'These excellent flowers of good mind, fragrant with divine blossoms,' (8.1.72.5) 'purified by the sacred filter of <s>Brahman</s>, purified by the rays of <s>Sūrya</s>.' (8.1.72.6) 'That the inspired ones (<s>viprāsaḥ</s>)...' (8.1.72.7) 'These fragrances, sweet-smelling, perfumed with divine scents,' (8.1.72.8) 'purified by the sacred filter of <s>Brahman</s>, purified by the rays of <s>Sūrya</s>.' (8.1.72.9) 'The collyrium (<s>añjana</s>) from <s>Traikakuda</s>, born upon the <s>Himavat</s> (Himālaya),' (8.1.72.10) 'with that I anoint you — for radiance, for splendor, and for fortune.'

children.text:
8.1.73.1 devásya tvā savitúḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhúbhyāṃ pūṣṇó hástābhyām
8.1.73.2 víṣṇave námáḥ
8.1.73.3 púruṣāya námáḥ
8.1.73.4 satyā́ya námáḥ
8.1.73.5 ácyutāya námáḥ
8.1.73.6 áníruddhāya námáḥ
8.1.73.7 kápilāya námáḥ
8.1.73.8 yajñā́ya námáḥ
8.1.73.9 nā́rāyaṇāya námáḥ
8.1.73.10 puṇyā́ya námáḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.73.1) 'At the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the arms of the <s>Aśvins</s>, with the hands of <s>Pūṣan</s>.' (8.1.73.2) 'To <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.3) 'To <s>Puruṣa</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.4) 'To <s>Satya</s> (Truth), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.5) 'To <s>Acyuta</s> (the Unfallen), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.6) 'To <s>Aniruddha</s> (the Unobstructed), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.7) 'To <s>Kapila</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.8) 'To <s>Yajña</s> (Sacrifice), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.9) 'To <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.73.10) 'To the Meritorious One (<s>Puṇya</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.74.1 śríyai námaḥ
8.1.74.2 dhŕ̥tyai námáḥ
8.1.74.3 pavítryai námáḥ
8.1.74.4 prámódā́yínyai námáḥ
8.1.74.5 haríṇyai námáḥ
8.1.74.6 paúṣṇyai námáḥ
8.1.74.7 kṣóṇyai námáḥ
8.1.74.8 máhyai námáḥ
8.1.74.9 vā́rāhāya námáḥ
8.1.74.10 nā́rasiṃhāya námáḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.74.1) 'To <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.2) 'To <s>Dhṛti</s> (Steadfastness), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.3) 'To <s>Pavitrī</s> (the Purifying One), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.4) 'To <s>Pramodāyinī</s> (the Delighting One), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.5) 'To <s>Hariṇī</s> (the Golden One), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.6) 'To <s>Pauṣṇī</s> (she of <s>Pūṣan</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.7) 'To <s>Kṣoṇī</s> (the Earth), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.8) 'To <s>Mahī</s> (the Great One), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.9) 'To <s>Vārāha</s> (the Boar-form), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.74.10) 'To <s>Nārasiṃha</s> (the Man-Lion), <s>namaḥ</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.75.1 vā́manāya námáḥ
8.1.75.2 trivikramā́ya námáḥ
8.1.75.3 subhadrā́ya námáḥ
8.1.75.4 ī́śitātmane námáḥ
8.1.75.5 sarvodvahā́ya námáḥ
8.1.75.6 sárva-vidyesvarāya námáḥ
8.1.75.7 indrā́ya námáḥ
8.1.75.8 yamā́ya námaḥ
8.1.75.9 váruṇāya námáḥ
8.1.75.10 kúberāya námáḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.75.1) 'To <s>Vāmana</s> (the Dwarf), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.2) 'To <s>Trivikrama</s> (the Three-strider), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.3) 'To <s>Subhadra</s> (the Auspicious One), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.4) 'To the one whose self is the ruler (<s>Īśitātman</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.5) 'To the upholder of all (<s>Sarvodvaha</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.6) 'To the lord of all knowledge (<s>Sarva-vidyeśvara</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.7) 'To <s>Indra</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.8) 'To <s>Yama</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.9) 'To <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.75.10) 'To <s>Kubera</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.76.1 agnáyé námáḥ
8.1.76.2 nírr̥taye námáḥ
8.1.76.3 vāyáve námáḥ
8.1.76.4 ī́śānāya námáḥ
8.1.76.5 subhadrā́ya námáḥ
8.1.76.6 hayātmakā́ya námáḥ
8.1.76.7 rā́ma-devāya námáḥ
8.1.76.8 puṇya-dévā́ya námáḥ
8.1.76.9 sarvā́ya námáḥ
8.1.76.10 sukhāvahā́ya námáḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.76.1) 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.2) 'To <s>Nirṛti</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.3) 'To <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.4) 'To <s>Īśāna</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.5) 'To <s>Subhadra</s> (the Auspicious One), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.6) 'To the one whose essence is the horse (<s>Hayātmaka</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.7) 'To the god <s>Rāma</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.8) 'To the meritorious god (<s>Puṇya-deva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.9) 'To the All (<s>Sarva</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.76.10) 'To the bringer of happiness (<s>Sukhāvaha</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.77.1 sáṃvahāya námáḥ
8.1.77.2 suvahā́ya námáḥ
8.1.77.3 śívaṃ prápadye
8.1.77.4 víśvaṃ prápadye
8.1.77.5 mítraṃ prápadye
8.1.77.6 átriṃ prápadye
8.1.77.7 sanat-kumā́raṃ prápadye
8.1.77.8 sanákaṃ prápadye
8.1.77.9 sánātanaṃ prápadye
8.1.77.10 sanáṃdánaṃ prápadye
children.translated_text: (8.1.77.1) 'To the one who conveys (<s>Saṃvaha</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.77.2) 'To the one who conveys well (<s>Suvaha</s>), <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.77.3) 'I take refuge in <s>Śiva</s>.' (8.1.77.4) 'I take refuge in the Universe (<s>Viśva</s>).' (8.1.77.5) 'I take refuge in <s>Mitra</s>.' (8.1.77.6) 'I take refuge in <s>Atri</s>.' (8.1.77.7) 'I take refuge in <s>Sanatkumāra</s>.' (8.1.77.8) 'I take refuge in <s>Sanaka</s>.' (8.1.77.9) 'I take refuge in <s>Sanātana</s>.' (8.1.77.10) 'I take refuge in <s>Sanandana</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.78.1[*823] indrā́ya námáḥ
8.1.78.2 yamā́ya námáḥ
8.1.78.3 váruṇāya námáḥ
8.1.78.4 kúberāya námáḥ
8.1.78.5 agnáye námáḥ
8.1.78.6 nírr̥taye námáḥ
8.1.78.7 vāyáve námáḥ
8.1.78.8 ī́śā́nāya námáḥ
8.1.78.9 páro mā́trayā
8.1.78.10 bŕ̥haspátir devā́nām
[*823] VMP omits numeral 78 for section 78.
children.translated_text: (8.1.78.1) 'To <s>Indra</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.2) 'To <s>Yama</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.3) 'To <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.4) 'To <s>Kubera</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.5) 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.6) 'To <s>Nirṛti</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.7) 'To <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.8) 'To <s>Īśāna</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>.' (8.1.78.9) 'Beyond measure...' (8.1.78.10) '<s>Bṛhaspati</s>, of the gods...'

children.text:
8.1.79.1 imé dhūpā́s surabhíno divyá-dhūpādhivā́sitāḥ
8.1.79.2 pūtā́ brahma-pavítreṇa pūtā́s sū́ryasya raśmíbhiḥ
8.1.79.3 víṣṇoḥ kármāṇi
8.1.79.4 śubhrā́ jyótiś ca devā́nāṃ tejáś ca satata-prabháḥ
prabhās-káró mahā-tejā dīpó 'yaṃ pratigŕ̥hyatām
8.1.79.5 trír deváḥ
8.1.79.6 índriyā́ṇi śata-krato trī́ṇi padā́ yóge-yoge śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.79.7 śúcī vo havyā́ḥ
8.1.79.8 varúṇam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.79.9 vā́rā́ham ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (8.1.79.1) 'These incenses, sweet-smelling, perfumed with divine fragrances,' (8.1.79.2) 'purified by the sacred filter of <s>Brahman</s>, purified by the rays of <s>Sūrya</s>.' (8.1.79.3) 'The deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' (8.1.79.4) 'Bright, the light of the gods, their radiance, ever-luminous — the light-maker, of great radiance — may this lamp be received.' (8.1.79.5) 'Thrice the god...' (8.1.79.6) 'The faculties... O lord of a hundred rites (<s>Śatakratu</s>)... three steps... in each union (<s>yoga</s>)... may the goddesses [bring us] bliss.' (8.1.79.7) 'Pure are your oblations...' (8.1.79.8) 'I invoke <s>Varuṇa</s>.' (8.1.79.9) 'I invoke <s>Vārāha</s> (the Boar-form).'

children.text:
8.1.80.1 nā́rásíṃham ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.80.2 vā́mánam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.80.3 trívíkrámam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.80.4 śríyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.80.5 lákṣmīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.80.6 sárásvátīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.80.7 bhávam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.80.8 víṣṇus tvā́(g)ṃ rakṣatu śubhrā́ jyótir yóge-yoge śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.80.9 óṃ námo bhágáváté vā́sudevāyá óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
children.translated_text: (8.1.80.1) 'I invoke <s>Nārasiṃha</s> (the Man-Lion).' (8.1.80.2) 'I invoke <s>Vāmana</s> (the Dwarf).' (8.1.80.3) 'I invoke <s>Trivikrama</s> (the Three-strider).' (8.1.80.4) 'I invoke <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity).' (8.1.80.5) 'I invoke <s>Lakṣmī</s>.' (8.1.80.6) 'I invoke <s>Sarasvatī</s>.' (8.1.80.7) 'I invoke <s>Bhava</s> (<s>Śiva</s>).' (8.1.80.8) 'May <s>Viṣṇu</s> protect you. Bright, the light... in each union (<s>yoga</s>)... may the goddesses [bring us] bliss.' (8.1.80.9) '<s>Oṃ</s>, obeisance to the Blessed Lord <s>Vāsudeva</s>. <s>Oṃ</s>, obeisance to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.81.1 devásya tvā
8.1.81.2 marútaḥ paramātmā́ páramā gatíḥ páraṃ bráhma páraṃ yógam
páramātmā́naṃ manye ajáraṃ yo 'gnir ahám annaṃ vāyáve
8.1.81.3 sóma(g)ṃ rā́jānam
8.1.81.4 marúto gaṇā́nāṃ prathamás saptádhānāṃ[*824] mūrdhā́ vāyo ányam ajárá(gg)ṃ śriyám
hótāraṃ vaí ráyan tvā́hur[*825] ágne havyáṃ marúdbhyaḥ
8.1.81.5 áśvo 'si háyo 'sy áto[*826] 'si náro 'sy árvāsi sáptir asi vājy ási vŕ̥ṣāsi nr̥máṇā asi yáyur nā́māsy ādityā́nāṃ pátvā́nvihi
8.1.81.6 áto devā́ agním īḷe iṣé tvorjé tvāgna ā́ yāhi śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.81.7 sóma(g)ṃ rā́jānam
8.1.81.8 ghr̥tā́t pári maṇḍa ivā́psu snehás sárvā́dhikas sarva-dhátteṣu śarváḥ
8.1.81.9 sá cetánáś cetáyate sva-śaktyā́
8.1.81.10 éko lokā́n gárbhavat pātu sárvān
8.1.81.11 ā́ vāta vāhi bheṣajáṃ ví vāta vāhi yád rápaḥ
tvá(g)ṃ hí viśvá-bheṣajo devā́nāṃ dūtá ī́yase
8.1.81.12 devásya tvā
8.1.81.13 óṃ námó bhágáváté vā́sudevāyá
8.1.81.14 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
[*824] 1984 edition: saptáthānāṃ
[*825] 1984 edition: vā́hur
[*826] 1946, 1984 editions: atyo corrected to ato. cf. VMP 8.1.19.3
children.translated_text: (8.1.81.1) 'Of the god...' (8.1.81.2) 'The <s>Maruts</s>... The Supreme Self is the supreme goal, the supreme <s>Brahman</s>, the supreme <s>Yoga</s>. I consider the Supreme Self to be ageless — he who is <s>Agni</s>, I am food, to <s>Vāyu</s>...' (8.1.81.3) 'King <s>Soma</s>...' (8.1.81.4) '<s>Marut</s>, first of the hosts, of the seven stores, the head... O <s>Vāyu</s>, the other, the ageless, the prosperity... They call the <s>Hotṛ</s> priest the wealth-giver indeed — O <s>Agni</s>, the oblation [is] for the <s>Maruts</s>.' (8.1.81.5) 'You are a horse (<s>aśva</s>), you are a steed (<s>haya</s>), you are [another] horse (<s>ata</s>), you are a man (<s>nara</s>), you are a racer (<s>arvan</s>), you are a swift one (<s>sapti</s>), you are a prize-winner (<s>vājin</s>), you are a bull (<s>vṛṣan</s>), you are delighting in men (<s>nṛmaṇas</s>), <s>Yayu</s> is your name — follow the path of the <s>Ādityas</s>.' (8.1.81.6) '<s>Ato devā</s>... I praise <s>Agni</s>... for food... for strength... O <s>Agni</s>, come... may the goddesses [bring us] bliss.' (8.1.81.7) 'King <s>Soma</s>...' (8.1.81.8) 'Like the cream from ghee, like the oil in waters — superior to all, <s>Śarva</s> in all supports.' (8.1.81.9) 'That conscious one awakens [all] by his own power.' (8.1.81.10) 'May the one [god] protect all worlds as if bearing them in the womb.' (8.1.81.11) 'O <s>Vāta</s> (Wind), blow forth the medicine; O <s>Vāta</s>, blow away whatever harm. For you are the universal medicine, you travel as the messenger of the gods.' (8.1.81.12) 'Of the god...' (8.1.81.13) '<s>Oṃ</s>, obeisance to the Blessed Lord <s>Vāsudeva</s>.' (8.1.81.14) '<s>Oṃ</s>, obeisance to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>.'

children.text: 8.0.7 súkrátuṃ bhágāya ca puṇyā́ya námó nā́ra-siṃhāya námáḥ kúberāya námás súkhā́vahā́ya námás sanáṃdánaṃ prápadye devānāṃ vā́rā́ham ā́vāhayāmi nā́rāyaṇāyá sárva-dhátteṣu śarvás saptá ca
children.translated_text: (8.0.7) [Rubric:] '...of good resolve, for fortune; to the Meritorious One, <s>namaḥ</s>; to <s>Narasiṃha</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>; to <s>Kubera</s>, <s>namaḥ</s>; to the bringer of happiness, <s>namaḥ</s>; I take refuge in <s>Sanandana</s>; of the gods; I invoke <s>Vārāha</s>; to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>; <s>Śarva</s> in all supports' — and seven [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.82.1 agním īḷe puróhitaṃ yajñásya devám r̥tvíjam
hótāraṃ ratna-dhā́tamam
8.1.82.2 yán mádhuno madhavyam
8.1.82.3 yóge-yoge śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.82.4 áthā́vánī́dám
8.1.82.5 ā́ mā vā́jásya citráṃ devā́nām ādítyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.82.6 bhā́s-káram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.82.7 sū́ryam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.82.8 vívásvántam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (8.1.82.1) 'I praise <s>Agni</s>, the priest placed foremost, the divine officiant (<s>ṛtvij</s>) of the sacrifice, the <s>Hotṛ</s>, the most bounteous bestower of treasures.' (8.1.82.2) 'That which is the sweetness of honey (<s>madhu</s>)...' (8.1.82.3) 'In each union (<s>yoga</s>)... may the goddesses [bring us] bliss.' (8.1.82.4) 'Then the [fire] was kindled here...' (8.1.82.5) 'Bring to me the brilliant prize of the gods... I invoke <s>Āditya</s>.' (8.1.82.6) 'I invoke <s>Bhāskara</s> (the Sun, the Light-maker).' (8.1.82.7) 'I invoke <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun).' (8.1.82.8) 'I invoke <s>Vivasvat</s> (the Shining One).'

children.text:
8.1.83.1 ā́dítyaṃ prápadye
8.1.83.2 bhā́s-káraṃ prápadye
8.1.83.3 sū́ryaṃ prápadye
8.1.83.4 mā́rtā́ṇḍaṃ prápadye
8.1.83.5 vívásvántaṃ prápadye
8.1.83.6 devásya tvā
8.1.83.7 amr̥topastáraṇam asi
8.1.83.8 nārā́yaṇā́ya
8.1.83.9 yát te susīmé hŕ̥dayaṃ diví candrámasi śritám
8.1.83.10 tásyā́mr̥tatvásyéśāno
8.1.83.11 mā́háṃ paútram ágha(g)ṃ rudam
children.translated_text: (8.1.83.1) 'I take refuge in <s>Āditya</s>.' (8.1.83.2) 'I take refuge in <s>Bhāskara</s> (the Light-maker).' (8.1.83.3) 'I take refuge in <s>Sūrya</s>.' (8.1.83.4) 'I take refuge in <s>Mārtāṇḍa</s> (the Sun, born from the lifeless [egg]).' (8.1.83.5) 'I take refuge in <s>Vivasvat</s> (the Shining One).' (8.1.83.6) 'Of the god...' (8.1.83.7) 'You are the immortal bed (<s>amṛtopasteraṇa</s>).' (8.1.83.8) 'To <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>...' (8.1.83.9) 'O lovely one, your heart is established in heaven, in the moon.' (8.1.83.10) 'Of that immortality he is the lord.' (8.1.83.11) 'May I not weep for a grandchild in misfortune.'

children.text:
8.1.84.1 veda te bhūmi hŕ̥dayaṃ diví candrámasi śritám
8.1.84.2 táthā́mr̥tatvásyéśāno
8.1.84.3 mā́háṃ paútram ághá(g)ṃ rudam
8.1.84.4 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
8.1.84.5 tát savitúr váreṇyam
ahám asmi prathama-jā́[*827]
8.1.84.6 tád asya priyám abhí pā́tho áśyāṃ náro yátra devayávo mádanti
urukramásya sá hí bándhur itthā́ víṣṇoḥ padé paramé mádhva úthsaḥ
8.1.84.7 subhū́s svayam-bhū́ḥ prathamáṃ[*828] mahaty arṇavé dadhé ha gárbham r̥tvíyam yáto jātáḥ prajā́-patiḥ
8.1.84.8 viśvá-bheṣaja(g)ṃ subheṣajám
8.1.48.9 yáthā sthíta idáṃ me viśvá-bheṣajám
[*827] TU 3.10.6; TB 2.8.8.1; TA 9.10.6.1 (VC p. 149)
[*828] VS: prathamo 'ntar
children.translated_text: (8.1.84.1) 'I know your heart, O Earth — established in heaven, in the moon.' (8.1.84.2) 'Thus of that immortality he is the lord.' (8.1.84.3) 'May I not weep for a grandchild in misfortune.' (8.1.84.4) '<s>Oṃ</s>, obeisance to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>.' (8.1.84.5) 'That excellent glory of <s>Savitṛ</s>... I am the first-born.' (8.1.84.6) 'May I attain that dear pathway of his — where the god-devoted men rejoice. The kinsman of the Wide-strider (<s>Urukrama</s>, i.e. <s>Viṣṇu</s>) is indeed thus — in the supreme step of <s>Viṣṇu</s> is the fountain of honey (<s>madhu</s>).' (8.1.84.7) 'The well-being, the self-existent one, in the beginning placed in the great ocean the embryo of due season, from whom <s>Prajāpati</s> was born.' (8.1.84.8) 'The universal medicine, the excellent medicine.' (8.1.84.9) 'As established, this is for me the universal medicine.'

children.text:
8.1.85.1 áśvinā prā́vátaṃ yuvám
idám ahá(g)ṃ sénāyā abhī́tvaryai
8.1.85.2 tváṃ júṣaja[*829] bheṣajáṃ vaiśvānarā́ya[*830] bheṣajám
átho asmábhyaṃ bheṣajá(g)ṃ súbheṣajam
8.1.85.3 idáṃ víṣṇur vícakrame yóge-yoge trir deváḥ
8.1.85.4 trī́ṇi padā́
8.1.85.5 sámāné vr̥kṣé púruṣo nimagnó ínīśatayā śócati múhyamānaḥ
júṣṭaṃ yádā́ paśyaty anyám īśáṃ tádā́bhīmā́nam éti[*831] vīta-śokáḥ
8.1.85.6 yóge-yoge śán no devī́r vícakrame pr̥thivī́
8.1.85.7 óṃ námó bhágáváté vā́sudevāyá
[*829] TS: táṃ juṣasva replaces tváṃ júṣaja
[*830] TS: gávé 'śvāya púruṣāya replaces vaiśvānarā́ya
[*831] ŚvetU, MuṇḍU: asya mahimānam iti replaces tádā́bhīmā́nam éti
children.translated_text: 8.1.85.1 'O <s>Aśvins</s>, protect, you two...' 'I [am] against the overpowering army...' 8.1.85.2 'You, [O <s>Agni</s>], take delight in the medicine, the medicine for <s>Vaiśvānara</s> — and also medicine for us, the best medicine.' 8.1.85.3 'This <s>Viṣṇu</s> strode forth — in every <s>yoga</s>, thrice the god...' 8.1.85.4 '...three steps.' 8.1.85.5 'On the same tree a person sits immersed, bewildered, grieving at his powerlessness; but when he sees the other, the Lord, beloved — then his sorrow departs and he goes beyond fear.' 8.1.85.6 'In every <s>yoga</s>; auspicious to us, O goddess; he strode forth; the earth...' 8.1.85.7 '<s>Oṃ</s>, homage to the Blessed <s>Vāsudeva</s>!' [Footnotes 829-831: Variant readings from TS, ŚvetU, and MuṇḍU.]

children.text:
8.1.86.1 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
8.1.86.2 bhū́ḥ prápadye áto devā́ sahásra-śīrṣā púruṣas sahasra-śī́rṣaṃ devám ékākṣaraṃ śubhrā́ jyótiḥ
8.1.86.3 upā́varoha jātavedaḥ púnas tváṃ devébhyo havyaṃ vaha naḥ prajānán
ā́yuḥ prajā́(g)ṃ rayím asmā́su dhehy ájasro dīdihi no duroṇé
8.1.86.4 táth savitúr váreṇyam
8.1.86.5 catvā́ri śŕ̥ṅgā tráyo asya pā́dā dvé śīrṣé saptá hástāso asyá
trī́dhā baddhó vŕ̥ṣabhó roravīti mahó devó mártyā́(g)ṃ ā́ viveśa
8.1.86.6 indrā́ya námáḥ
8.1.86.7 bráhmaṇe námáḥ
8.1.86.8 sómā́ya námáḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.86.1 '<s>Oṃ</s>, homage to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>!' 8.1.86.2 '<s>Bhūḥ</s>, I take refuge; thence may the gods...; the thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>; the thousand-headed god; the single syllable; the radiant light.' 8.1.86.3 'Descend again, O <s>Jātavedas</s>! Carry the oblation to the gods once more, knowing [our wish]; bestow upon us lifespan, offspring, and wealth; shine ceaselessly in our abode.' 8.1.86.4 'That of <s>Savitṛ</s>, the most excellent...' 8.1.86.5 'Four are his horns, three his feet, two his heads, seven his hands — bound threefold, the bull roars mightily; the great god has entered mortals.' 8.1.86.6 'To <s>Indra</s>, homage!' 8.1.86.7 'To <s>Brahman</s>, homage!' 8.1.86.8 'To <s>Soma</s>, homage!'

children.text:
8.1.87.1 yáthā ha tát
8.1.87.2 ádité ínumanyasva
8.1.87.3 áto devā́ idáṃ víṣṇus trī́ṇi padā́ víṣṇoḥ kármāṇi tád víṣṇoḥ paramáṃ tád víprāsaḥ
8.1.87.4 víṣṇave svā́hā
8.1.87.5 bhū́r bhúvas súvas svā́hā
8.1.87.6 agním īḷa iṣé tvorjé tvāgna ā́ yāhi śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.87.7 ádité ínvama(gg)ṃsthā́ḥ
8.1.87.8 bhū́tis mā́ te
8.1.87.9 ādityás sómo námaḥ
8.1.87.10 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
8.1.87.11 yát te agne
8.1.87.12 úd vayán támasaḥ
8.1.87.13 vaiśvānarásya rūpám
children.translated_text: 8.1.87.1 'As indeed that...' 8.1.87.2 'O <s>Aditi</s>, be gracious...' 8.1.87.3 'Thence may the gods...; this <s>Viṣṇu</s>...; three steps; the deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>; that supreme [abode] of <s>Viṣṇu</s>; that the inspired ones...' 8.1.87.4 'To <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' 8.1.87.5 '<s>Bhūr Bhuvas Suvaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' 8.1.87.6 'I praise <s>Agni</s>; for sap I [invoke] you, for vigor I [invoke] you; O <s>Agni</s>, come; auspicious to us, O goddesses...' 8.1.87.7 'O <s>Aditi</s>, may you approve...' 8.1.87.8 'May prosperity not [depart] from you...' 8.1.87.9 '<s>Āditya</s>; <s>Soma</s>; homage.' 8.1.87.10 'O waters, for you are the source of happiness...' 8.1.87.11 'Whatever of you, O <s>Agni</s>...' 8.1.87.12 'We rise from the darkness...' 8.1.87.13 'The form of <s>Vaiśvānara</s>...'

children.text: 8.0.8 vívásvántam ā́vāhayāmi paútram ágha(g)ṃ rudáṃ viśvá-bhéṣajáṃ vā́sudevāyá sómā́ya námó bhúvas trī́ṇi ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.8 [Catch-words:] '<s>Vivasvat</s>... I invoke; grandson; sin; weeping; the universal remedy; to <s>Vāsudeva</s>; to <s>Soma</s>, homage; <s>Bhuvaḥ</s>; three steps' — and [additional mantras].

children.text:
8.1.88.1 trír deváḥ
8.1.88.2 yóge-yoge śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.88.3 víśvān balí-rakṣita-sarva-devā́n
tásmād báli(g)ṃ rakṣatu bhū́taye
8.1.88.4 bálí-rákṣákam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.88.5 dánḍyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.88.6 sárvá-jñam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.88.7 sámam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.88.8 śatá-dhāra(g)ṃ hiraṇmáyam
8.1.88.9 gárúḍam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: 8.1.88.1 '...thrice the god.' 8.1.88.2 'In every <s>yoga</s>; auspicious to us, O goddesses...' 8.1.88.3 'All the gods who are protected by the offering — may the offering protect for prosperity.' 8.1.88.4 'I invoke the Protector of Offerings (<s>Bali-rakṣaka</s>).' 8.1.88.5 'I invoke the one worthy of punishment (<s>Daṇḍya</s>).' 8.1.88.6 'I invoke the Omniscient One (<s>Sarva-jña</s>).' 8.1.88.7 'I invoke the Impartial One (<s>Sama</s>).' 8.1.88.8 '...of hundred streams, golden...' 8.1.88.9 'I invoke <s>Garuḍa</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.89.1 rathantarám asi vāmadevyám asi br̥hád asi
8.1.89.2 áṅkaú nyaṅkā́v abhíto ráthaṃ yaú dhvāntáṃ vātāgrám ánu sañcárantau
dūré hetir indriyā́vān patatrī́ té no 'gnáyaḥ páprayaḥ pārayantu
8.1.89.3 ayáṃ vām aśvínau[*832] rátho mā́ duḥkhé mā́ sukhé riṣat
áriṣṭa svastí gacchatu vivighnán pŕ̥tanā yatáḥ
8.1.89.4 ihá dhŕ̥tir ihá vídhr̥tir ihá rántir ihá rámatiḥ
8.1.89.5 svastí no mimītām
8.1.89.6 yógéśam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.89.7 párá-bráhmā́ṇám ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.89.8 párámā́tmā́nam ā́vāhayāmi
[*832] ApMB: aśvínā
children.translated_text: 8.1.89.1 'You are the <s>Rathantara</s> [<s>sāman</s>]; you are the <s>Vāmadevya</s> [<s>sāman</s>]; you are the <s>Bṛhat</s> [<s>sāman</s>].' 8.1.89.2 'The two flankers, close on both sides of the chariot, pursuing the leading edge of the wind through the darkness — the far-hurled missile, the wing-borne possessor of <s>Indra</s>'s power; may those <s>Agnis</s> of ours convey us across.' 8.1.89.3 'This is your chariot, O <s>Aśvins</s> — may it not be harmed in sorrow nor in joy; may it go unharmed, safely, scattering the enemies in battle.' 8.1.89.4 'Here is steadfastness, here is support, here is delight, here is joy.' 8.1.89.5 'May [the gods] measure out well-being for us.' 8.1.89.6 'I invoke the Lord of <s>Yoga</s> (<s>Yogeśa</s>).' 8.1.89.7 'I invoke the Supreme <s>Brahman</s> (<s>Para-brahman</s>).' 8.1.89.8 'I invoke the Supreme Self (<s>Paramātman</s>).' [Footnote 832: ApMB reads aśvinā.]

children.text:
8.1.90.1 bháktá-vátsálam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.90.2 áto devā́ udyántaṃ vā́vā́dityáṃ devásya tvā viṣṇus tvā́(g)ṃ rakṣatu
8.1.90.3 sóma(g)ṃ rā́jānaṃ marútaḥ paramātmā́
8.1.90.4 vāyu-parī jala-śáyanī svayán-dhā́rā satyántho párimedínī
sopári dhattaṃgāya
8.1.90.5 maṇikā́ya námaḥ
8.1.90.6 sándhyāyai námaḥ
8.1.90.7 yé bhūtā́ḥ pracáranti dívā náktaṃ bálim icchánto vitúdasya préṣyāḥ
tébhyo balíṃ puṣṭi-kā́mo harāmi máyi púṣṭiṃ púṣṭi-patir dadhātu
8.1.90.8 víṣṇor nú kaṃ vīryāṇi sahásra-śīrṣā púruṣaḥ
8.1.90.9 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
8.1.90.10 óṃ námó bhágáváté vā́sudevāyá
8.1.90.11 sū́ryas tvā purástāt pātu kásyāś cid abhíśastyāḥ
8.1.90.12 úd vayáṃ támasaḥ
8.1.90.13 ihá púṣṭiṃ púṣṭi-patir dadhātv ihá prajā́ṃ ramayatu
8.1.90.14 prajā́-pataye puṣṭi-pátáye 'gni-patáye ráyi-pataye kā́māyānnā́dyāya
8.1.90.15 ágne náya supáthā[*833] rāyé asmā́n
[*833] Text: supádhā
children.translated_text: 8.1.90.1 'I invoke the One Dear to Devotees (<s>Bhakta-vatsala</s>).' 8.1.90.2 'Thence may the gods...; the rising <s>Āditya</s>...; of the god, may <s>Viṣṇu</s> protect you.' 8.1.90.3 '<s>Soma</s> the king; the <s>Maruts</s>; the <s>Paramātman</s>...' 8.1.90.4 'Encircled by wind, reclining on water, self-sustaining, truth-bounded, encompassing the earth — supporting above for [the cow].' 8.1.90.5 'To <s>Maṇika</s>, homage!' 8.1.90.6 'To <s>Sandhyā</s> (Twilight), homage!' 8.1.90.7 'Those beings who roam by day and night, seeking offerings, servants of the distributor — to them I present the offering, desiring prosperity; may the lord of prosperity bestow prosperity upon me.' 8.1.90.8 'The heroic deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>...; the thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>...' 8.1.90.9 '<s>Oṃ</s>, homage to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>!' 8.1.90.10 '<s>Oṃ</s>, homage to the Blessed <s>Vāsudeva</s>!' 8.1.90.11 'May the Sun protect you from the east, from every reviling.' 8.1.90.12 'We rise from the darkness...' 8.1.90.13 'Here may the Lord of Prosperity bestow prosperity; here may he delight [us with] offspring.' 8.1.90.14 'To <s>Prajāpati</s>, to the Lord of Prosperity, to the Lord of Fire, to the Lord of Wealth, for desire, for nourishment.' 8.1.90.15 'O <s>Agni</s>, lead us by the good path to prosperity.' [Footnote 833: Text reads supádhā.]

children.text: 8.0.9 gárúḍam ā́vāhayāmi paramātmānam ā́vāhayāmi púruṣas saptá cá
children.translated_text: 8.0.9 [Catch-words:] 'I invoke <s>Garuḍa</s>; I invoke the <s>Paramātman</s>; <s>Puruṣa</s>' — and seven [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.91.1 víṣṇor nú kaṃ vīryāṇi imā́s sumánasa imé gandhā́ imé dhūpā́ś śubhrā́ jyótiḥ
8.1.91.2 hiraṇya-garbhás sám avartatā́gre bhūtásya jātáḥ pátir éka āsīt
sá dādhāra pr̥thivī́ṃ dyā́m utémā́ṃ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.91.3 yé te śatám
8.1.91.4 idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
8.1.91.5 yóge-yoge
8.1.91.6 śáṃ no devī́r vícakrame
8.1.91.7 yám arpáyanti múnayo havír yó 'jó 'híjānír víbudhā virā́jann
táṃ mayi doṣā́ yásyānanāgnaú vípināni patantu
children.translated_text: 8.1.91.1 'The heroic deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>...; these auspicious [waters]; these fragrances; these incenses; the radiant light.' 8.1.91.2 '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> (the Golden Embryo) came into being at the beginning; born, he was the sole lord of created beings. He upheld the earth and this sky — to what god shall we offer our oblation?' 8.1.91.3 'Those hundred of yours...' 8.1.91.4 'This <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' 8.1.91.5 'In every <s>yoga</s>...' 8.1.91.6 'Auspicious to us, O goddesses; he strode forth...' 8.1.91.7 'He whom the sages offer to — the oblation-bearer, the unborn, the wise, the radiant — may the faults, whose fire is passionless, fall upon the forests in me.'

children.text:
8.1.92.1 śéṣam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.92.2 sáhásrá-śī́rṣam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.92.3 ánántam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.92.4 nā́gá-rā́jam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.92.5 yád vaiṣṇavá(g)ṃ śáyane śayānáṃ tát saha devaís saháŕ̥ṣibhiḥ
tát sarva-devā́ ánumanyatāṃ proktó vaiṣṇavo 'há(g)ṃ śáyitaṃ karomi
8.1.92.6 tá(g)ṃ śáyane devéśaṃ daítya-nāśāya tát sarva-devaír ánumanyatām
8.1.92.7 avíghnaṃ púṇya(g)ṃ sámpadyatāṃ tad bhagavā́n ánumanyatām
8.1.92.8 yád vaiṣṇavatvá(g)ṃ sámatā(g)ṃ samatváṃ vaiṣṇavo 'háṃ váhatāṃ vahāmi
8.1.92.9 víṣṇor aháṃ jíṣṇum aháḥ prápadye svā́hā svadhā́ vaí śírasā vahāmi
children.translated_text: 8.1.92.1 'I invoke <s>Śeṣa</s> (the Remainder).' 8.1.92.2 'I invoke the Thousand-headed One.' 8.1.92.3 'I invoke <s>Ananta</s> (the Infinite).' 8.1.92.4 'I invoke the King of Serpents (<s>Nāga-rāja</s>).' 8.1.92.5 'What <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> [image] is reclining on the couch — that, together with the gods, together with the sages: may all the gods approve of that. I, a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, as proclaimed, perform the reclining [ceremony].' 8.1.92.6 'That Lord of the Gods on the couch, for the destruction of the <s>Daityas</s> — may all the gods approve of that.' 8.1.92.7 'May it be accomplished without obstacle, with merit. May the Blessed One approve.' 8.1.92.8 'Whatever is <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>-ness, equanimity, equality — I, a <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, bear what is to be borne.' 8.1.92.9 'I, of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, take refuge in the victorious day. I bear <s>svāhā</s> and <s>svadhā</s> upon my head.'

children.text:
8.1.93.1 síndhoḥ pátiṃ váruṇaṃ mā́ vidantu víṣṇúṃ śayáné śāyayāmí
8.1.93.2 śriyé jātáḥ śriyáṃ śayáné śāyayāmí
8.1.93.3 medínī devī́ haríṇī́ṃ śayáné śāyayāmí
8.1.93.4 agním īḷa iṣé tvorjé tvāgna ā́ yāhi śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.93.5 iyáṃ jā́gratiḥ prathamáṃ práviśya devā́ bhavantu mánu-jā varéṇyaḥ
8.1.93.6 mahā́tmanné no hárate námas te
8.1.93.7 aghaugha-vidhváṃsam amúṃ kuruṣva
children.translated_text: 8.1.93.1 'May they know <s>Varuṇa</s>, the lord of the waters — I lay <s>Viṣṇu</s> upon the couch.' 8.1.93.2 'Born for <s>Śrī</s> (glory)... I lay <s>Śrī</s> upon the couch.' 8.1.93.3 '<s>Medinī</s> the goddess, the golden one... I lay her upon the couch.' 8.1.93.4 'I praise <s>Agni</s>; for sap I [invoke] you; for vigor I [invoke] you; O <s>Agni</s>, come; auspicious to us, O goddesses...' 8.1.93.5 'This waking state, entering first — may the gods become foremost among humans.' 8.1.93.6 'To the Great Self, he takes away; homage to you.' 8.1.93.7 'Destroy the flood of sins in that one.'

children.text:
8.1.94.1 bhū́r agnáye ca pr̥thivyaí ca mahaté ca námo bhúvo vāyáve cāntárikṣāya ca mahaté ca námas súvar ādityā́ya ca divé ca mahaté ca námo bhū́r bhúvas súvaś candrámase ca nákṣatrebhyaś ca digbhyáś ca mahaté ca námaḥ[*834]
8.1.94.2 yajñéna yajñám ayajanta devā́ḥ tā́ni dhármāṇi prathamā́ny āsan
té ha nā́kaṃ mahimā́nas sacante yátra pū́rve sādhyā́s sánti devā́ḥ
8.1.94.3 yáḥ prāṇató nimiṣató mahitvaíka íd rā́jā jágato babhū́va
yá ī́śe asyá dvi-pádaś cátuṣ-padaḥ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.94.4 śukrán tvā śukrā́yāṃ dhā́mne-dhāmne devébhyo yájuṣe-yajuṣe gr̥hṇāmi
jyótis tvā jyótiṣy arcís tvārcíṣi dhā́mne-dhāmne devébhyo yájuṣe-yajuṣe gr̥hṇāmi
8.1.94.5 námo bráhmaṇe námo astv agnáye námaḥ pr̥thivyaí náma óṣadhībhyaḥ
námo vācé námo vācás-pátaye námo víṣṇave br̥haté karomi
[*834] TA, MahānU give svāhā in place of namaḥ in this verse. cf. VMP 6.11.7
children.translated_text: 8.1.94.1 '<s>Bhūḥ</s> — to <s>Agni</s>, to the Earth, and to the Great One, homage! <s>Bhuvaḥ</s> — to <s>Vāyu</s>, to the Atmosphere, and to the Great One, homage! <s>Suvaḥ</s> — to <s>Āditya</s>, to Heaven, and to the Great One, homage! <s>Bhūr Bhuvas Suvaḥ</s> — to the Moon, to the Stars, to the Directions, and to the Great One, homage!' 8.1.94.2 'By sacrifice the gods sacrificed to the sacrifice — those were the first ordinances. Those mighty ones attain the firmament, where dwell the ancient <s>Sādhyas</s> and the gods.' 8.1.94.3 'He who by his greatness alone has become the sole king of the breathing and blinking world — who is lord of this two-footed and four-footed [creation]: to what god shall we offer our oblation?' 8.1.94.4 'The bright one, in the bright station, station by station, for the gods, formula by formula, I take hold of; the light, in the light, the flame in the flame, station by station, for the gods, formula by formula, I take hold of.' 8.1.94.5 'Homage to <s>Brahman</s>! Homage to <s>Agni</s>! Homage to the Earth! Homage to the herbs! Homage to Speech! Homage to the Lord of Speech! Homage to <s>Viṣṇu</s> — the great one, I perform.' [Footnote 834: TA and MahānU give svāhā in place of namaḥ; cf. VMP 6.11.7.]

children.text:
8.1.95.1 ā́ tvāhārṣam antár abhūḥ
8.1.95.2 óṃ árcitas súṣṭutaś cāpi suparṇá-garuḍa-dhvájá
cakra-pāṇé mahā-bāho yathéṣṭaṃ vasa óṃ námaḥ
8.1.95.3 sahásra-śīrṣā púruṣaḥ
8.1.95.4 víṣṇor nú kaṃ vīryāṇi
8.1.95.5 sahasra-śī́rṣaṃ devám
8.1.95.6 nārāyaṇā́ya
8.1.95.7 áto devā́
8.1.95.8 óṃ námó nā́rāyaṇāyá
8.1.95.9 óṃ námó bhágáváté vā́sudevāyá
8.1.95.10 sū́ryas tvā purástāt pātu kásyāś cid abhíśastyāḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.95.1) I have brought you; you have become [established] within. (8.1.95.2) <s>Oṃ</s> — worshiped and well-praised, O you whose banner is <s>Suparṇa-Garuḍa</s>, O <s>Cakrapāṇi</s> (discus-handed), O mighty-armed one — dwell as you please, <s>Oṃ namaḥ</s>! (8.1.95.3) 'The thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>...' (8.1.95.4) 'The heroic deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' (8.1.95.5) 'The thousand-headed god...' (8.1.95.6) 'To <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>...' (8.1.95.7) 'Henceforth the gods...' (8.1.95.8) <s>Oṃ</s>, obeisance to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>! (8.1.95.9) <s>Oṃ</s>, obeisance to the <s>Bhagavān Vāsudeva</s>! (8.1.95.10) 'May the Sun protect you from the front, from any curse...'

children.text: 8.0.10 vípināni patantu śírasā vahāmy amúṃ kuruṣva bŕ̥haté karomi vā́sudevāyaíkañ ca
children.translated_text: (8.0.10) [Catch-words:] '...may the forests fall...' '...I carry on [my] head...' '...to that one, do...' '...to the great, I perform...' '...to <s>Vāsudeva</s>...' — and one.

children.text:
8.1.96.1 āśāsu saptásu
8.1.96.2 sóma(g)ṃ rā́jānam
8.1.96.3 sv-āsa-stháṃ devébhyaḥ
8.1.96.4 tátth savitúḥ
8.1.96.5 sumitrā́ na ā́pa óṣadhayas santu durmitrā́s tásmai bhūyāsur yo 'smān dveṣṭi yáñ ca vayáṃ dviṣmáḥ
8.1.96.6 híraṇya-pāṇim ūtáye savitā́ram úpa hvaye
sá céttā devátā padám
8.1.96.7 devásya tvā
8.1.96.8 óṃ bhū́r bhúvas súvaḥ
8.1.96.9 índraṃ náro nemádhitā havante yát pā́ryā yunájate dhíyas tā́ḥ
śū́ro nŕ̥-ṣātā śávasaś cakāná ā́ gó-mati vrajé bhajā tváṃ naḥ[*835]
[*835] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 97. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 96.
children.translated_text: (8.1.96.1) 'In the seven directions...' (8.1.96.2) '<s>Soma</s> the king...' (8.1.96.3) 'Well-established in his seat, to the gods...' (8.1.96.4) 'That [glory] of <s>Savitṛ</s>...' [<s>Gāyatrī</s> incipit]. (8.1.96.5) May the waters and herbs be friendly to us; may they be hostile to him who hates us and whom we hate. (8.1.96.6) I call upon golden-handed <s>Savitṛ</s> for aid — he is the perceiver, the god, [whose] station [is supreme]. (8.1.96.7) 'Of the god, you...' (8.1.96.8) <s>Oṃ Bhūḥ Bhuvaḥ Suvaḥ</s>! (8.1.96.9) Men invoke <s>Indra</s>, the unerring one, when they yoke those thoughts for the occasion — the hero, the winner of men, desirous of might — share us in the cow-rich enclosure! [Editorial note: VMP divides this verse at the chapter break.]

children.text:
8.1.97.1 iṣé tvorjé tvā
8.1.97.2 śúcī vo havyā́ imé dhūpā́ḥ
8.1.97.3 dhārāsu saptasú
8.1.97.4 idám ā́paś śivā́ḥ
8.1.97.5 ápa undantu jīváse
8.1.97.6 ā́po vā́ idá(g)ṃ sárvam
8.1.97.7 dhārāsu saptasu
8.1.97.8 úd u tyáṃ citrám
8.1.97.9 índrā-viṣṇū havíṣā vāvŕ̥dhānā́grādhvānā námasā rātahavyā
ghŕ̥tāsutī dráviṇaṃ dhattam asmé samudrá-sthaḥ kaláśas soma-dhā́naḥ[*836]
[*836] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 98. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 97.
children.translated_text: (8.1.97.1) 'For nourishment [I yoke] you, for vigor [I yoke] you...' (8.1.97.2) 'Pure are these offerings of yours, these incenses...' (8.1.97.3) 'In the seven streams...' (8.1.97.4) 'These waters, auspicious...' (8.1.97.5) 'May the waters flow for life...' (8.1.97.6) 'Waters are indeed this all...' (8.1.97.7) 'In the seven streams...' (8.1.97.8) 'Rising up, that wondrous one...' [Sun hymn incipit]. (8.1.97.9) <s>Indra</s> and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, strengthened by the oblation, foremost on the path, [honoured] with homage, to whom offerings are given — anointed with <s>ghṛta</s> (clarified butter), bestow wealth upon us; the ocean-dwelling pot, the vessel of <s>Soma</s>. [Editorial note: VMP divides this verse at the chapter break.]

children.text:
8.1.98.1 śukrán te anyád yajatam te anyád víṣu-rūpe áhanī dyaúr ivāsi
víśvā hí māyā́ ávasi svádhā́vó bhadrā́ te pū́ṣann ihá rātír astu
8.1.98.2 sóma óṣadhīnāṃ váruṇo bŕ̥haspátiḥ
8.1.98.3 prájā-pate ná tvád etā́ni...[*837]
8.1.98.4 anyé devā́ nī́radāḥ
8.1.98.5 śa(g)ṃ sā́ ni[yacchaty] námas sulomá sá éko 'bhū́d devásya tvā
8.1.98.6 áto devā́ kṣmā́m ekā́n tán mā yaśo 'gré brahmā́ devā́nām
8.1.98.7 idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
8.1.98.8 śukrám asi jyótir asi téjo 'si devó vas savitótpunātv ácchidreṇa pavítreṇa vásos sū́ryasya raśmíbhiś
śukrán tvā śukrā́yāṃ dhā́mne-dhāmne devébhyo yájuṣe-yajuṣe gr̥hṇāmi jyótis tvā jyótiṣy arcís tvārcíṣi dhā́mne-dhāmne devébhyo yájuṣe-yajuṣe grhṇāmi
[*837] Text: etā́n corrected to etā́ni
children.translated_text: (8.1.98.1) Bright is your one [form], worshipful is your other — of different forms like the two halves of a day, you are like the sky; for you, O self-powered one, sustain all wondrous powers — O <s>Pūṣan</s>, may your gift here be auspicious! (8.1.98.2) '<s>Soma</s>, [lord] of herbs; <s>Varuṇa</s>; <s>Br̥haspati</s>...' (8.1.98.3) 'O <s>Prajāpati</s>, none other than you, these...' (8.1.98.4) 'The other gods, the rainless ones...' (8.1.98.5) [Incipits:] 'Auspiciousness, she controls...' 'Obeisance, O fair-haired one...' 'He, the one, became...' 'Of the god, you...' (8.1.98.6) [Incipits:] 'Henceforth the gods...' 'The one earth...' 'May that glory for me, at the forefront...' '<s>Brahmā</s>, of the gods...' (8.1.98.7) 'This <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' (8.1.98.8) You are the bright, you are the light, you are the splendor — may the god <s>Savitṛ</s> purify you with an unbroken filter, with the rays of <s>Sūrya</s> of the <s>Vasus</s>; I take you, the bright, for each station, for the gods, for each sacrificial formula — the light for the light, the flame for the flame, for each station, for the gods, for each sacrificial formula, I take you.

children.text:
8.1.99.1 dadhíkrā́vṇo[*838] akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇór áśvasya vājínaḥ
surabhí no múkhā karat prá ṇa ā́yū(g)ṃṣi tāriṣat
8.1.99.2 ā́ pyāyasva sám etu té viśvátas soma vŕ̥ṣṇiyam[*839]
bhávā vā́jasya saṅgathé[*840]
8.1.99.3 gandha-dvārā́n durādharṣāṃ nityá-puṣṭāṃ karī́ṣiṇīm
īśvarī́(g)ṃ sárva-bhūtānāṃ tā́m ihópa hvaye śríyám
8.1.99.4 táth savitúr váreṇyam
8.1.99.5 try-ambakam
8.1.99.6 svā́diṣṭhayā mádíṣṭhayā pávasva soma dhā́rayā
índrāya pā́tave sutáḥ
[*838] Text: dadhikrāvṇṇo
[*839] VMP has metrical i.
[*840] Text: saṅgadhé
children.translated_text: (8.1.99.1) I have praised <s>Dadhikrāvan</s> (the swift horse), the victorious, the prize-winning steed — may he make our mouths fragrant; may he extend our lifespans. (8.1.99.2) Swell up, O <s>Soma</s>, may virile strength come to you from every side — be at the gathering of the prize! (8.1.99.3) Her whose gateway is fragrance, unassailable, ever-nourished, rich in cattle-dung [i.e., prosperity] — the sovereign of all beings — that <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity) I invoke here. (8.1.99.4) 'That [glory] of <s>Savitṛ</s>...' [<s>Gāyatrī</s> incipit]. (8.1.99.5) '<s>Tryambaka</s>...' [<s>Mṛtyuñjaya</s> mantra incipit]. (8.1.99.6) Purify yourself, O <s>Soma</s>, with the sweetest, most intoxicating stream — pressed for <s>Indra</s> to drink.

children.text:
8.1.100.1 ghr̥tá-pratīko ghr̥tá-yonir agnír ghr̥taís sámiddho ghr̥tám asyā́nnam
ghr̥ta-pŕ̥ṣas tvā saríto vahanti ghr̥táṃ píbanth suyájā yakṣi devā́n
8.1.100.2 yán mádhuno madhavyam paramám annā́d yaṃ vīryam
ténāháṃ mádhuno madhavyena paraméṇānnā́dyena vīryeṇa paramo 'nnādó madhavyo 'sāni
8.1.100.3 dadhikrā́vṇaḥ[*841]
8.1.100.4 śáṃ no devī́r ā́ pyāyasva
8.1.100.5 gandha-dvārā́m imā́ óṣadhayaḥ
8.1.100.6 sóma(g)ṃ rā́jānam
8.1.100.7 yátas[*842] svám ā́sīd áto devā́
8.1.100.8 brahmā́ devā́nām
[*841] Text: dadhikrā́vṇṇaḥ
[*842] Text: yáta
children.translated_text: (8.1.100.1) <s>Agni</s>, whose face is <s>ghṛta</s> (clarified butter), whose source is <s>ghṛta</s> — kindled with <s>ghṛta</s>, whose food is <s>ghṛta</s>; rivers of drops of <s>ghṛta</s> carry you — drinking <s>ghṛta</s>, O well-sacrificing one, worship the gods! (8.1.100.2) Whatever is the supreme sweetness of honey, whatever is the supreme vigor of food — by that supreme sweetness of honey, by that supreme vigor of food, may I become the supreme food-eater, sweet as honey. (8.1.100.3) '[I praise] <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>...' (8.1.100.4) 'May the divine [waters be] auspicious to us; swell up...' (8.1.100.5) 'Her whose gateway is fragrance...' 'These herbs...' (8.1.100.6) '<s>Soma</s> the king...' (8.1.100.7) 'Whence his own [form] was...' 'Henceforth the gods...' (8.1.100.8) '<s>Brahmā</s>, of the gods...'

children.text:
8.1.101.1 citrán devā́nām imā́s sumánasaḥ
8.1.101.2 vándyo[*843] na eṣá vasúṣu nidadhyā́t
tri-dhā́ tri-dhāmā́ bíbhr̥yād adīnā́n
8.1.101.3 yé te śatáṃ vā́rīś cátasraḥ
8.1.101.4 rúdram anyáṃ sínīvālīmé gandhā́ḥ
8.1.101.5 tát-púruṣāya vidmáhe mahā-devā́ya dhīmahi
tán no rudraḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.101.6 nārāyaṇā́ya
8.1.101.7 óṃ jáyām ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.101.8 índráṃ práṇayantam
[*843] 1984 edition: vándhyo
children.translated_text: (8.1.101.1) 'The wondrous one of the gods...' 'These fair-minded ones...' (8.1.101.2) 'He who is to be praised — may he bestow among the <s>Vasus</s>; of three stations, threefold, may he bear the unafflicted.' (8.1.101.3) 'Those hundred of yours...' 'Four waters...' (8.1.101.4) '<s>Rudra</s>...' 'Another...' '<s>Sinīvālī</s>...' 'These fragrances...' (8.1.101.5) We know the <s>Tat-Puruṣa</s> (Supreme Person); we meditate upon <s>Mahādeva</s> (the Great God) — may that <s>Rudra</s> inspire us [<s>Rudra Gāyatrī</s>]. (8.1.101.6) 'To <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>...' (8.1.101.7) <s>Oṃ</s>, I invoke <s>Jayā</s> (Victory). (8.1.101.8) '<s>Indra</s>, the leader...'

children.text:
8.1.102.1 ŕ̥co yájū́(g)ṃṣi praíṣām adhīśáś śatá-dhāra(g)ṃ hiraṇmáyam
8.1.102.2 kánikradaj januṣam
8.1.102.3 páraṃ raṃha ā́sthāsye
8.1.102.4 óṃ súvar bhúvar bhū́ḥ
8.1.102.5 trī́ṇi padā́ śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.102.6 kr̥ṇuṣvá pā́jas svastí-dā viśás-pátiḥ
8.1.102.7 védāhám etáṃ yád vaiṣṇavá(g)ṃ śáyane śayānám
8.1.102.8 agním īḷe iṣé tvorjé tvāgna ā́ yāhi śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.102.9 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
8.1.102.10 híraṇya-varṇāḥ pávamānas súvar-jánaḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.102.1) 'The <s>Ṛcas</s> (verses), the <s>Yajus</s> (formulas)...' 'The lord of commands...' 'The hundred-streamed, golden...' (8.1.102.2) 'Neighing at [his] birth...' (8.1.102.3) 'I shall mount the supreme speed...' (8.1.102.4) <s>Oṃ Suvaḥ Bhuvaḥ Bhūḥ</s>! [reverse order]. (8.1.102.5) 'Three steps...' 'May the divine [waters be] auspicious to us...' (8.1.102.6) 'Make protection; the bestower of well-being, the lord of the people...' (8.1.102.7) 'I know this one...' 'That which is of <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> [nature], reclining on his couch...' (8.1.102.8) 'I praise <s>Agni</s>...' 'For nourishment [I yoke] you, for vigor...' 'O <s>Agni</s>, come...' 'May the divine [waters be] auspicious to us...' (8.1.102.9) 'For you, O waters, are the source of happiness...' (8.1.102.10) 'Golden-hued...' 'The purifier, the heaven-born...'

children.text:
8.1.103.1 bhū́mir bhūmnā́
8.1.103.2 óṃ bhū́mim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.3 úrvīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.4 dháráṇīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.5 rátná-gárbhām ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.6 háríṇīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.7 paúṣṇīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.8 kṣóṇīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.9 máhīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.103.10 ágne náya supáthā rāyé ásmā́n
children.translated_text: (8.1.103.1) 'The earth, with [its] vastness...' (8.1.103.2) <s>Oṃ</s>, I invoke the earth (<s>Bhūmi</s>). (8.1.103.3) I invoke the broad one (<s>Urvī</s>). (8.1.103.4) I invoke the bearer (<s>Dharaṇī</s>). (8.1.103.5) I invoke her whose womb contains jewels (<s>Ratnagarbhā</s>). (8.1.103.6) I invoke the green one (<s>Hariṇī</s>). (8.1.103.7) I invoke the nourishing one (<s>Pauṣṇī</s>). (8.1.103.8) I invoke the ground (<s>Kṣoṇī</s>). (8.1.103.9) I invoke the great one (<s>Mahī</s>). (8.1.103.10) 'O <s>Agni</s>, lead us by the good path to prosperity...'

children.text:
8.1.104.1 ágnim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.2 jā́tá-védásam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.3 sáhójásam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.4 ájírā́-prábham ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.5 vaíśvā́ṇáram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.6 náryā́pásam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.7 páṅktí-rā́dhásam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.8 vísárpíṇam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.104.9 marútaḥ paramātmā́
8.1.104.10 vā́yum ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (8.1.104.1) I invoke <s>Agni</s>. (8.1.104.2) I invoke <s>Jātavedas</s> (the Knower of Births). (8.1.104.3) I invoke the one of conquering strength (<s>Sahojas</s>). (8.1.104.4) I invoke the one of swift radiance (<s>Ajīraprabha</s>). (8.1.104.5) I invoke <s>Vaiśvānara</s> (the Universal Fire). (8.1.104.6) I invoke the one of manly deeds (<s>Naryāpas</s>). (8.1.104.7) I invoke the one of fivefold bounty (<s>Paṅktirādhas</s>). (8.1.104.8) I invoke the spreading one (<s>Visarpin</s>). (8.1.104.9) 'The <s>Maruts</s>, the <s>Paramātman</s>...' (8.1.104.10) I invoke <s>Vāyu</s> (the Wind).

children.text:
8.1.105.1 jávánam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.105.2 bhū́tā́tmákam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.105.3 údā́nam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.105.4 śatá-dhāra(g)ṃ hiraṇmáyam
8.1.105.5 tā́rkṣyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.105.6 pákṣí-rū́pam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.105.7 súpárṇam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.105.8 áṅkúrā́dhípam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.105.9 índraṃ práṇayantam
8.1.105.10 índram ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (8.1.105.1) I invoke the swift one (<s>Javana</s>). (8.1.105.2) I invoke the one whose nature is the elements (<s>Bhūtātmaka</s>). (8.1.105.3) I invoke the upward breath (<s>Udāna</s>). (8.1.105.4) 'The hundred-streamed, golden...' (8.1.105.5) I invoke <s>Tārkṣya</s> [<s>Garuḍa</s>]. (8.1.105.6) I invoke the one of bird-form (<s>Pakṣirūpa</s>). (8.1.105.7) I invoke <s>Suparṇa</s> (the Fair-Winged). (8.1.105.8) I invoke the lord of sprouts (<s>Aṅkurādhipa</s>). (8.1.105.9) '<s>Indra</s>, the leader...' (8.1.105.10) I invoke <s>Indra</s>.

children.text:
8.1.106.1 śácī́-pátim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.2 púrú-hū́tam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.3 púrán-dáram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.4 hárí-háyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.5 vájrá-pā́ṇim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.6 áryámṇam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.7 trí-lókā́dhípam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.8 rúdram anyám
8.1.106.9 páñcá-gávyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.106.10 śívam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (8.1.106.1) I invoke the husband of <s>Śacī</s> (<s>Śacīpati</s>). (8.1.106.2) I invoke the much-invoked one (<s>Puruhūta</s>). (8.1.106.3) I invoke the destroyer of cities (<s>Purandara</s>). (8.1.106.4) I invoke the one with bay horses (<s>Harihaya</s>). (8.1.106.5) I invoke the thunderbolt-handed one (<s>Vajrapāṇi</s>). (8.1.106.6) I invoke <s>Aryaman</s>. (8.1.106.7) I invoke the lord of the three worlds (<s>Trilokādhipa</s>). (8.1.106.8) '<s>Rudra</s>, the other...' (8.1.106.9) I invoke the five cow-products (<s>Pañcagavya</s>). (8.1.106.10) I invoke <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text:
8.1.107.1 ī́śam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.107.2 ávyáktam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.107.3 víśve devāś śr̥ṇutémá(g)ṃ hávaṃ me yé antárikṣe yá úpa dyávi ṣṭhá
yé agni-jihvā́ utá vā yájatrā āsádyāsmín barhíṣi mādayadhvam
8.1.107.4 víśvā́n dévān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.107.5 sárvā́n dévān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.107.6 víśvá-pútrān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.107.7 dhármá-sū́núkān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.107.8 ágna ā́ yāhi
8.1.107.9 ghŕ̥tam ā́vāhayāmi
