children.translated_text: (8.1.107.1) I invoke <s>Īśa</s> (the Lord). (8.1.107.2) I invoke the unmanifest (<s>Avyakta</s>). (8.1.107.3) O <s>Viśvedevas</s> (All-Gods), hear this call of mine — you who are in the atmosphere, you who stand in heaven, you who have tongues of <s>Agni</s> and are worthy of worship — seat yourselves on this sacred grass and rejoice! (8.1.107.4) I invoke all the gods (<s>Viśvān Devān</s>). (8.1.107.5) I invoke all the gods (<s>Sarvān Devān</s>). (8.1.107.6) I invoke the sons of all (<s>Viśvaputrān</s>). (8.1.107.7) I invoke the sons of <s>Dharma</s> (<s>Dharmasūnukān</s>). (8.1.107.8) 'O <s>Agni</s>, come...' (8.1.107.9) I invoke the <s>ghṛta</s> (clarified butter).

children.text:
8.1.108.1 sā́má-védam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.108.2 vájram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.108.3 yájñam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.108.4 saṃvathsaro 'si parivathsaro 'sīdāvathsaro 'sīduvathsaro 'si
idvathsaro 'si vathsáro 'si tásya te vasantáś śíraḥ
8.1.108.5 váthsárān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.108.6 vású-sútān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.108.7 nídhīn ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.108.8 dhármá-sū́núkān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.108.9 agním īḷe
children.translated_text:
I invoke the <s>Sāma Veda</s>!
I invoke the <s>Vajra</s> (thunderbolt)!
I invoke the <s>Yajña</s> (sacrifice)!
You are the <s>saṃvatsara</s> (year), you are the <s>parivatsara</s>, you are the <s>idāvatsara</s>, you are the <s>iduvatsara</s>,
you are the <s>idvatsara</s>, you are the <s>vatsara</s> — <s>Vasanta</s> (Spring) is your head.
I invoke the Years (<s>vatsaras</s>)!
I invoke the sons of the <s>Vasus</s>!
I invoke the Treasures (<s>nidhis</s>)!
I invoke the sons of <s>Dharma</s> (Righteousness)!
I praise <s>Agni</s> —

children.text:
8.1.109.1 mádhu ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.2 ŕ̥g-védam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.3 sómam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.4 krátum ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.5 marútaḥ paramātmā́
8.1.109.6 prā́ṇam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.7 ápā́nam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.8 vyā́nam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.9 údā́nam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.109.10 sámā́nam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text:
I invoke <s>Madhu</s> (Honey/Spring)!
I invoke the <s>Ṛg Veda</s>!
I invoke <s>Soma</s>!
I invoke <s>Kratu</s> (Resolve/Sacrifice)!
The <s>Maruts</s> [are] the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self).
I invoke <s>Prāṇa</s> (the outward breath)!
I invoke <s>Apāna</s> (the downward breath)!
I invoke <s>Vyāna</s> (the diffused breath)!
I invoke <s>Udāna</s> (the upward breath)!
I invoke <s>Samāna</s> (the equalizing breath)!

children.text:
8.1.110.1 iṣé tvorjé tvā
8.1.110.2 dádhi ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.110.3 yájúr-védam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.110.4 íṣṭam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.110.5 míśram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.110.6 try-ambakaṃ yajāmahe
8.1.110.7 ī́śā́nam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.110.8 kápā́línam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.110.9 bhávam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.110.10 súhā́-dévam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text:
For food [I take] you, for vigor [I take] you!
I invoke <s>Dadhi</s> (Curds)!
I invoke the <s>Yajur Veda</s>!
I invoke the <s>Iṣṭa</s> (the Desired/Offering)!
I invoke the <s>Miśra</s> (the Mixed)!
We worship the three-eyed one (<s>Tryambaka</s>) —
I invoke <s>Īśāna</s> (the Ruler, Śiva)!
I invoke <s>Kapālin</s> (the Skull-bearer, Śiva)!
I invoke <s>Bhava</s> (Existence, Śiva)!
I invoke <s>Suhā-deva</s> (the God of Good Offerings)!

children.text:
8.1.111.1 śáṃ no devī́ḥ kṣī́ram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.111.2 áthárvá-védam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.111.3 pavítram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.111.4 púṇyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.111.5 tád aśvínāv aśva-yújópayātāṃ śubhaṃ gámiṣṭhau suyámebhir áśvaiḥ
sváṃ nákṣatra(g)ṃ havíṣā yájantau madhvā sáṃpr̥ktau yájuṣā sámaktau
8.1.111.6 aśvínāv ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.111.7 márútā́v ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.111.8 yúgmám ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text:
May the goddesses be auspicious to us — I invoke <s>Kṣīra</s> (Milk)!
I invoke the <s>Atharva Veda</s>!
I invoke the Pure (<s>Pavitra</s>)!
I invoke the Meritorious (<s>Puṇya</s>)!
May the two <s>Aśvins</s>, yoked with horses, come near, the best goers with well-controlled steeds,
worshipping their own <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar asterism) with oblation, anointed with honey, joined with the <s>Yajus</s> formula.
I invoke the <s>Aśvins</s> (the Divine Twin Physicians)!
I invoke the <s>Maruts</s> (Storm-gods)!
I invoke the Pair (<s>Yugma</s>)!

children.text:
8.1.112.1 tvā́ṣṭrá[*844]-pútrāv ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.112.2 vasanténartúnā devā́ḥ vásavas tri-vŕ̥tā stutám
rathantaréṇa téjásā havír índre váyo dadhuḥ[*845]
8.1.112.3 śáḍ ŕ̥tūn ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.112.4 sáhá-rā́śīn ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.112.5 gándhān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.112.6 tī́rthān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.112.7 ā́ vāyo bhūṣa śucipā úpa nas sahásran te niyúto viśva-vāra
úpo te ándho[*846] mádyam ayāmi yásya deva dadhiṣé pūrva-péyam
[*844] 1946 edition: tvā́ṣṭrī́
[*845] Text: dathuḥ
[*846] Text: ántho
children.translated_text:
I invoke the two sons of <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> (the Celestial Craftsman)!
In the season of <s>Vasanta</s> (Spring), the <s>Vasu</s> gods, with the <s>Trivṛt</s> (threefold) <s>stoma</s> (hymn of praise),
with the <s>Rathantara</s> <s>sāman</s>, with splendor, placed the oblation and vigor in <s>Indra</s>.
I invoke the six <s>Ṛtus</s> (Seasons)!
I invoke the <s>Rāśis</s> (Zodiacal Signs) together!
I invoke the Fragrances (<s>Gandhas</s>)!
I invoke the Sacred Fords (<s>Tīrthas</s>)!
O <s>Vāyu</s>, come, drink of the pure [offering], approach us — yours are a thousand teams of horses, O one of universal bounty;
the pressed [<s>Soma</s>] drink comes to you, the intoxicating one — O god, to you belongs the first draught.

children.text:
8.1.113.1 marútān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.2 lóká-dhárān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.3 sáptá-sáptá-gáṇān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.4 márúdvátī́-sútān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.5 prajā́-patiṃ prathamáṃ yajñíyānām
8.1.113.6 ákṣátān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.7 kā́śyapam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.8 ánántam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.9 víśvá-mū́rtim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.113.10 bŕ̥haspate áti yát
children.translated_text:
I invoke the <s>Maruts</s> (Storm-gods)!
I invoke the World-supporters (<s>Loka-dharas</s>)!
I invoke the seven groups of seven!
I invoke the sons of <s>Marudvatī</s>!
<s>Prajāpati</s> (Lord of Creatures), the first among the sacrificial ones —
I invoke the Unbroken Grains (<s>Akṣatas</s>)!
I invoke <s>Kāśyapa</s>!
I invoke <s>Ananta</s> (the Infinite, Śeṣa)!
I invoke <s>Viśva-mūrti</s> (the Universal Form)!
O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, that which —

children.text:
8.1.114.1 bŕ̥háspátim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.2 pī́tá-várṇam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.3 gúrum ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.4 taíṣyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.5 sómo dhenúm phálódákam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.6 sómam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.7 púṇyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.8 ámítam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.114.9 śáṃ no nídhattām
children.translated_text:
I invoke <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter, the Lord of Sacred Speech)!
I invoke the Yellow-colored One (<s>Pīta-varṇa</s>)!
I invoke the <s>Guru</s> (the Preceptor)!
I invoke <s>Taiṣya</s> (the one associated with the Tiṣya/Puṣya asterism)!
<s>Soma</s>, the cow, with fruit and water — I invoke!
I invoke <s>Soma</s>!
I invoke the Meritorious (<s>Puṇya</s>)!
I invoke the Immeasurable (<s>Amita</s>)!
May he place auspiciousness for us —

children.text:
8.1.115.1 nā́gá-rā́jam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.2 sáhásrá-śī́rṣam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.3 ánántam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.4 vā́súkim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.5 yátas[*847] svám ā́sīt
8.1.115.6 kúśān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.7 tápó-náthā́n[*848] ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.8 múnīn ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.9 pā́pá-vínā́śína ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.115.10 yám arpáyanti
[*847] Text: yáta
[*848] 1984 edition: tapo-dhanā
children.translated_text:
I invoke <s>Nāga-rāja</s> (the Serpent King)!
I invoke the Thousand-headed One (<s>Sahasra-śīrṣa</s>)!
I invoke <s>Ananta</s> (the Infinite)!
I invoke <s>Vāsuki</s>!
From where his own [nature] existed —
I invoke the <s>Kuśa</s> (sacred grass)!
I invoke the Lords of <s>Tapas</s> (Austerity)!
I invoke the <s>Munis</s> (Sages)!
I invoke the Destroyers of Sin (<s>Pāpa-vināśinas</s>)!
They who direct —

children.text:
8.1.116.1 tákṣákam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.2 sárpá-rā́jam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.3 kṣítí-jam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.4 dhárā́dháram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.5 idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
8.1.116.6 rátnam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.7 víṣṇum ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.8 vyā́pínam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.9 víśvam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.116.10 apsarássu yó gandhó gandharveṣu ca yád yáśaḥ
daívo yó mānuṣó gandhás sá mā gandhás surabhír juṣatām[*849]
[*849] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 117. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 116.
children.translated_text:
I invoke <s>Takṣaka</s> (the Serpent)!
I invoke the King of Serpents (<s>Sarpa-rāja</s>)!
I invoke the Earth-born One (<s>Kṣiti-ja</s>)!
I invoke the Upholder of the Earth (<s>Dharādhara</s>)!
This <s>Viṣṇu</s> [strode forth] —
I invoke the Jewel (<s>Ratna</s>)!
I invoke <s>Viṣṇu</s>!
I invoke the All-pervading One (<s>Vyāpin</s>)!
I invoke the Universe (<s>Viśva</s>)!
The fragrance that is among the <s>Apsarases</s> (celestial nymphs) and the fame that is among the <s>Gandharvas</s> (celestial musicians),
whether divine or human fragrance — may that sweet fragrance delight me!

children.text:
8.1.117.1 gándharvān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.117.2 rámyān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.117.3 svárá-jān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.117.4 saúmyá-jān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.117.5 yád devā́nāṃ cákṣuṣy ā́go ásti yád evá kíṃca pratijagrāhám agnír mā tásmād anr̥ṇáṃ kr̥ṇotu
8.1.117.6 jápyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.117.7 pávítram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.117.8 mántram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.117.9 śúddham ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text:
I invoke the <s>Gandharvas</s> (celestial musicians)!
I invoke the Delightful Ones (<s>Ramyas</s>)!
I invoke the Self-sovereign Ones (<s>Svara-jas</s>)!
I invoke those born of <s>Soma</s> (<s>Saumya-jas</s>)!
Whatever sin exists in the eyes of the <s>devas</s> (gods), whatever I have accepted — may <s>Agni</s> make me free from that debt.
I invoke the <s>Japya</s> (the Murmured Prayer)!
I invoke the Pure (<s>Pavitra</s>)!
I invoke the <s>Mantra</s> (Sacred Formula)!
I invoke the Purified (<s>Śuddha</s>)!

children.text:
8.1.118.1 ihá púṣṭiṃ púṣṭi-patir dadhātu
8.1.118.2 vídyā́-dhárān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.118.3 mántrá-bálān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.118.4 púṣpá-jān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.118.5 bhógá-jān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.118.6 citrán devā́nām
8.1.118.7 sárvaúṣádham ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.118.8 ā́dítyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.118.9 áṇḍá-jam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.118.10 sū́ryam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text:
May the lord of nourishment bestow nourishment here!
I invoke the <s>Vidyādharas</s> (Bearers of Knowledge, celestial beings)!
I invoke the <s>Mantra-balas</s> (Powers of Sacred Formulas)!
I invoke those born of Flowers (<s>Puṣpa-jas</s>)!
I invoke those born of Enjoyment (<s>Bhoga-jas</s>)!
Wondrous among the <s>devas</s> (gods) —
I invoke all Herbs (<s>Sarva-oṣadha</s>)!
I invoke <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun)!
I invoke the Egg-born One (<s>Aṇḍa-ja</s>)!
I invoke <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun)!

children.text:
8.1.119.1 apsárā́su yā́ medhā́ gandharvéṣu ca yán mánaḥ
daívī medhā́ manuṣya-jā́ sā́ māṃ medhā́ surábhir juṣatām
8.1.119.2 ápsárása ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.119.3 múdā́váhā ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.119.4 bhógáváhā ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.119.5 svápná-jā ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.119.6 dhātā́sya víśvaṃ hí bíbharti yo vaí
púṣpāṇi rakṣánn ihá jīva-loké
8.1.119.7 dhā́tā́ram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.119.8 súrá-jyéṣṭham ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text:
The wisdom that is among the <s>Apsarases</s> (celestial nymphs) and the mind that is among the <s>Gandharvas</s> (celestial musicians),
whether divine wisdom or human-born — may that sweet wisdom delight me!
I invoke the <s>Apsarases</s> (celestial nymphs)!
I invoke the Joy-bringers (<s>Mudāvahas</s>)!
I invoke the Pleasure-bringers (<s>Bhogavahas</s>)!
I invoke those born of Dream (<s>Svapna-jas</s>)!
<s>Dhātṛ</s> (the Creator) of this [universe] indeed sustains all,
protecting the flowers here in the world of the living.
I invoke <s>Dhātṛ</s> (the Creator)!
I invoke the Eldest of the Gods (<s>Sura-jyeṣṭha</s>)!

children.text:
8.1.120.1 páráméṣṭhínam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.120.2 cátúrā́nánam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.120.3 bhū́mān anto 'gré cákram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.120.4 súdárśánam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.120.5 sáhásrá-víkácam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.120.6 ánápā́yínam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.120.7 úd uttamám
8.1.120.8 várúṇam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.120.9 prácétásam ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text:
I invoke <s>Parameṣṭhin</s> (the Supreme Being)!
I invoke the Four-faced One (<s>Caturānana</s>, Brahmā)!
The abundant one, the protector at the end and beginning — I invoke the <s>Cakra</s> (Discus)!
I invoke <s>Sudarśana</s> (the Beautiful-to-behold, Viṣṇu's discus)!
I invoke the Thousand-rayed One (<s>Sahasra-vikaca</s>)!
I invoke the Imperishable One (<s>Anapāyin</s>)!
Rise up, O most exalted one —
I invoke <s>Varuṇa</s>!
I invoke <s>Pracetasa</s> (the Wise One, Varuṇa)!

children.text:
8.1.121.1 ráktā́mbárá-dháram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.2 yā́dás-pátim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.3 jágad-bhuvam
8.1.121.4 jágád-bhúvam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.5 yájád-bhúvam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.6 viśva-bhúvam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.7 bráhmá-bhúvam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.8 rúdrá-bhúvam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.9 bhúvád-bhúvam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.121.10 rúdram anyám
children.translated_text:
I invoke the Wearer of Red Garments (<s>Raktāmbara-dhara</s>)!
I invoke the Lord of Aquatic Creatures (<s>Yādas-pati</s>)!
The source of the world —
I invoke the Source of the World (<s>Jagad-bhuva</s>)!
I invoke the Source of Sacrifice (<s>Yajad-bhuva</s>)!
I invoke the Source of the Universe (<s>Viśva-bhuva</s>)!
I invoke the Source of <s>Brahman</s> (<s>Brahma-bhuva</s>)!
I invoke the Source of <s>Rudra</s> (<s>Rudra-bhuva</s>)!
I invoke the Source of Existence (<s>Bhuvad-bhuva</s>)!
To <s>Rudra</s>, the other —

children.text:
8.1.122.1 rúdram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.2 óṣádhī́śān ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.3 try-ámbákam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.4 kápā́línam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.5 sínīvāli-pŕ̥thuṣṭuke
8.1.122.6 sínī́vā́lim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.7 gábhástínīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.8 hítá-dām ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.9 púṇyá-dām ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.122.10 trātā́ram índram
children.translated_text:
I invoke <s>Rudra</s>!
I invoke the Lords of Herbs (<s>Oṣadhīśas</s>)!
I invoke the Three-eyed One (<s>Tryambaka</s>)!
I invoke the Skull-bearer (<s>Kapālin</s>)!
O <s>Sinīvālī</s>, of broad braids —
I invoke <s>Sinīvālī</s> (the New Moon goddess)!
I invoke <s>Gabhastinī</s> (the Ray-bearer)!
I invoke the Giver of Good (<s>Hita-dā</s>)!
I invoke the Giver of Merit (<s>Puṇya-dā</s>)!
<s>Indra</s> the protector —

children.text:
8.1.123.1 índram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.2 bhógam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.3 gándham ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.4 śátá-krátum ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.5 hiraṇya-garbhás sám avartatā́gre
8.1.123.6 tváṣṭā́ram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.7 rū́pá-jā́tam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.8 nídhí-jam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.9 plótā́dhípam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.123.10 prájā-pate tváṃ nidhi-pā́ḥ purāṇó devā́nāṃ pitā́ janitā́ prajā́nām
pátir víśvasya jágataḥ paraspā havír no deva vihavé juṣasva[*850]
[*850] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 124. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 123.
children.translated_text:
I invoke <s>Indra</s>!
I invoke Enjoyment (<s>Bhoga</s>)!
I invoke Fragrance (<s>Gandha</s>)!
I invoke the Performer of a Hundred Sacrifices (<s>Śatakratu</s>, Indra)!
<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> (the Golden Embryo) came into being in the beginning —
I invoke <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> (the Celestial Craftsman)!
I invoke the Born-of-Form (<s>Rūpa-jāta</s>)!
I invoke the Treasure-born (<s>Nidhi-ja</s>)!
I invoke the Lord of Rafts (<s>Plotādhipa</s>)!
O <s>Prajāpati</s> (Lord of Creatures), you are the ancient guardian of treasures, the father of the <s>devas</s> (gods), the progenitor of offspring,
the lord and protector of all the world — O god, accept our oblation at the invocation!

children.text:
8.1.124.1 prájā́-pátim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.124.2 sráṣṭā́ram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.124.3 védá-máyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.124.4 bráhmá-rū́pam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.124.5 jātávedase sunavāma sómam arātīyató ní dahāti védaḥ
sá naḥ parṣad áti durgā́ṇi víśvā nāvéva síndhuṃ duritā́ty agníḥ
8.1.124.6 dúrgā́m ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.124.7 kā́tyā́yánīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.124.8 vaíṣṇávīm ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (8.1.124.1) 'I invoke <s>Prajāpati</s> (Lord of Creatures).' (8.1.124.2) 'I invoke the Creator (<s>Sraṣṭṛ</s>).' (8.1.124.3) 'I invoke the one made of the <s>Vedas</s> (<s>Veda-maya</s>).' (8.1.124.4) 'I invoke the one whose form is <s>Brahman</s> (<s>Brahma-rūpa</s>).' (8.1.124.5) 'Let us press <s>Soma</s> for <s>Jātavedas</s>; may he who is our knowledge burn down the hostile ones. May he carry us past all dangers, as a boat across a river — <s>Agni</s>, past evils.' (8.1.124.6) 'I invoke <s>Durgā</s>.' (8.1.124.7) 'I invoke <s>Kātyāyanī</s>.' (8.1.124.8) 'I invoke <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.125.1 víndhyá-vā́sínīm ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.125.2 ā́ satyéna
8.1.125.3 ā́dítyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.125.4 kā́śyápam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.125.5 bhā́skáram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.125.6 sū́ryam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.125.7 yā́ te dhā́māni diví yā́ pr̥thivyā́ṃ yā́ párvateṣv óṣadhīṣv apsú
tébhir no víśvais sumánā áhedan rā́janth[*851] soma práti havyā́ gr̥bhāya
8.1.125.8 níśā́káram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.125.9 cándram ā́vāhayāmi
[*851] RV: rājan
children.translated_text: (8.1.125.1) 'I invoke <s>Vindhyavāsinī</s> (She who dwells in the <s>Vindhya</s> mountains).' (8.1.125.2) 'By truth (<s>ā satyena</s>)...' (8.1.125.3) 'I invoke <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun).' (8.1.125.4) 'I invoke <s>Kāśyapa</s>.' (8.1.125.5) 'I invoke <s>Bhāskara</s> (the Light-maker).' (8.1.125.6) 'I invoke <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun).' (8.1.125.7) 'Whatever abodes of yours are in heaven, on earth, in the mountains, in the herbs, and in the waters — with all of those, O gracious one, do not harm us. O King <s>Soma</s>, accept the oblations.' (8.1.125.8) 'I invoke <s>Niśākara</s> (the Night-maker, i.e. the Moon).' (8.1.125.9) 'I invoke <s>Candra</s> (the Moon).'

children.text:
8.1.126.1 ā́tréyam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.126.2 índum ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.126.3 jágad-bhuvas subrahmaṇyáḥ kŕ̥ttikā-sutáḥ ṣaṣṭikā́ya
8.1.126.4 kúmā́ram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.126.5 śáktí-dháram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.126.6 śíkhí-vā́ham ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.126.7 ṣáḍ-ā́nánam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.126.8 agníṃ dūtám
8.1.126.9 ágnim ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: (8.1.126.1) 'I invoke <s>Ātreya</s> (Son of <s>Atri</s>, i.e. the Moon).' (8.1.126.2) 'I invoke <s>Indu</s> (the Moon-drop).' (8.1.126.3) 'The sustainer of the world, the <s>Subrahmaṇya</s>, the son of the <s>Kṛttikā</s> stars — for the <s>Ṣaṣṭī</s> [rite].' (8.1.126.4) 'I invoke <s>Kumāra</s> (<s>Skanda</s>).' (8.1.126.5) 'I invoke the Spear-bearer (<s>Śaktidhara</s>).' (8.1.126.6) 'I invoke the Peacock-rider (<s>Śikhivāha</s>).' (8.1.126.7) 'I invoke the Six-faced One (<s>Ṣaḍānana</s>).' (8.1.126.8) '<s>Agni</s> the messenger...' (8.1.126.9) 'I invoke <s>Agni</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.127.1 jā́távédásam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.127.2 pā́vákam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.127.3 hútā́śánam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.127.4 rakṣasva tváṃ mahā-bāho sampū́rṇān deva-pū́ritān
ī́ḍítā́ṃs trí-daśais tīrthaiḥ pavítrān uttamā́ñ chubhān
8.1.127.5 hárá svedáṃ varaṃ divyaṃ kaláśaṃ samaláṅkr̥tam
náva-dvayá-gaṇaiḥ pūjyaṃ purúṣāya samā́naya
8.1.127.6 ékākṣaram
8.1.127.7 víṣṇúṃ mr̥dā́ snāpayāmí
8.1.127.8 víśve nímagnaḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.127.1) 'I invoke <s>Jātavedas</s> (the All-knowing Fire).' (8.1.127.2) 'I invoke <s>Pāvaka</s> (the Purifier).' (8.1.127.3) 'I invoke <s>Hutāśana</s> (the Oblation-eater).' (8.1.127.4) 'Protect, O great-armed one, those [vessels] filled full by the gods, praised by the thirty [gods], purified by the sacred fords (<s>tīrtha</s>), the most excellent and auspicious ones.' (8.1.127.5) 'Take this excellent divine water-pot (<s>kalaśa</s>), well-adorned, to be worshipped by the hosts of nine and two — bring it to <s>Puruṣa</s>.' (8.1.127.6) 'The single syllable (<s>ekākṣara</s>)...' (8.1.127.7) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with clay (<s>mṛd</s>).' (8.1.127.8) 'All [are] immersed...'

children.text:
8.1.128.1 víṣṇúṃ parváténá prádákṣíṇáṃ kārayāmí
8.1.128.2 prāṇá prásūtiḥ
8.1.128.3 víṣṇúṃ dhānyaís snāpayāmí
8.1.128.4 vitátya bānám
8.1.128.5 víṣṇúm aṅkúraír árcayāmí
8.1.128.6 tváṃ vajra-bhŕ̥t
8.1.128.7 víṣṇúṃ maṃgáléná[*852] prádákṣíṇáṃ kārayāmí
8.1.128.8 vásoḥ pavítram asi
8.1.128.9 víṣṇúṃ pañcá-gávyéná snāpayāmí
8.1.128.10 vā́rīś cátasraḥ
[*852] Text: maṃgáḷéná
children.translated_text: (8.1.128.1) 'I perform circumambulation (<s>pradakṣiṇa</s>) of <s>Viṣṇu</s> with [offerings from] the mountain.' (8.1.128.2) '<s>Prāṇa</s> (breath), the impeller...' (8.1.128.3) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with grains (<s>dhānya</s>).' (8.1.128.4) 'Having stretched the arrow...' (8.1.128.5) 'I worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> with sprouts (<s>aṅkura</s>).' (8.1.128.6) 'You, the thunderbolt-bearer...' (8.1.128.7) 'I perform circumambulation (<s>pradakṣiṇa</s>) of <s>Viṣṇu</s> with auspicious things (<s>maṅgala</s>).' (8.1.128.8) 'You are the purifier of wealth (<s>Vasoḥ pavitra</s>)...' (8.1.128.9) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with the five cow-products (<s>pañcagavya</s>).' (8.1.128.10) 'The four waters...'

children.text:
8.1.129.1 víṣṇúm upásnā́néná snāpayāmí
8.1.129.2 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
8.1.129.3 víṣṇúm uṣṇódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.129.4 ágna ā́ yāhi
8.1.129.5 víṣṇúṃ ghr̥téná snāpayāmí
8.1.129.6 agním īḷe
8.1.129.7 víṣṇúṃ madhúnā́ snāpayāmí
8.1.129.8 iṣé tvorjé tvā
8.1.129.9 víṣṇuṃ dadhnā́ snāpayāmí
8.1.129.10 śaṃ no devī́ḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.129.1) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with the concluding bath (<s>upasnāna</s>).' (8.1.129.2) 'O waters, you are indeed the sources of bliss (<s>āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo-bhuvaḥ</s>)...' (8.1.129.3) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with warm water (<s>uṣṇodaka</s>).' (8.1.129.4) 'O <s>Agni</s>, come...' (8.1.129.5) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with ghee (<s>ghṛta</s>).' (8.1.129.6) 'I praise <s>Agni</s>...' (8.1.129.7) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with honey (<s>madhu</s>).' (8.1.129.8) 'For food, for strength (<s>iṣe tvorje tvā</s>)...' (8.1.129.9) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with curds (<s>dadhi</s>).' (8.1.129.10) 'May the goddesses [bring us] bliss...'

children.text:
8.1.130.1 víṣṇúṃ kṣīréṇá snāpayāmí
8.1.130.2 abhí tvā śūra
8.1.130.3 víṣṇúṃ gandhódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.130.4 imā́ óṣadhayaḥ
8.1.130.5 víṣṇúm akṣátódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.130.6 jápan datvā́nuvadema sāmá somā́ndhya māndóḥ
karmaṇy ándha mā́ndho nínatu
8.1.130.7 víṣṇuṃ phalódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.130.8 catvā́ri vā́k
8.1.130.9 víṣṇúṃ kuśódákéná snāpayāmí
children.translated_text: (8.1.130.1) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with milk (<s>kṣīra</s>).' (8.1.130.2) 'O <s>Śūra</s> (Hero), toward you...' (8.1.130.3) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with scented water (<s>gandhodaka</s>).' (8.1.130.4) 'These herbs (<s>oṣadhayaḥ</s>)...' (8.1.130.5) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with <s>akṣata</s>-water (unbroken rice grains in water).' (8.1.130.6) 'Muttering and having given, let us recite the <s>Sāman</s>; of <s>Soma</s>, the blind one of the <s>Mānda</s> — may the action, the blind <s>Mānda</s>, lead [us].' (8.1.130.7) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with fruit-water (<s>phalodaka</s>).' (8.1.130.8) 'Four are the [stages of] speech (<s>catvāri vāk</s>)...' (8.1.130.9) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with <s>kuśa</s>-grass water (<s>kuśodaka</s>).'

children.text:
8.1.131.1 nārāyaṇā́ya
8.1.131.2 víṣṇúṃ ratnódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.131.3 pūtás tasya
8.1.131.4 víṣṇúṃ japyódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.131.5 catvā́ri śŕ̥ṅgā tráyo asya pā́dāḥ
8.1.131.6 víṣṇúṃ sarvaúśádhy-údákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.131.7 dhātā́ vidhātā́
8.1.131.8 víṣṇúṃ puṇyá-púṣpaír arcayāmí
8.1.131.9 ŕ̥co yájū(g)ṃṣi
8.1.131.10 víṣṇúṃ jātī́-phálā́dí-cū́rnéná snāpayāmí
children.translated_text: (8.1.131.1) 'To <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>...' (8.1.131.2) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with gem-water (<s>ratnodaka</s>).' (8.1.131.3) 'Purified of that...' (8.1.131.4) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with <s>japya</s>-water (water consecrated by recitation).' (8.1.131.5) 'Four are his horns, three are his feet (<s>catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādāḥ</s>)...' (8.1.131.6) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with water of all herbs (<s>sarvauṣadhy-udaka</s>).' (8.1.131.7) '<s>Dhātṛ</s>, <s>Vidhātṛ</s>...' (8.1.131.8) 'I worship <s>Viṣṇu</s> with sacred flowers (<s>puṇya-puṣpa</s>).' (8.1.131.9) 'The <s>Ṛc</s> verses, the <s>Yajus</s> formulas...' (8.1.131.10) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with powder of jasmine berries and other [substances] (<s>jātī-phalādi-cūrṇa</s>).'

children.text:
8.1.132.1 sa eṣa devó 'mbára-yāna-cákre víṣṇúṃ kaṣā́ya-cū́rṇénódvartayāmí
8.1.132.2 sa sarva-vettā́
8.1.132.3 víṣṇúṃ tīrthódákaís snāpayāmí
8.1.132.4 sāmaíś ca sāṅgám
8.1.132.5 víṣṇúṃ vanaúṣádhī́bhír mārjayāmí
8.1.132.6 áto devā́
8.1.132.7 víṣṇúṃ harídrā́-cū́rṇéná snāpayāmí
8.1.132.8 tvá(gg)ṃ strī pumān
8.1.132.9 víṣṇúṃ sarvá-gándhénódvartayāmí
children.translated_text: (8.1.132.1) 'He is the god who [moves on] the wheel of the sky-vehicle... I anoint <s>Viṣṇu</s> with astringent powder (<s>kaṣāya-cūrṇa</s>).' (8.1.132.2) 'He is the knower of all...' (8.1.132.3) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with waters from sacred fords (<s>tīrthodaka</s>).' (8.1.132.4) 'With the <s>Sāman</s> chants, together with the limbs [of the <s>Veda</s>]...' (8.1.132.5) 'I cleanse <s>Viṣṇu</s> with forest herbs (<s>vanauṣadhī</s>).' (8.1.132.6) '<s>Ato devā</s>...' (8.1.132.7) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with turmeric powder (<s>haridrā-cūrṇa</s>).' (8.1.132.8) 'You [are] woman, [you are] man...' (8.1.132.9) 'I anoint <s>Viṣṇu</s> with all fragrances (<s>sarva-gandha</s>).'

children.text:
8.1.133.1 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
8.1.133.2 víṣṇúm uṣṇódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.133.3 sahásra-śīrṣā púruṣaḥ
8.1.133.4 víṣṇúṃ śuddhódákéná snāpayāmí
8.1.133.5 yóge-yoge śáṃ no devī́ḥ
8.1.133.6 mitrás suparṇáḥ
8.1.133.7 víṣnúṃ ploténá vimr̥jāmí
8.1.133.8 téjo vátsyāvas sómasya tanū́r asi bhūtó bhūtéṣu carati práviṣṭhaḥ
8.1.133.9 agníṃ dūtám
8.1.133.10 tváṃ bhū́r bhúvas tvám
8.1.133.11 víṣṇúṃ mūlá-gándhena mārjayāmí
8.1.133.12 búddhímátāṃ párāṅ gátim
8.1.133.13 víṣṇúṃ dhātúbhír álaṅkaromí
8.1.133.14 kánikradaj janúṣam
children.translated_text: (8.1.133.1) 'O waters, you are indeed the sources of bliss...' (8.1.133.2) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with warm water (<s>uṣṇodaka</s>).' (8.1.133.3) 'The thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>...' (8.1.133.4) 'I bathe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with pure water (<s>śuddhodaka</s>).' (8.1.133.5) 'In each union (<s>yoga</s>)... may the goddesses [bring us] bliss.' (8.1.133.6) '<s>Mitra</s>, the good-winged one (<s>Suparṇa</s>)...' (8.1.133.7) 'I wipe <s>Viṣṇu</s> with a cloth (<s>plota</s>).' (8.1.133.8) 'Radiance... of <s>Vātsyāva</s>... the body of <s>Soma</s>... having become a being, he moves entered into beings.' (8.1.133.9) '<s>Agni</s> the messenger...' (8.1.133.10) 'You are <s>Bhūḥ</s>, you are <s>Bhuvas</s>...' (8.1.133.11) 'I cleanse <s>Viṣṇu</s> with root-fragrance (<s>mūla-gandha</s>).' (8.1.133.12) 'The supreme goal of the wise...' (8.1.133.13) 'I adorn <s>Viṣṇu</s> with minerals (<s>dhātu</s>).' (8.1.133.14) '<s>Kanikradaj januṣam</s>...'

children.text: 8.0.11 dhíyas tā́ rātahavyā́ yájuṣe gr̥hṇāmi pā́tave sutár dévā́nāṃ práṇayantaṃ súvar-jána ágne náya supáthā rāyé asmā́n vā́yum ā́vāhayāmīndram ā́vāhayāmi śivam ā́vāhayāmi ghŕ̥tam ā́vāhayāmy agním īḷe samānam ā́vāhayāmi mahā-devam ā́vāhayāmi yugmam ā́vāhayāmi pūrva-péyam ati yác cháṃ no nídhattāṃ yám arpáyanti yaśaś śuddham ā́vāhayāmi sūryam ā́vāhayāmi sura-jyeṣṭham ā́vāhayāmi pracetasam ā́vāhayāmi rúdram anyáṃ trātā́ram índraṃ prajā́nāṃ vaiṣṇavīm ā́vāhayāmi candram ā́vāhayāmy agním ā́vāhayāmi víśve nímagna vārīś cátasraś śáṃ no devī́ḥ kuśódákéná snāpayāmí cū́rṇéná snāpayāmí gándhénódvartayāmy agníṃ dūtáṃ pañca ca
children.translated_text: (8.0.11) [Rubric:] '...thoughts; those; ...as oblation; I accept the <s>Yajus</s> for drinking; ...of the gods, directing; the heaven-born; O <s>Agni</s>, lead us by the good path to prosperity; I invoke <s>Vāyu</s>; I invoke <s>Indra</s>; I invoke <s>Śiva</s>; I invoke ghee; I praise <s>Agni</s>; I invoke <s>Samāna</s>; I invoke <s>Mahādeva</s>; I invoke the pair; the first drinking; ...may he deposit bliss; ...whom they offer; I invoke pure glory; I invoke <s>Sūrya</s>; I invoke the eldest of the gods; I invoke <s>Pracetas</s>; <s>Rudra</s>; another protector; <s>Indra</s>; of creatures; I invoke <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>; I invoke <s>Candra</s>; I invoke <s>Agni</s>; all immersed; four waters; may the goddesses [bring] bliss; I bathe with <s>kuśa</s>-water; I bathe with powder; I anoint with fragrance; <s>Agni</s> the messenger' — and five [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.134.1 vā́stoṣ-pate dadbhyás svā́hā
8.1.134.2 śatá-dhāraṃ kadā́pí sr̥jate
8.1.134.3 ā́sāgra agrá ojo-bálāya
8.1.134.4 áto devā́ idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
8.1.134.5 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
8.1.134.6 dhārāsu saptasú
8.1.134.7 idám ā́paś śivā́ḥ
8.1.134.8 ā́po vā́ idá(g)ṃ sárvaṃ
8.1.134.9 nārāyaṇā́ya
children.translated_text: (8.1.134.1) 'O <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> (Lord of the Dwelling), to those who give, <s>svāhā</s>.' (8.1.134.2) 'The hundred-streamed one releases at some time.' (8.1.134.3) 'At the foremost of the foremost seats — for vigor and strength.' (8.1.134.4) '<s>Ato devā</s>; this <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' (8.1.134.5) 'O waters, you are indeed the sources of bliss...' (8.1.134.6) 'In the seven streams...' (8.1.134.7) 'These are the auspicious waters...' (8.1.134.8) 'Waters indeed are all this.' (8.1.134.9) 'To <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>...'

children.text:
8.1.135.1 tát-púruṣāya vidmáhe súpárṇá-pakṣā́ya dhīmahi
táṃ no garuḍaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.135.2 iṣé tvorjé tvā
8.1.135.3 ā́pa undaṃtu
8.1.135.4 sahásrá-śī́rṣā púruṣaḥ
8.1.135.5 áto devā́ idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
8.1.135.6 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
8.1.135.7 híraṇya-varṇāḥ pávamānas súvar-jánaḥ
8.1.135.8 śáṃ no devī́s sahásra-śīrṣā púruṣaḥ
8.1.135.9 áto devā́ idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
children.translated_text: (8.1.135.1) 'We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate on the one with <s>Suparṇa</s> (eagle) wings — may <s>Garuḍa</s> inspire us.' (8.1.135.2) 'For food, for strength (<s>iṣe tvorje tvā</s>)...' (8.1.135.3) 'May the waters sprinkle...' (8.1.135.4) 'The thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>...' (8.1.135.5) '<s>Ato devā</s>; this <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' (8.1.135.6) 'O waters, you are indeed the sources of bliss...' (8.1.135.7) 'Golden-hued... self-purifying... heaven-born.' (8.1.135.8) 'May the goddesses [bring] bliss; the thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>...' (8.1.135.9) '<s>Ato devā</s>; this <s>Viṣṇu</s>...'

children.text:
8.1.136.1 ā́tmātmā dhārāsu saptasú
8.1.136.2 vainateyó mahā-vīryaḥ kāśyápo 'gni-samá-prabhaḥ
ā́yā́tú bhágavān rājā sarpá-jid viṣṇu-vā́hanaḥ
8.1.136.3 śatá-dhāraṃ kadā́pi sr̥jate
8.1.136.4 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvaḥ
8.1.136.5 híraṇya-varṇāḥ pávamānas súvar-jánaḥ
8.1.136.6 svasti-dā́ viśás-pátiḥ
8.1.136.7 védāhám etám
8.1.136.8śatá-dhāraṃ kadā́pí sr̥jate
8.1.136.9[*853] oṃ āyātu tārkṣya bījākṣara rakta-varṇa śvetānana vajra-nakha vajra-pakṣa svāmi-kārya dhuraṃdharāṣṭa-nāga-sahita marut-sahāya saha devatābhir anumanyatā́m
[*853] In this verse, the text has no accent marks from oṃ through the first syllable, a, in anumanyatā́m.
children.translated_text: (8.1.136.1) 'The Self, the Self — in the seven streams.' (8.1.136.2) '<s>Vainateya</s> (<s>Garuḍa</s>), of great valor, son of <s>Kaśyapa</s>, having the splendor equal to <s>Agni</s> — may the blessed king come, the conqueror of serpents, the vehicle of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.' (8.1.136.3) 'The hundred-streamed one releases at some time.' (8.1.136.4) 'O waters, you are indeed the sources of bliss...' (8.1.136.5) 'Golden-hued... self-purifying... heaven-born.' (8.1.136.6) 'The bestower of well-being, the lord of the people (<s>Viśaspati</s>)...' (8.1.136.7) 'I know this one...' (8.1.136.8) 'The hundred-streamed one releases at some time.' (8.1.136.9) '<s>Oṃ</s>. May <s>Tārkṣya</s> come — with the seed-syllable, of red color, white-faced, with diamond claws, with diamond wings, the bearer of burdens for the Lord's purpose, accompanied by the eight <s>Nāgas</s>, with <s>Marut</s> as companion, together with the deities — may he approve.'

children.text:
8.1.137.1 yás tú śúká-várṇā́ṃbárá-dháráḥ púṣkárá-sáñcā́ríṇaṃ lóhítā́kṣáṃ gárutmantam óm
8.1.137.2 gárúḍam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.137.3 pákṣí-rā́jam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.137.4 súpárṇá-pákṣam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.137.5 khágā́dhípátim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.137.6 áto devā́ víṣṇor nú ka(g)ṃ sahásra-śīrṣā púruṣaḥ
8.1.137.7 ā́sāgra agrá ójo-bálāya
8.1.137.8 śatá-dhāraṃ kadā́pí sr̥jate
8.1.137.9 bhūs svā́hā
8.1.137.10 śatá-dhāraṃ kadā́pi sr̥jate
8.1.137.11 óṃ bhū́ḥ gárúḍam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.137.12 tát-púruṣāya vidmáhe
8.1.137.13 ā́gneyó yásmāt
8.1.137.14 praíṣām adhīśáḥ
8.1.137.15 bhū́mān anto 'gré vándyo na eṣáḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.137.1 He who wears parrot-colored garments, the red-eyed <s>Garutmat</s> who wanders among lotuses — <s>Oṃ</s>. 8.1.137.2 I invoke <s>Garuḍa</s>. 8.1.137.3 I invoke the King of Birds (<s>Pakṣi-rāja</s>). 8.1.137.4 I invoke the Fair-winged One (<s>Suparṇa-pakṣa</s>). 8.1.137.5 I invoke the Lord of Birds (<s>Khagādhipati</s>). 8.1.137.6 '<s>Ato devāḥ</s>... <s>Viṣṇor nu kam</s>... The thousand-headed <s>Puruṣa</s>...' 8.1.137.7 'At the foremost edge — for strength and power.' 8.1.137.8 'He releases the hundred-streamed [flow] at any time.' 8.1.137.9 '<s>Bhūḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' 8.1.137.10 'He releases the hundred-streamed [flow] at any time.' 8.1.137.11 '<s>Oṃ Bhūḥ</s> — I invoke <s>Garuḍa</s>.' 8.1.137.12 'We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>...' 8.1.137.13 'He who is born of <s>Agni</s>...' 8.1.137.14 'The overlord of the commands.' 8.1.137.15 'The abundant one, at the end and beginning — this one is to be worshipped by us.'

children.text: 8.0.12 vidmáhe viṣṇur ánumanyatā́ṃ sr̥jate pañcá ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.12 [Rubric:] 'We know... May <s>Viṣṇu</s> approve... He releases...' — and five [more mantras].

children.text:
8.1.138.1 śucī vo havyā́
8.1.138.2 agníś śúciḥ
8.1.138.3 óṃ bhū́téśam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.138.4 máhā́-bhū́tam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.138.5 víṣṇú-bháktam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.138.6 gádā́-dháram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.138.7 prajā́-pátim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.138.8 śéṣam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.138.9 sū́ryam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.138.10 cándram ā́vāhayāmi
children.translated_text: 8.1.138.1 'Pure are your oblations...' 8.1.138.2 '<s>Agni</s> is pure.' 8.1.138.3 <s>Oṃ</s>. I invoke <s>Bhūteśa</s> (the Lord of Beings). 8.1.138.4 I invoke <s>Mahā-bhūta</s> (the Great Being). 8.1.138.5 I invoke the Devotee of <s>Viṣṇu</s> (<s>Viṣṇu-bhakta</s>). 8.1.138.6 I invoke the Mace-bearer (<s>Gadā-dhara</s>). 8.1.138.7 I invoke <s>Prajāpati</s> (the Lord of Creatures). 8.1.138.8 I invoke <s>Śeṣa</s> (the Cosmic Serpent). 8.1.138.9 I invoke <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun). 8.1.138.10 I invoke <s>Candra</s> (the Moon).

children.text:
8.1.139.1 sáptá-mā́tr̥̄r ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.139.2 bhū́mim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.139.3 vŕ̥ṣábham ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.139.4 índram ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.139.5 vā́cás-pátim ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.139.6 náṃdī́śam ā́vāhayāmi
8.1.139.7 ádité ínumanyasva
8.1.139.8 bhūteśā́ya svā́hā
8.1.139.9 áto devā́ idáṃ víṣṇus trī́ṇi padā́ víṣṇoḥ kármāṇi tád víṣṇoḥ páramáṃ tád víprāsaḥ
8.1.139.10 bhū́s svā́hā
children.translated_text: 8.1.139.1 I invoke the Seven Mothers (<s>Sapta-mātṛs</s>). 8.1.139.2 I invoke <s>Bhūmi</s> (the Earth). 8.1.139.3 I invoke <s>Vṛṣabha</s> (the Bull). 8.1.139.4 I invoke <s>Indra</s>. 8.1.139.5 I invoke <s>Vācaspati</s> (the Lord of Speech). 8.1.139.6 I invoke <s>Nandīśa</s> (the Lord of Joy). 8.1.139.7 'O <s>Aditi</s>, approve!' 8.1.139.8 'To <s>Bhūteśa</s> (the Lord of Beings), <s>svāhā</s>!' 8.1.139.9 '<s>Ato devāḥ</s>... This <s>Viṣṇu</s>... Three steps... The deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>... That supreme [abode] of <s>Viṣṇu</s>... That the inspired ones...' 8.1.139.10 '<s>Bhūḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!'

children.text:
8.1.140.1 ádité ínvama(gg)ṃsthāḥ
8.1.140.2 úpa śvāsaya pr̥thivī́m utá dyā́ṃ purutrā́ te manutāṃ víṣṭhitaṃ jágat
sá duṃdubhe sajū́r índreṇa devaír dūrā́d dávīyo ápa sedha śátrūn
8.1.140.3 ā́ krandaya bálam ójo na ā́ dhā ní ṣṭanihi duritā́ bā́dhamānaḥ
ápa protha duṃdubhe ducchúnā́(g)ṃ[*854] itá índrasya muṣṭír asi vīḍáyasva
8.1.140.4 ā́mū́r aja pratyā́vartayemā́ḥ ketumád duṃdhubhír vāvadīti
sám áśva-parṇāś cáranti no náro 'smā́kam indra rathíno jayantu
8.1.140.5 óm bhū́r bhúvas súvaḥ
8.1.140.6 índrāya vā́caṃ vadaténdraṃ vā́jaṃ jāpayaténdro vā́jam ajayit
8.1.140.7 yajñásya ghoṣád asi
[*854] RV: duchúnā; TS: ducchúnā́ṃ. Proof that Vaikhānasas follow TS.
children.translated_text: 8.1.140.1 'O <s>Aditi</s>, be gracious!' 8.1.140.2 'Make the earth tremble, and heaven! May the manifold universe acknowledge your far-spread [power]. O <s>Dundubhi</s> (war-drum), together with <s>Indra</s> and the gods, drive away enemies to the farthest distance!' 8.1.140.3 'Roar! Bestow power and strength upon us! Boom, driving away misfortune! Scatter ill-fortune from here, O <s>Dundubhi</s>! You are the fist of <s>Indra</s> — make yourself firm!' 8.1.140.4 'Drive back those [enemies]; turn these back! The <s>Dundubhi</s> sounds forth with its banner. Our men advance with horse-feathered [arrows] — may our charioteers conquer, O <s>Indra</s>!' 8.1.140.5 '<s>Oṃ Bhūr Bhuvas Suvaḥ</s>!' 8.1.140.6 'Speak the word for <s>Indra</s>; cause <s>Indra</s> to win the prize; <s>Indra</s> has won the prize.' 8.1.140.7 'You are the roar of the sacrifice.'

children.text: 8.0.13 cándram ā́vāhayāmi bhū́s svā́hā yajñásya ghoṣád asi
children.translated_text: 8.0.13 [Rubric:] 'I invoke <s>Candra</s> (the Moon)... <s>Bhūḥ svāhā</s>... You are the roar of the sacrifice.'

children.text:
8.1.141.1 udyántaṃ bŕ̥haspate áti yát
8.1.141.2 mā́rkaṇḍeyāya námáḥ
8.1.141.3 bhŕ̥gave námáḥ
8.1.141.4 bráhma jajñānám
8.1.141.5 pitā́ virā́jāṃ bráhma devā́ antár asmin bráhman devā́ś cátasra ā́śāḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.141.1 'Rising, O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, beyond that...' 8.1.141.2 Obeisance to <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>. 8.1.141.3 Obeisance to <s>Bhṛgu</s>. 8.1.141.4 '<s>Brahman</s> was born...' 8.1.141.5 'The father of the <s>Virāj</s> meters — <s>Brahman</s>, the gods within; in this <s>Brahman</s>, the gods and the four directions.'

children.text: 8.0.14 udyántaṃ páñca ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.14 [Rubric:] 'Rising...' — and five [more mantras].

children.text:
8.1.142.1 hiraṇya-garbhás sám avartatā́gre bhūtásya jātáḥ pátir éka āsīt
sá dādhāra pr̥thivī́n dyā́m utémā́ṃ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.142.2 yáḥ prāṇató nimiṣató mahitvaíka íd rā́jā jágato babhū́va
yá ī́śe asyá dvi-pádaś cátuṣ-padaḥ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.142.3 yá ātma-dā́ bala-dā́ yásya víśva upā́sate praśíṣáṃ yásya devā́ḥ
yásya chāyā́mŕ̥taṃ yásya mr̥tyúḥ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.142.4 yásyemé himávanto mahitvā́ yásya samudrá(g)ṃ rasáyā sahā́húḥ
yásyemā́ḥ pradíśo yásya bāhū́ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.142.5 yáṃ krándasī ávasā tastabhāné abhy aíkṣetāṃ mánasā réjamāne
yátrā́dhi sū́ra úditau vyéti[*855] kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.142.6 yéna dyaúr ugrā́ pr̥thivī́ ca dr̥ḍhé[*856] yéna súvas stabhitáṃ yéna nā́kaḥ
yó antárikṣe rájaso vimā́naḥ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.142.7 ā́po ha yán mahátī́r[*857] víśvam ā́yan dákṣaṃ[*858] dádhānā janáyantīr agním
táto devā́nāṃ níravartatā́sur[*859] ékaḥ kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
8.1.142.8 yáś cid ā́po mahinā́ paryápaśyad dákṣaṃ dádhānā janáyantīr agním[*860]
yó devéṣv ádhi devá éka ā́sīt kásmai devā́ya havíṣā vidhema
[*855] RV: údito vibhā́ti replaces úditau vyéti
[*856] RV: dr̥dhā́
[*857] RV: yád br̥hatīr replaces yán mahátī́r
[*858] RV: garbham
[*859] RV: samavartatā́sur
[*860] RV: yajñám
children.translated_text: 8.1.142.1 '<s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> (the Golden Embryo) arose in the beginning; once born, he was the sole lord of all that exists. He upheld the earth and this heaven — to which god shall we offer oblation?' 8.1.142.2 'He who by his greatness became the sole king of the breathing and blinking [world] — who rules over this two-footed and four-footed [creation] — to which god shall we offer oblation?' 8.1.142.3 'He who is the giver of the Self, the giver of strength; whose command all the gods attend; whose shadow is immortality and [whose shadow is also] death — to which god shall we offer oblation?' 8.1.142.4 'By whose greatness these snowy mountains [exist]; whose, they say, is the ocean with the [river] <s>Rasā</s>; whose are these directions, whose are the arms — to which god shall we offer oblation?' 8.1.142.5 'Whom the two battle-hosts, trembling in their minds, look to with awe as they stand supported — over whom the risen sun shines forth — to which god shall we offer oblation?' 8.1.142.6 'By whom the mighty heaven and the firm earth [are held], by whom the sun is established, by whom the vault [of heaven] — who in the atmosphere is the measurer of space — to which god shall we offer oblation?' 8.1.142.7 'When the great waters came, bearing all as a germ, generating <s>Agni</s> — then arose the one life-breath of the gods — to which god shall we offer oblation?' 8.1.142.8 'He who with his might surveyed the great waters, bearing the ritual skill, generating <s>Agni</s> — who was the one god above the gods — to which god shall we offer oblation?'

children.text: 8.0.15 vídhéma ṣáṭ ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.15 [Rubric:] '...shall we offer oblation' — and six [more mantras].

children.text:
8.1.143.1 índraṃ vo viśvátas pári hávāmahe jánebhyaḥ
asmā́kam astu kévalaḥ
8.1.143.2 índraṃ náro nemádhitā havante yát pā́ryā yunájate dhíyas tā́ḥ
śū́ro nŕ̥-ṣātā śávasaś cakāná ā́ gó-mati vrajé bhajā tváṃ naḥ
8.1.143.3 indriyā́ṇi śata-krato yā́ te jáneṣu pañcásu
índra tā́ni ta ā́ vr̥ṇe
8.1.143.4 ánu te dāyi mahá índriyā́ya satrā́ te víśvam ánuvr̥tra hátyai[*861]
ánu kṣatrám ánu sáho yajatréndra devébhir án ute nr̥ṣáhye
8.1.143.5 yujé ráthaṃ gavéṣaṇa(g)ṃ háribhyām úpa bráhmāṇi jujuṣāṇám asthuḥ
ví bādhiṣṭā[*862] syá ródasī mahitvā́ índro vr̥trā́ṇy ápratī́ jaghanvā́n[*863]
[*861] RV, TS, TB: hátye
[*862] RV, AV: bādhiṣṭa; TB: bādhiṣṭā
[*863] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 144. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 143.
children.translated_text: 8.1.143.1 'We invoke <s>Indra</s> from all sides, from among the peoples — may he be ours alone!' 8.1.143.2 '<s>Indra</s>, whom men who are not negligent invoke when they yoke their prayers — the hero, the winner of men, desiring might — in the cattle-rich enclosure, do you share [the spoils] with us!' 8.1.143.3 'The senses, O <s>Śatakratu</s> (Hundred-sacrificer), which are yours among the five peoples — O <s>Indra</s>, those I choose for you.' 8.1.143.4 'For your great might, for the complete slaying of <s>Vṛtra</s> — sovereignty and power have been granted to you; [you are] worthy of worship, O <s>Indra</s>, among the gods, and [powerful] in the contest of men.' 8.1.143.5 'I yoke the chariot seeking cattle, with the two bay horses; the prayers have stood, delighting. He has pushed apart the two worlds by his greatness — <s>Indra</s>, irresistible, has slain the <s>Vṛtras</s>.'

children.text:
8.1.144.1 índraṃ náro yujé rátham
8.1.144.2 jagŕ̥bhṇā́[*864] te dákṣiṇam indra hástam vasūyávo vasu-pate vásūnām
vidmā́ hí tvā gó-pati(g)ṃ śūra gónām asmábhyaṃ citráṃ vŕ̥ṣaṇa(g)ṃ rayíṃ dāḥ
8.1.144.3 távedáṃ víśvam abhítaḥ paśavyam yát páśyasi cákṣuṣā sū́ryasya
gávām asi gó-patir éka indraḥ bhakṣīmáhi te práyatasya vásvaḥ[*865]
[*864] RV: jagr̥bhmā; TB: jagr̥bhṇā
[*865] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 145. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 144.
children.translated_text: 8.1.144.1 '<s>Indra</s>, whom men [invoke]... I yoke the chariot...' 8.1.144.2 'We have grasped your right hand, O <s>Indra</s>, desiring wealth, O lord of wealth, [lord] of riches! For we know you, O hero, as the lord of cattle, [lord] of cows — give us, O Bull, wonderful wealth!' 8.1.144.3 'All this cattle-[wealth] around is yours, whatever you see with the eye of <s>Sūrya</s>. You alone, O <s>Indra</s>, are the lord of cattle, the lord of cows — may we partake of the wealth offered by you!'

children.text:
8.1.145.1 sám indra ṇo mánasā neṣi góbhiḥ sá(g)ṃ sūríbhir maghavanth[*866] sá(gg)ṃ svastyā́[*867]
sáṃ bráhmaṇā devá-kr̥taṃ[*868] yád ásti sáṃ devā́nā́(g)ṃ sumatyā́ yajñíyānām
8.1.145.2 ārā́c chátrum ápa bādhasva dūrám úgró yáś śámbaḥ[*869] puruhūta téna
asmé dhehi yávamad gómád índrá kr̥dhī́ dhíyaṃ jaritré vā́ja-ratnām
8.1.145.3 índra śréṣṭhāni dráviṇāni dhehi cíttiṃ dákṣasya subhagatvám asmé
póṣaṃ rayīṇā́m áriṣṭiṃ tanū́nāṃ svādmā́naṃ vācás sudinatvám áhnām
8.1.145.4 bhúvas tvám indra bráhmaṇā mahā́n bhúvo víśveṣu sávaneṣu yajñíyaḥ
bhúvo nr̥̄́(g)ṃś cyautnó víśvasmin bháre jyéṣṭhaś ca mántro viśva-carṣaṇe
8.1.145.5 índraṃ práṇayantaṃ vápur índra(gg)ṃ srávanta(g)ṃ savitā́ram índraṃ dadhātu
śákras sukŕ̥taṣya lokám índraṃ manye pitáraṃ mātā́rañ ca
8.1.145.6 éndra sānasí(g)ṃ rayí(g)ṃ sajítvāna(g)ṃ sadāsáham[*870]
várṣiṣṭham ūtáye bhara
[*866] RV: harivaḥ
[*867] RV: svasti
[*868] RV: -hitam
[*869] 1984 edition: śámbhuḥ; 1946 edition, RV: śámbaḥ
[*870] RV, TS: sadāsáham; VMP: sadāsaham
children.translated_text: 8.1.145.1 'Lead us together with cattle, O <s>Indra</s>, with your mind; together with the generous patrons, O Bountiful One, together with well-being; together with the divine <s>Brahman</s> — together with the goodwill of the gods worthy of sacrifice.' 8.1.145.2 'Drive the enemy far away, repel [him] to a distance! O mighty one, whatever weapon is yours, O Much-invoked — with that, bestow upon us [wealth] rich in barley and cattle. O <s>Indra</s>, grant to the singer a prayer rich in prizes!' 8.1.145.3 'O <s>Indra</s>, bestow the most excellent riches! Grant us wisdom, good fortune, and for ourselves — increase of wealth, safety of body, and sweetness of speech, and fair days!' 8.1.145.4 'You became great through <s>Brahman</s>, O <s>Indra</s>; you became worthy of worship at all <s>Soma</s>-pressings. You became the impeller of men, a hero in every contest, and the greatest <s>mantra</s> among all peoples.' 8.1.145.5 'May <s>Savitṛ</s> establish <s>Indra</s> who leads forth, the radiant form, <s>Indra</s> the flowing one. May <s>Śakra</s> [grant] the world of the meritorious — I consider <s>Indra</s> as father and mother.' 8.1.145.6 'O <s>Indra</s>, bring to us wealth that conquers, ever-victorious, ever-surpassing — the most excellent, for our aid!'

children.text: 8.0.16 jujuṣāṇám asthur éka indro 'sme saptá ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.16 [Rubric:] '...delighting, they stood; the one <s>Indra</s>; for us' — and seven [more mantras].

children.text:
8.1.146.1 ágne náya supáthā rāyé asmā́n víśvāni deva vayúnāni vidvā́n
yuyodhy asmaj juhurāṇám éno bhū́yiṣṭhān te námá-úktíṃ vídhémá
8.1.146.2 prá vaś śukrā́ya bhānáve bharadhva(g)ṃ havyáṃ matíṃ cāgnáye súpūtam
yó daívyāni mā́nuṣā janū́(g)ṃṣy antár víśvāni vidmánā jígāti
8.1.146.3 ácchā[*871] gíro matáyo devayántīr agníṃ yanti dráviṇaṃ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ
susaṃdŕ̥śa(g)ṃ suprátīka(gg)ṃ sváñcá(g)ṃ havyavā́ham[*872] aratíṃ mā́nuṣāṇām
8.1.146.4 ágne tvám asmád yuyodhy ámīvā ánagnitrā abhyamanta kr̥ṣṭī́ḥ
púnar asmábhyá(g)ṃ suvitā́ya deva kṣā́ṃ víśvebhir ajárebhir yajatra
8.1.146.5 ágne tváṃ pārayā návyo asmā́n svastíbhir áti durgā́ṇi víśvā
pū́ś ca pr̥thvī́ bahulā́ na urvī́ bhávā tokā́ya tánayāya śáṃ yóḥ
[*871] RV: áchā; TB: ácchā
[*872] RV, TB: havyavā́ha; VMP: havyamā́ha
children.translated_text: 8.1.146.1 O <s>Agni</s>, lead us by the good path to prosperity, O god, knowing all the ways; drive away from us the sin that leads astray — we shall offer the utmost homage-words to you. 8.1.146.2 Bring forth your oblation and thought, well-purified, to <s>Agni</s>, to the bright radiance; who by his wisdom penetrates all divine and human births. 8.1.146.3 Toward [<s>Agni</s>] go hymns and thoughts, seeking the gods, going to <s>Agni</s>, asking for wealth — beautiful to behold, fair-faced, well-directed, the oblation-bearer, the charioteer of humans. 8.1.146.4 O <s>Agni</s>, drive away from us disease; the people who have no fire have oppressed [us]; O god, worthy of worship, [restore] our land for well-being again, with all the unaging ones. 8.1.146.5 O <s>Agni</s>, being the newest, carry us safely across all difficulties; and may the earth be broad and spacious for us — be for our children and grandchildren a [source of] bliss and joy! [Footnotes 871-872: Variant readings from RV and TB.]

children.text:
8.1.147.1 prá kāravo mananā́ vacyámānā devadrī́cīṃ nayatha[*873] devayántaḥ
dakṣiṇāvā́ḍ vājínī prā́cy eti havír bháranty agnáye ghr̥tā́cī
8.1.147.2 ágna ā́ yāhi vītáye gr̥ṇānó havyádātaye
ní hótā satsi barhíṣi
8.1.147.3 agním īḷe puróhitaṃ yajñásya devám r̥tvíjam
hótāraṃ ratna-dhā́tamam
8.1.147.4 agníḥ pū́rvebhir r̥ṣibhir ī́ḍyo nū́tanir utá
sá devā́ṃ éhá vakṣati
8.1.147.5 agnínā rayím aśnavat póṣam evá divé-dive
yaśásaṃ vīrávattamam
[*873] RV: nayata
children.translated_text: 8.1.147.1 Forth go the bards, the songs being uttered, god-directed, seeking the gods; the prize-bearing [mare] goes eastward, southward, carrying the oblation to <s>Agni</s>, dripping with ghee. 8.1.147.2 O <s>Agni</s>, come to the feast, praised, to receive the oblation; sit down as <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoker) on the sacred grass! 8.1.147.3 I praise <s>Agni</s>, the household priest of the sacrifice, the divine officiant, the <s>Hotṛ</s>, the most bounteous bestower of jewels. 8.1.147.4 <s>Agni</s>, praised by the former sages and by the present — may he bring the gods here. 8.1.147.5 Through <s>Agni</s> may one attain wealth, daily increasing prosperity, glorious and most abounding in heroes. [Footnote 873: RV reads nayata.]

children.text:
8.1.148.1 ágne yáṃ yajñám adhvaráṃ viśvátaḥ paribhū́r ási
sá íd devéṣu gacchati
8.1.148.2 agnír hótā kaví-kratus satyáś citrá-śravastamaḥ
devó devébhir ā́g amat
8.1.148.3 agnír ŕ̥ṣiḥ pávamānaḥ pā́ñcajanyaḥ puróhitaḥ
tám īmahe mahā-gayám
8.1.148.4 ágne pávasva svápā asmé várcas suvī́ryam
dádhad rayíṃ máyi póṣam
8.1.148.5 agnír mūrdhā́ diváḥ kakút pátiḥ pr̥thivyā́ ayám
apā́(g)ṃ rétā́(g)ṃsi jinvati
8.1.148.6 úd buddhyasvāgne práti jāgr̥hy enam iṣṭā-pūrté sá(g)ṃsr̥jethā mayáṃ ca
púnaḥ kr̥ṇvá(gg)ṃs tvā pitáraṃ yúvānam anvā́tā́(g)ṃsīt tváyi tántum etám
children.translated_text: 8.1.148.1 O <s>Agni</s>, whatever sacrifice and ritual you encompass on all sides — that indeed reaches the gods. 8.1.148.2 <s>Agni</s>, the <s>Hotṛ</s>, the one of poetic wisdom, the true one, of most renowned glory — may the god come with the gods. 8.1.148.3 <s>Agni</s> the sage, the self-purifying, of the five peoples, the household priest — we implore him, the great singer. 8.1.148.4 O <s>Agni</s>, purify yourself, O performer of good deeds! [Bestow] upon us splendor and heroic strength, placing wealth and prosperity in me. 8.1.148.5 <s>Agni</s> is the head of heaven, the summit, the lord of this earth — he quickens the seeds of the waters. 8.1.148.6 Awake, O <s>Agni</s>, be watchful! May you and I be united in the offered and fulfilled [rites]. Making you again the youthful father, he has stretched this thread upon you.

children.text: 8.0.17 śáṃ yór vīrávattamaṃ jinvati dvé ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.17 [Catch-words:] '...bliss and joy; most abounding in heroes; he quickens' — and two [additional mantras].

children.text:
8.1.149.1 ā́yātu devás sumánābhir ūtíbhir yamó havehá práyatābhir aktā́
ā́ sīdatā(g)ṃ suprayáte ha barhíṣy ū́rjāya jātyaí máma śatru-hátyai
8.1.149.2 yamé iva yátamāne yád aítaṃ prá vām bharan mā́nuṣā devayántaḥ
ā́ sīdata(gg)ṃ svám u lokáṃ vídāne svāsasthé bhavatam índave naḥ
8.1.149.3 yamā́ya sóma(g)ṃ sunuta yamā́ya juhutā havíḥ
yamá(g)ṃ ha yajñó gacchaty agní-dūto áraṃ-kr̥taḥ
8.1.149.4 yamā́ya ghr̥távad dhavír juhóta prá ca tiṣṭhata
só no devéṣv ā́ yamad dīrghám ā́yuḥ prá jīváse
8.1.149.5 yamā́ya mádhumattama(g)ṃ rā́jñe havyáṃ juhotana
idáṃ náma ŕ̥ṣibhyaḥ pūrvajébhyaḥ pū́rvebhyaḥ pathikŕ̥dbhyaḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.149.1 May the god <s>Yama</s> come with his well-intentioned aids, with the appointed and anointed ones, invoked here; may he sit on the well-prepared sacred grass — for vigor, for birth, for the slaying of my enemies. 8.1.149.2 Like <s>Yama</s> and his pair striving — when you two come, humans seeking the gods have brought [oblations] to you; sit down, finding your own realm — be well-established for our <s>Soma</s>. 8.1.149.3 For <s>Yama</s> press the <s>Soma</s>; for <s>Yama</s> offer the oblation — to <s>Yama</s> the sacrifice goes, <s>Agni</s>-conducted, well-prepared. 8.1.149.4 Offer the ghee-rich oblation to <s>Yama</s>, and step forth; may he guide us among the gods to a long life, for living. 8.1.149.5 Offer to King <s>Yama</s> the sweetest oblation — this homage to the sages of old, the ancient path-makers.

children.text:
8.1.150.1 yó 'sya kaúṣṭhya jágataḥ pā́rthivasyaíka idvaśī́
yamáṃ bhaṅgyaśravó gāya yó rā́jā anaparódhyaḥ
8.1.150.2 yamáṃ gā́ya bhaṅgyaśrávo yó rā́jā anaparódhyaḥ
yénāpó nadyó dhanvāni yéna dyaúḥ pr̥thivī́ dr̥ḍhā́
8.1.150.3 hiraṇya-kakṣyā́nth sudhúrān hiraṇyākṣā́n ayaś-śaphā́n
áśvān anáśyato dānaṃ yamó rājā abhitíṣṭhati
8.1.150.4 yamó dādhāra pr̥thivī́ṃ yamó víśvam idáṃ jágat
yamā́ya sárvam ít trasthe[*874] yát prāṇád vāyú-rakṣitám
8.1.150.5 yáthā páñca yáthā ṣáḍ yathā́ páñcadaśárṣayaḥ
yamáṃ yó vidyāth sá brūyād yathaíká ŕ̥ṣir vijā́nate
[*874] TA: trasthe; KS: tasthe; VMP: rasthe
children.translated_text: 8.1.150.1 He who of this standing, earthly world is the sole ruler — sing of <s>Yama</s>, O <s>Bhaṅgyaśravas</s>, who is the king that cannot be opposed. 8.1.150.2 Sing of <s>Yama</s>, O <s>Bhaṅgyaśravas</s>, the king that cannot be opposed — by whom the waters, the rivers, the deserts [are held], by whom heaven and earth are made firm. 8.1.150.3 Horses with golden girth-bands, well-harnessed, golden-eyed, iron-hoofed — the gift of imperishable [horses], King <s>Yama</s> oversees. 8.1.150.4 <s>Yama</s> upheld the earth; <s>Yama</s>, all this moving world — before <s>Yama</s> everything that breathes trembles, protected by <s>Vāyu</s>. 8.1.150.5 As five, as six, as fifteen sages — whoever would know <s>Yama</s>, let him speak — as one sage knows him. [Footnote 874: Variant readings in TA, KS, and VMP.]

children.text:
8.1.151.1 tríkadrukebhiḥ pátati[*875] ṣáḍ urvī́r ékam íd br̥hát
gāyatrī́ triṣṭúp[*876] chándā́(g)ṃsi sárvā tā́ yamá ā́hitā
8.1.151.2 áhar-ahar náyamāno gā́m áśvaṃ púruṣaṃ jágat
vaívasvato ná tr̥pyati páñcabhir mā́navair yamáḥ
8.1.151.3 vaívasvate vívicyante yáme rā́jani te janā́ḥ
yé cehá satyénécchante yá u cā́nr̥ta-vādináḥ
8.1.151.4 té rājann ihá vívicyante 'thā́yanti[*877] tvām úpa
devā́(g)ṃś ca yé namasyánti brā́hmaṇā(g)ṃś cāpacítyati
8.1.151.5 yásmin vr̥kṣé supalāśé devaís saṃpíbate yamáḥ
átrā no viś-pátiḥ pitā́ purāṇā́[*878] ánu venati
8.1.151.6 yamó dādhāra pr̥thivī́ṃ yamó dyā́m utá sū́ryaḥ[*879]
yamás sárva-mr̥tyus te náḥ[*880] prāṇā́nāṃ vāyūnā́m
[*875] RV patati; TA: pátati
[*876] RV: triṣṭúp gāyatrī́
[*877] Text: yantit
[*878] RV: purāṇā́ṃ
[*879] KS: sūryam
[*880] cf. VMP 6.19.1: stenáḥ instead of te náḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.151.1 By three cups he flies over six wide [realms]; one alone is great — <s>Gāyatrī</s>, <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, [and] all metres are established in <s>Yama</s>. 8.1.151.2 Day by day leading away cow, horse, man, the world — <s>Vaivasvata</s> <s>Yama</s> is not satisfied with five races of men. 8.1.151.3 In the realm of <s>Vaivasvata</s>, in King <s>Yama</s>, those people are distinguished — those who here seek by truth, and those who speak untruth. 8.1.151.4 Those, O king, are distinguished here, and then they come to you — those who worship the gods and who honor the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>. 8.1.151.5 In the fair-leaved tree where <s>Yama</s> drinks with the gods — there the lord of the clan, our father, the ancient one, attends. 8.1.151.6 <s>Yama</s> upheld the earth; <s>Yama</s>, heaven and the sun — <s>Yama</s> [is] all-death; those our <s>prāṇas</s> and winds... [Footnotes 875-880: Variant readings across RV, TA, KS, and VMP editions.]

children.text: 8.0.18 pathikŕ̥dbhyo vijānaté ínuvenati dvé ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.18 [Catch-words:] '...the path-makers; [one sage] knows; attends' — and two [additional mantras].

children.text:
8.1.152.1 námas súte nirr̥te víśvarūpe 'yas-máyaṃ ví cr̥tā bandhám etám
yaména tváṃ yamyā saṃvidānóttamán nā́kam ádhi rohayemám
8.1.152.2 yát te devī́ nír̥r̥tir ābabándha dā́ma grīvā́sv avicartyám
idáṃ te tád ví ṣyāmy ā́yuṣo ná mádhyād áthā jīváḥ pitúm addhi prámuktaḥ
8.1.152.3 yásyāste asyā́ḥ krūrá āsáñ juhómy eṣā́ṃ bandhā́nām avasárjanāya
bhū́mir íti tvā jánā vidúr nírr̥tir íti tvāháṃ pári veda viśvátaḥ
8.1.152.4 ásunvantam áyajamānam iccha stenásyetyā́ṃ táskarasyā́nveṣi
anyám asmád iccha sā́ ta ityā́ námo devi nirr̥te túbhyam astu
8.1.152.5 devī́m aháṃ nírr̥tiṃ vándamānaḥ pitéva putráṃ dasaye vácobhiḥ
víśvasya yā́ jā́yamānasya véda śíraś-śiraḥ práti sūrī́ vícaṣte
8.1.152.6 nivéśanas saṃgámano vásūnāṃ víśvā rūpā́bhícaṣṭe śácībhiḥ
durgā́narātīr ápānuda vīrá-patnī
8.1.152.7 yaména yamy ā́yuṣā sáṃvídānā́[*881] pitéva putrám abhírakṣatan naḥ
8.1.152.8 námas te nírr̥taye ghána-tejāya tásmaí vísr̥ja bándhanāt
8.1.152.9 yáma naya tvá(g)ṃ savitā́ devá uttamā́n ánīke abhírocaya yāyinā́m
8.1.152.10 vásavaḥ prathamó devátānā(g)ṃ so 'sya prajā́ṃ paśū́n pāhi
8.1.152.11 áto devébhyaḥ paśúbhir yó vaí vásavas svásty astu
8.1.152.12 sahasrākṣó vā́ ayám agníḥ pitaro devátānām
8.1.152.13 vásūn yátra vásavo bhūtā́nā́ṃ pā́layanti tásmā ánya-vasubhyaḥ
[*881] 1984 edition: sáṃvídhānā́; 1946 edition, : sáṃvídānā́
children.translated_text: 8.1.152.1 Homage to you, O <s>Nirṛti</s>, of universal form! This iron bond — untie it; O <s>Yama</s>, united with <s>Yamī</s>, raise this one to the highest firmament! 8.1.152.2 Whatever bond the goddess <s>Nirṛti</s> has bound on your neck, that cannot be undone — this I loosen for you from the midst of life; then, freed, live and eat your food! 8.1.152.3 She whose cruel [seat] is here — I offer for the releasing of these bonds. The people call you 'Earth'; I know you on all sides as <s>Nirṛti</s>. 8.1.152.4 Seek the non-presser, the non-sacrificer; pursue the pathway of the thief, the robber — seek another than us; that is your path, O <s>Nirṛti</s>; homage to you, O Goddess! 8.1.152.5 I, praising the goddess <s>Nirṛti</s>, court her with words as a father his son; she who knows the head of every being born — the patron gazes at each head. 8.1.152.6 The resting-place, the assembly of riches — he surveys all forms with his powers; the wife of the hero has driven away the evil enmities. 8.1.152.7 By <s>Yama</s>, <s>Yamī</s>, united in lifespan — may they protect us as a father his son. 8.1.152.8 Homage to you, O <s>Nirṛti</s>, of lightning splendor; release [this one] from that bond. 8.1.152.9 O <s>Yama</s>, lead; O <s>Savitṛ</s>, the god — illuminate the foremost ranks of those who march. 8.1.152.10 The <s>Vasus</s> are the first among the deities; may he protect our offspring and cattle. 8.1.152.11 Thence, to the gods; with cattle, whoever is of the <s>Vasus</s> — may there be well-being. 8.1.152.12 Thousand-eyed is this <s>Agni</s>, the ancestor of the deities. 8.1.152.13 Where the <s>Vasus</s> protect the beings of the <s>Vasus</s> — for that, for the other-<s>Vasus</s>. [Footnote 881: Variant readings across editions.]

children.text: 8.0.19 vícaṣṭe 'ṣṭaú ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.19 [Catch-words:] '...gazes; eight' — and [additional mantras].

children.text:
8.1.153.1 ástabhnād[*882] dyā́m r̥ṣabhó antárikṣam ámimīta varīmā́ṇaṃ pr̥thivyā́
ā́sīdad víśvā bhúvanāni saṃrā́ḍ víśvét tā́ni váruṇasya vratā́ni
8.1.153.2 yác cid dhí te víśo yathā prá deva varuṇa vratám
minīmási dyávi-dyavi
8.1.153.3 yát kíṃ cedáṃ varuṇa daívye jáne 'bhidroháṃ manuṣyāś cárāmasi
ácittī yát táva dhármā yuyopimá mā́ nas tásmād énaso deva rīriṣaḥ
8.1.153.4 kitavā́so yád riripúr ná dīví yád vā ghā satyám utá yán ná vidmá
sárvā tā́ ví ṣya śithiréva devā́thā[*883] te syāma varuṇa piyā́saḥ
8.1.153.5 áva te héḍo varuṇa námobhir áva yajñébhir īmahe havírbhiḥ
kṣáyann asmábhyam asura praceto[*884] rā́jann énā(g)ṃsi śiśrathaḥ kr̥tā́ni
[*882] Text: ástabhnā
[*883] RV: devā́dhā
[*884] RV: pracetā
children.translated_text: 8.1.153.1 The bull has propped up the sky, [measured] the atmosphere, the breadth of the earth; he sat upon all beings as sovereign — all these are the ordinances of <s>Varuṇa</s>. 8.1.153.2 Whatever ordinance of yours, O divine <s>Varuṇa</s>, we violate, day by day... 8.1.153.3 Whatever wrong we mortals commit against the divine order among the gods, O <s>Varuṇa</s> — when we unwittingly violate your law, do not harm us for that sin, O god. 8.1.153.4 [The sins] which gamblers commit, as if cheating at dice, whether indeed true or what we do not know — release all those like loosened [bonds], O God; then may we be dear to you, O <s>Varuṇa</s>. 8.1.153.5 We quell your anger, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, with homage, with sacrifices, with oblations; O wise <s>Asura</s>, O ruling king, loosen for us the sins committed. [Footnotes 882-884: Variant readings across editions.]

children.text:
8.1.154.1 úd uttamáṃ varuṇa pā́śam asmád ávādhamáṃ ví madhyamá(gg)ṃ śrathāya
áthā vayám āditya vraté távā́nāgaso áditaye syāma
8.1.154.2 imáṃ me varuṇa śrudhī hávam adyā́ ca mr̥ḍaya
tvā́m avasyúr ā́ cake
8.1.154.3 tát[*885] tvā yāmi bráhmaṇā vándamānas tád ā́ śāste yájamāno havírbhiḥ
áheḍamāno varuṇehá bodhy úruśa(g)ṃsa mā́ na ā́yuḥ prá moṣīḥ
8.1.154.4 tváṃ no agne váruṇasya vidvā́n devásya héḍó 'va yāsisīṣṭhāḥ
yájiṣṭho váhnitamaś śóśucāno víśvā dvéṣā́(g)ṃsi prá mumugdhy asmát
8.1.154.5 sá tváṃ no agne 'vamó bhavotī́ nédiṣṭho asyā́ uṣáso vyuṣṭau
áva yakṣva no váruṇa(g)ṃ rárāṇo vīhí[*886] mr̥ḍīká(g)ṃ suhávo na edhi
8.1.154.6 tvám agne ayā́sy ayā́ sán mánasā hitáḥ
ayā́ sán havyám ūhiṣe áyā́ no dhehi bheṣajám
8.1.154.7 yé te śatáṃ varuṇa yé sahásraṃ yajñíyāḥ pā́śā vítatāḥ purutrā́
tébhyo na índras savitótá víṣṇur víśvedevā́ muñcantu marútas svastyā́
[*885] Text: tá
[*886] Text: vīhá
children.translated_text: (8.1.154.1) Loosen from us the uppermost bond, O <s>Varuṇa</s>; loosen the lowest; release the middle one — then may we, O <s>Āditya</s>, in your ordinance, be sinless before <s>Aditi</s>. (8.1.154.2) Hear this call of mine, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, and be gracious today — I, seeking your help, call upon you. (8.1.154.3) This I approach you with prayer, praising — this the sacrificer implores with offerings; O <s>Varuṇa</s>, be not angered, be alert here — O you of wide fame, do not steal away our lifespan! (8.1.154.4) You, O <s>Agni</s>, knowing [the way], would turn aside the wrath of the god <s>Varuṇa</s> — most sacrificing, most carrying, blazing — free us from all hatreds! (8.1.154.5) You, O <s>Agni</s>, be nearest to us, closest, at the dawning of this dawn — worship <s>Varuṇa</s> on our behalf, being generous — proclaim mercy; be easy to invoke for us! (8.1.154.6) You, O <s>Agni</s>, unwavering, as the unwavering one, set in mind — unwavering, you carry the oblation — give us healing as the unwavering one! (8.1.154.7) Those bonds of yours, O <s>Varuṇa</s>, a hundred, a thousand, sacrificial, spread out widely — from those may <s>Indra</s>, <s>Savitṛ</s>, and <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the <s>Viśvedevas</s> and the <s>Maruts</s> release us with well-being!

children.text: 8.0.20 kr̥tā́ny edhi catvā́ri ca
children.translated_text: (8.0.20) [Catch-words:] '...be accomplished'; and four [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.155.1 pī́vonnā(g)ṃ[*887] rayi-vŕ̥dhas sumedhā́ś śvetás siṣakti niyútām abhiśrī́ḥ
té vāyáve sámanaso ví tasthur víśvén náras svapatyā́ni cakruḥ
8.1.155.2 rāyé ínú yáṃ jájñátū ródasī[*888] ubhé rāyé devī́ dhiṣáṇā dhāti devám
ádhā[*889] vāyúṃ niyútas saścata svā́ utá śvetáṃ vásudhitiṃ nireké[*890]
8.1.155.3 ā́ vāyo bhūṣa śucipā úpa nas sahásraṃ te niyúto viśva-vāra
úpo te ándho mádyam ayāmi yásya deva dadhiṣé pūrva-péyam
8.1.155.4 prá yā́bhir yā́si dāśvā́(g)ṃsam ácchā niyúdbhir vāyav iṣṭáye duroṇé
ní no rayí(g)ṃ subhójasaṃ yuvehá ni vīrávad[*891] gávyam áśviyaṃ ca rā́dhaḥ
8.1.155.5 prá vāyúm ácchā br̥hatī́ manīṣā́ br̥hád-rayiṃ viśvávārā(g)ṃ[*892] rathaprā́m
dutádyāmā niyútaḥ pátyamānaḥ kavíḥ kavím iyakṣasi prayajyo
[*887] RV: pī́voannāṃ
[*888] RV: ródasīme
[*889] RV: ádha
[*890] VMP follows TB
[*891] RV: yuvasva ní vīrám replaces yuvehá ni vīrávad
[*892] RV: viśvávāraṃ; TB: viśvávārāṃ
children.translated_text: (8.1.155.1) Fat, wealth-increasing, wise — the white one pursues the teams [of horses], the beauty of the <s>Niyuts</s> (steeds); they stood apart for <s>Vāyu</s>, of one mind — all the men performed their fair progeny-deeds. (8.1.155.2) For wealth indeed both heaven and earth begot him; for wealth the divine <s>Dhiṣaṇā</s> sustains the god — then the <s>Niyuts</s>, his own, follow <s>Vāyu</s>, and the white one, the wealth-holder, in solitude. (8.1.155.3) Come hither, O <s>Vāyu</s>, the pure-drinking one, to us — a thousand are your teams, O universally desired one; come to you is the pressed juice, the intoxicating [drink] — of which, O god, you hold the first draught. (8.1.155.4) With those teams by which you go to the worshiper, O <s>Vāyu</s>, with the <s>Niyuts</s>, to the offering in the dwelling — bestow upon us here wealth of good nourishment, and bounty rich in heroes, in cattle, and in horses! (8.1.155.5) A great hymn goes forth toward <s>Vāyu</s> — of great wealth, universally desired, chariot-filling; the <s>Niyuts</s> of swift course, being mastered — you, the seer, seek to reach the seer, O most worthy of worship!

children.text:
8.1.156.1 ā́ no niyúdbhiś śatínībhir adhvará(g)ṃ sahasríṇībhir úpa yāhi yajñám
vā́yo asmín havíṣi mādayasva yūyáṃ pāta svastíbhis sádā naḥ
8.1.156.2 vā́yo śatá(g)ṃ hárīṇāṃ yuvásva póṣyāṇām
utá vā te sahasríṇo rátha ā́ yātu pā́jasā
8.1.156.3 prá yā́ vā́jaṃ ná héṣantaṃ perúm ásyasy arjuni
r̥dūdáreṇa sákhyā saceya yó mā ná ríṣyed dharyaśva pītáḥ
8.1.156.4 prakramyātha[*893] ū́rdhvaṃ púruṣa-jo vivéśa prájāsu vr̥tyā́ya ásūn dadāti
so 'ham asmín yájāni sámāpātu
8.1.156.5 yo mātaríśvā víyaj jātó[*894] 'ṃśako vr̥to hūyáte
yásya satá(g)ṃ sametu
8.1.156.6 marútaḥ paramātmā́ páramā gatíḥ páraṃ bráhma páraṃ yógam
paramātmā́naṃ manye ajáraṃ yo 'gnir ahám ánnaṃ vāyáve
8.1.156.7 marúto gaṇā́nāṃ prathamás saptádhānāṃ mūrdhā́ vāyo ányam ajára(g)ṃ śriyam
hotāraṃ vaí ráyan tvā́hur ágne havyáṃ marúdbhyaḥ
[*893] Text: prakramyādha
[*894] 1984 edition: viyajñātó instead of víyaj jātó
children.translated_text: (8.1.156.1) Come to our sacrifice with the hundred-fold, the thousand-fold <s>Niyuts</s> (steeds), O <s>Vāyu</s>; rejoice in this oblation — may you all protect us always with blessings! (8.1.156.2) O <s>Vāyu</s>, yoke a hundred bay horses to be nourished — or let your chariot of a thousand [horses] come with speed! (8.1.156.3) You who dispatch the neigh-like prize, O silver-white one — may I follow with friendship your gentle-bellied [horses] — may he not harm me, O lord of bays, when drunk! (8.1.156.4) Having advanced, the man-born one entered upward — in creatures, for sustenance, he gives the breaths of life; may I sacrifice to him in that; may it be fully accomplished! (8.1.156.5) He who as <s>Mātariśvā</s> (the Wind), born, a sharer, is chosen and invoked — may a hundred [breaths] of his unite. (8.1.156.6) The <s>Maruts</s> — the <s>Paramātman</s> (Supreme Self), the supreme goal, the supreme <s>Brahman</s>, the supreme <s>Yoga</s> — I consider the <s>Paramātman</s> the ageless one; who is <s>Agni</s>, I am food for <s>Vāyu</s>. (8.1.156.7) The <s>Maruts</s>, foremost of hosts, heads of the seven streams — O <s>Vāyu</s>, [who is] another, ageless, [giver of] beauty — they call you the invoker, O <s>Agni</s>, carrying the oblation — the offering to the <s>Maruts</s>!

children.text: 8.0.21 práyájyó sametu catvā́ri ca
children.translated_text: (8.0.21) [Catch-words:] '...most worthy of worship...' '...may unite'; and four [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.157.1[*895] adbhyás tírodhā́jāyata táva vaiśravaṇás sadā
tírodhehi sapatnā́n no yé ápo áśnánti kecaná
8.1.157.2 tvāṣṭrī́ṃ māyā́ṃ vaiśravaṇó ráthá(g)ṃ sahasra-vándhuram
puruścakrá(g)ṃ sáhasrāśvam ā́sthāyā́yāhi no balím
8.1.157.3 yásmai bhūtā́ni balím ā́vahanti dhánaṃ gā́vo hásti híraṇyam áśvā́n
ásāma sumataú yajñíyasya śríyaṃ bíbhrató ínna-mukhīṃ virā́jam
8.1.157.4 sudarśané ca krauñcé ca maināgé ca mahā́-girau
satá dvāṭṭā́ra-gamantā́ sa(g)ṃhā́ryaṃ nágaraṃ táva
8.1.157.5 ítí mantrā́ḥ. kálpo 'ta ūrdhvám
8.1.157.6 yádi báli(g)ṃ háred dhiraṇya-nābháye vitudáye kauberā́yāyáṃ baliḥ
[*895] All of 8.1.157 is a continuous quote from TA 1.31.1-2 only.
children.translated_text: (8.1.157.1) From the waters he arose, the concealer — your [servant], O <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s> (son of <s>Viśravas</s>, i.e. <s>Kubera</s>), always — conceal our rivals; whoever may consume the waters. (8.1.157.2) The <s>māyā</s> (magical craft) fashioned by <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, [is] the chariot of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>, of a thousand axles, many-wheeled, of a thousand horses — mounting it, come to our offering! (8.1.157.3) He to whom beings bring offering — wealth, cattle, elephants, gold, horses — may we be in the good grace of the sacrificial one, bearing glory, with splendid face, the sovereign. (8.1.157.4) On <s>Sudarśana</s> and <s>Krauñca</s> and <s>Maināka</s>, the great mountains — with a hundred thousand gates — your city to be gathered. (8.1.157.5) Thus [end] the mantras. The ritual procedure (<s>kalpa</s>) [follows] hereafter. (8.1.157.6) If one would offer the <s>bali</s> to <s>Hiraṇyanābha</s> (Golden-Naveled), to <s>Vituda</s>, to <s>Kubera</s> — 'this is the offering.' [Editorial note: All of 8.1.157 is a continuous quote from Taittirīya Āraṇyaka 1.31.]

children.text:
8.1.158.1 sárvá-bhū́tā́dhípátáyé nama ity áthá bálí(g)ṃ hŕ̥tvópatiṣṭheta
kṣatráṃ kṣatráṃ vaiśravaṇó brā́hmáṇā vaya(gg)ṃ smáḥ
8.1.158.2 námas te astu mā́ mā hi(g)ṃsīr ásmā́t právíśyā́nnam addhītī́
áthá tám ágním ādadhītá yásmínn étát kármá prayuñjītá
8.1.158.3 tiródhā bhū́s tiródhā bhúvaḥ
tiródhās[*896] svas tiródhā bhū́r bhúvas svaḥ
8.1.158.4 sárvéṣā́ṃ lókā́nā́m ā́dhípátye sīdety áthá tám ágnim indhītá
yásmínn étát kármá prayuñjītá tiródhā bhū́s svā́hā
8.1.158.5 tiródhā bhúvas svā́hā tiródhā svas svāhā tiródhā bhū́r bhúvas svas svāhā yásmínn ásyá kā́lé sárvā́ ā́hútī́r hútā bhaveyúḥ
[*896] VMP: tiródhā, corrected to tiródhās, the version in TA.
children.translated_text: (8.1.158.1) 'Obeisance to the lord of all beings' — thus, having offered the <s>bali</s>, one should attend; 'sovereignty, sovereignty — <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s> [is lord]; we are the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>.' (8.1.158.2) 'Obeisance to you; do not harm me; from this, having entered, eat the food' — thus one should establish that fire on which this ritual is to be performed. (8.1.158.3) <s>Tirodhā</s> (the Concealer), <s>Bhūḥ</s>! <s>Tirodhā</s>, <s>Bhuvaḥ</s>! <s>Tirodhā</s>, <s>Svaḥ</s>! <s>Tirodhā</s>, <s>Bhūḥ Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ</s>! (8.1.158.4) 'May he sit in lordship over all the worlds' — thus one should kindle that fire on which this ritual is to be performed — '<s>Tirodhā</s>, <s>Bhūḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' (8.1.158.5) '<s>Tirodhā</s>, <s>Bhuvaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' '<s>Tirodhā</s>, <s>Svaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' '<s>Tirodhā</s>, <s>Bhūḥ Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — at the proper time of this [ritual], all the oblations should be offered.

children.text:
8.1.159.1 ápí brā́hmaṇa-mukhīnā́s tásmínn áhnáḥ kā́lé prayuñjītá
páras suptá-jánā́d vepí mā́ smá prámā́dyántam ādhyāpáyét[*897]
8.1.159.2 sárvā́rthās siddhyanté yá evaṃ vedá
kṣúdhyánn ídam ajānátā́ṃ sárvā́thā́ na siddhyanté[*898]
8.1.159.3 yás te vighā́tuko bhrātā́ mámā́ntár hr̥daye śrítáḥ
tásmā imám agra-píṇḍaṃ juhomi sá me 'rthān mā́ vívadhīn máyi svā́hā[*899]
8.1.159.4 rājādhirājā́ya prasahya-sāhíne námo vayáṃ vaiśravaṇā́ya kurmahe
sá me kā́mān kā́ma-kā́māya máhyaṃ kāmeśvaró vaiśravaṇó dadātu[*900]
8.1.159.5 kuberā́ya vaiśravaṇā́ya mahā-rājā́ya námaḥ[*901]
8.1.159.6 rāyás póṣāyā́yuṣā tvā nidhī́śo bhrā́tr̥vyāṇāṃ mahásāṃ cā́dhipatyai[*902]
8.1.159.7 miśrá-vāsasaḥ kauberakā́ rakṣo-rājéna préṣitāḥ
grā́ma(g)ṃ sá-jānayo gacchántīchánto paridā́kŕ̥tā́n
8.1.159.8 etā́n ghnataitā́n gr̥hṇītéty ayáṃ bráhmaṇas putráḥ
tā́n agníḥ páryasarat tā́n índras tā́n bŕ̥haspátiḥ
tā́n aháṃ veda brāhmaṇáḥ pramr̥śatáḥ kūṭa-dantā́n vikeśā́n lambana-stanā́n
[*897] TA 1.31.5 only (not in VC)
[*898] TA 1.31.5 only (not in VC)
[*899] TA 1.31.5-6 only (VC p. 771)
[*900] TA 1.31.6 only (VC p. 821)
[*901] TA 1.31.6 only (VC p. 328)
[*902] In VC pp. 824-825, there are two columns of rāyas poṣ... but no match to this verse.
children.translated_text: (8.1.159.1) With <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-faced [offerings], one should perform at the proper time of day; beyond the sleeping people, even trembling — one should not teach one who is heedless. (8.1.159.2) All purposes are accomplished for one who knows thus; [but for] the hungry one, the ignorant — all purposes are not accomplished. (8.1.159.3) 'He who is your destructive brother, dwelling within my heart — to him I offer this first food-ball; may he not obstruct my purposes in me, <s>svāhā</s>!' (8.1.159.4) 'To the king of kings, the mighty conqueror — we make obeisance to <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>; may <s>Kāmeśvara</s> (the Lord of Desires), <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>, grant me my desires, who desire desires.' (8.1.159.5) 'Obeisance to <s>Kubera</s>, <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>, the great king!' (8.1.159.6) 'For the increase of wealth, with lifespan [I establish] you, O lord of treasures — for sovereignty over kinsmen and great ones.' (8.1.159.7) 'The <s>Kauberakas</s> (servants of <s>Kubera</s>), clad in mixed garments, sent by the lord of <s>Rākṣasas</s> — they go to the villages with their kin, desiring those who are given over [to heedlessness].' (8.1.159.8) 'Strike these! Seize these!' — thus said this son of <s>Brahmā</s>. <s>Agni</s> encircled them, <s>Indra</s> [pursued] them, <s>Br̥haspati</s> [pursued] them — I, the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, know them as they approach: fang-toothed, disheveled, with pendulous breasts. [Editorial notes: verses from Taittirīya Āraṇyaka 1.31, with references to VC editions.]

children.text: 8.0.22 ayáṃ balir bhaveyúś cā́dhipatyai páñca ca
children.translated_text: (8.0.22) [Catch-words:] '...this offering...' '...should be...' '...sovereignty'; and five [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.160.1 stuhí śrutáṃ garta-sádaṃ yúvānaṃ mr̥gáṃ ná bhīmám upahatnúm ugrám
mr̥ḍā́ jaritré rudra stávāno anyáṃ te asmán ní vapantu sénāḥ
8.1.160.2 pári ṇo rudrásya hetír vr̥ṇaktu pári tveṣásya durmatír aghāyóḥ
áva sthirā́ maghávadbhyas tanuṣva mī́ḍhvas tokā́ya tánayāya mr̥ḍaya
8.1.160.3 mī́ḍhuṣṭama śívatama[*903] śivó nas sumánā bhava
paramé vr̥kṣá ā́yudhaṃ nidhā́ya kŕ̥ttiṃ vásāna ā́ cara pínākaṃ bíbhradā́ gahi
8.1.160.4 árhan bibharṣi sā́yakāni dhánvā́rhan niṣkáṃ yajatáṃ viśvá-rūpam árhann idáṃ dayase víśvam ábbhuvaṃ[*904] ná vā́ ójīyo rudra tvád asti
8.1.160.5 tvám agne rudró ásuro mahó divás tvá(g)ṃ śárdho mā́rutaṃ pr̥kṣá īśiṣe
tváṃ vā́tair aruṇaír yāsi śaṃgayás tváṃ pūṣā́[*905] vidhatáḥ pāsi nú tmánā
[*903] VMP: śívatamaś; TS: śívatama
[*904] RV: ábhvaṃ
[*905] Text: pūṃṣā́

8.1.161.1 ā́ vo rā́jānam adhvarásya rudrá(g)ṃ hótāra(g)ṃ sátya-yája(g)ṃ ródasyoḥ
agníṃ purā́ tanayitnór acíttād dhíraṇya-rūpam ávase kr̥ṇudhvam
8.1.161.2 námas te rudra manyáva utó ta íṣave námaḥ
námas te astu dhánvane bāhúbhyām utá te námaḥ
8.1.161.3 yā́ ta íṣuś śivátamā śiváṃ babhū́va te dhánuḥ
śivā́ śaravyā́ yā́ táva táyā no rudra mr̥ḍaya
8.1.161.4 rúdram anyáṃ bahutó hutaṃ vr̥ṣabháṃ námas te astu
tán me astu bāhúbhyāṃ vītáye
8.1.161.5 try-ambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhíṃ[*906] puṣṭi-várdhanam
urvārukám iva bándhanān mr̥tyór mukṣīya mā́mŕ̥tāt
8.1.161.6 ī́śānas sárva-lokānā́ṃ tryambakas sárva-vidyānā́m
ná dvitīyo bhavódbhavāya
8.1.161.7 ī́śa ī́śitre bhū́r bhúvas súvar ī́śāya lokā́nām
bhīmā́ya vāmadevā́ya námaḥ
[*906] RV: sugándhiṃ; TS: sugandhíṃ
children.translated_text:
Make for yourselves the king of the sacrifice, <s>Rudra</s>, the invoker, the true sacrificer of heaven and earth,
<s>Agni</s>, of golden form, for protection — before the unforeseen thunderbolt!
Homage to you, O <s>Rudra</s>, to your wrath, and homage to your arrow!
Homage to your bow, and homage to your two arms!
Your most auspicious arrow — auspicious has your bow become;
auspicious is your quiver — with that, O <s>Rudra</s>, be gracious to us!
To <s>Rudra</s>, the other, much-invoked, the bull — homage be to you!
May that be for my arms, for strength!
We worship the three-eyed one (<s>Tryambaka</s>), the fragrant one, the increaser of nourishment;
like a cucumber from its stem, may I be freed from death, not from immortality!
<s>Īśāna</s> (the Ruler) of all worlds, <s>Tryambaka</s> (the Three-eyed) of all knowledge,
there is no second — to him from whom <s>Bhava</s> (Existence) arises!
O <s>Īśa</s> (Lord), O Ruler! <s>Bhūr bhuvas suvar</s> — to <s>Īśa</s> of the worlds,
to the Terrible One (<s>Bhīma</s>), to <s>Vāmadeva</s>, homage!

children.text: 8.0.23 vídhatáḥ pāsi sú tmánāmŕ̥tāc catvā́ri ca
children.translated_text: You protect the worshipper by your own self, not from immortality — and [these are] four.

children.text:
8.1.162.1 kánikradaj janúṣam
svasti-dā́ viśás-pátiḥ
8.1.162.2 suparṇo 'si garútmān tri-vŕ̥tte śíro gāyatráṃ cákṣus stóma ātmā́ sā́ma te tanū́r vāmadevyáṃ br̥had-rathantaré pakṣaú yajñāyajñíyaṃ púcchaṃ chándā(g)ṃsy áṅgāni dhíṣṇiyāś śaphā́ yájū́(g)ṃṣi nā́ma
8.1.162.3 suparṇo 'si garútmān dívaṃ gaccha súvaḥ pata
8.1.162.4 havíṣmatīr imā́ ā́po havíṣmān devó adhvaró
havíṣmā(g)ṃ ā́ vivāsati havíṣmā(g)ṃ astu sū́ryaḥ
8.1.162.5 agnér vó 'panna-gr̥hasya sádasi sādayāmi sumnā́ya sumninīs sumné mā dhattendrāgniyór bhāgadhéyīs stha mitrā́-váruṇayor bhāgadhéyīs stha víśveṣāṃ devā́nāṃ bhāgadhéyīs stha yajñé jāgr̥ta
8.1.162.6 bhū́r asi bhū́ḥ prátiṣṭhityai
8.1.162.7 dhvajáṃ prátiṣṭhāpayāmí
8.1.162.8 jayā́ya námaḥ
atyucchritā́ya námaḥ
children.translated_text:
Neighing at birth —
the bestower of well-being, the lord of the people.
You are <s>Suparṇa</s> (the Beautiful-winged One), <s>Garutmat</s> (Garuḍa); the <s>Trivṛt</s> (threefold stoma) is your head, the <s>Gāyatra</s> (Gāyatrī meter) is your eye, the <s>Stoma</s> (hymn) is your body, the <s>Sāman</s> is your form, the <s>Vāmadevya</s> [sāman is your essence], the <s>Bṛhat</s> and <s>Rathantara</s> [sāmans] are your two wings, the <s>Yajñāyajñīya</s> [sāman] is your tail, the meters are your limbs, the <s>dhiṣṇyas</s> (fire-hearths) are your hooves, the <s>Yajus</s> formulas are your name.
You are <s>Suparṇa</s>, <s>Garutmat</s> — go to heaven, fly to the luminous realm!
These waters are rich in oblation, the divine sacrifice is rich in oblation;
the oblation-bearer invokes — may the Sun be rich in oblation!
In the seat of <s>Agni</s>, whose house is unfailing, I seat [the fires] — for your favor, O gracious ones, place me in your grace; you share in the portions of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you share in the portions of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, you share in the portions of all the <s>devas</s> — be wakeful in the sacrifice!
You are <s>bhūḥ</s> (earth), <s>bhūḥ</s> for firm establishment!
I establish the banner!
Homage to Victory (<s>Jayā</s>)!
Homage to the Most Exalted (<s>Atyucchrita</s>)!

children.translated_text: Homage to the Most Exalted; homage to <s>Īśāna</s>; homage to <s>Brahman</s> — and [this is] one.

To the one who snorts, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who snorts loudly, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the smell, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who has smelled, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the outward breath (<s>prāṇa</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the diffused breath (<s>vyāna</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

To the one who has lain down, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one about to sleep, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one sleeping, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who has slept, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one about to close the eyes, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one closing the eyes, <s>svāhā</s>!

To what he excretes, <s>svāhā</s>!
