8.2.4.8 veda-garbhā́ya svā́hā
8.2.4.9 víbhave svā́hā
8.2.4.10 víṣṇave svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the overseer of the gods, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one beyond conceptual distinctions, <s>svāhā</s>! To the stainless one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one devoted to <s>Brahman</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the lord of the earth, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one clad in yellow garments, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one dwelling in the cave [of the heart], <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose womb is the <s>Vedas</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the glorious one (<s>Vibhu</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.2.5.1 śrī́mate svā́hā
8.2.5.2 trailokya-bhū́ṣaṇāya svā́hā
8.2.5.3 yajñá-mū́rtaye svā́hā
8.2.5.4 améyā́tmane svā́hā
8.2.5.5 vará-dā́ya svā́hā
8.2.5.6 vāsavānújāya svā́hā
8.2.5.7 bhaktí-príyāya svā́hā
8.2.5.8 jagat-pūjyā́ya svā́hā
8.2.5.9 paramā́tmane svā́hā
8.2.5.10 asurāntakā́ya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the resplendent one (<s>Śrīmat</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the ornament of the three worlds, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose form is sacrifice (<s>Yajñamūrti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of immeasurable Self, <s>svāhā</s>! To the granter of boons, <s>svāhā</s>! To the younger brother of <s>Vāsava</s> (<s>Indra</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one fond of devotion, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one worshipped by the universe, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Supreme Self (<s>Paramātman</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the destroyer of demons, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.2.6.1 deva-devā́ya svā́hā
8.2.6.2 hr̥ṣīkeśā́ya svā́hā
8.2.6.3 śáṅkarāya svā́hā
8.2.6.4 garuḍa-dhvajā́ya svā́hā
8.2.6.5 nā́rásiṃhā́ya svā́hā
8.2.6.6 mahā́-devā́ya svā́hā
8.2.6.7 svayambhúve svā́hā
8.2.6.8 bhuvaneśvarā́ya svā́hā
8.2.6.9 śrī́dharāya svā́hā
8.2.6.10 devakī-putrā́ya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the god of gods, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s> (lord of the senses), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Śaṅkara</s> (the beneficent one), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose banner bears <s>Garuḍa</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Narasiṃha</s> (the man-lion), <s>svāhā</s>! To the great god (<s>Mahādeva</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the self-born one (<s>Svayambhū</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the lord of the worlds (<s>Bhuvaneśvara</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Śrīdhara</s> (bearer of Śrī), <s>svāhā</s>! To the son of <s>Devakī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.2.7.1 pā́rtha-sārathaye svā́hā
8.2.7.2 ácyutāya svā́hā
8.2.7.3 śáṅkha-pāṇaye svā́hā
8.2.7.4 parañ-jyótiṣe svā́hā
8.2.7.5 ātma-jyótiṣe svā́hā
8.2.7.6 acañcalā́ya svā́hā
8.2.7.7 śrī́vat(th)sāṅkā́ya svā́hā
8.2.7.8 akhilādhārā́ya svā́hā
8.2.7.9 sárva-loka-pataye svā́hā
8.2.7.10 prábhave svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the charioteer of <s>Pārtha</s> (<s>Arjuna</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Acyuta</s> (the unfallen one), <s>svāhā</s>! To the conch-handed one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the supreme light, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Self-luminous one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the unwavering one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one marked with <s>Śrīvatsa</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the support of all, <s>svāhā</s>! To the lord of all the worlds, <s>svāhā</s>! To the sovereign lord (<s>Prabhu</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.2.8.1 trivikramā́ya svā́hā
8.2.8.2 trikāla-jnā́ya svā́hā
8.2.8.3 tridhámne svā́hā
8.2.8.4 karuṇā-karā́ya svā́hā
8.2.8.5 sárva-jñāya svā́hā
8.2.8.6 sárvasmai svā́hā
8.2.8.7 sárva-sākṣiṇe svā́hā
8.2.8.8 aniruddhā́ya svā́hā
8.2.8.9 haya-grīvā́ya svā́hā
8.2.8.10 háraye svā́hā
children.translated_text: To <s>Trivikrama</s> (the one who took three strides), <s>svāhā</s>! To the knower of the three times, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of triple abode, <s>svāhā</s>! To the compassionate one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the omniscient one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the All, <s>svāhā</s>! To the witness of all, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Aniruddha</s> (the unobstructed one), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Hayagrīva</s> (the horse-necked one), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Hari</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.2.9.1 śārṅgíṇe svā́hā
8.2.9.2 harikeśā́ya svā́hā
8.2.9.3 halā́yudhāya svā́hā
8.2.9.4 sahasra-bāháve svā́hā
8.2.9.5 ávyaktāya svā́hā
8.2.9.6 sahasrākṣā́ya svā́hā
8.2.9.7 ákṣayāya svā́hā
8.2.9.8 ákṣarāya svā́hā
8.2.9.9 anantā́ya svā́hā
8.2.9.10 sarva-lokéśāya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one bearing the <s>Śārṅga</s> bow, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Harikeśa</s> (the golden-haired one), <s>svāhā</s>! To the wielder of the plough (<s>Halāyudha</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the thousand-armed one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the unmanifest one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the thousand-eyed one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the imperishable one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the immutable one (<s>Akṣara</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the infinite one (<s>Ananta</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the lord of all the worlds, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.2.10.1 kāmā́nándā́ya svā́hā
8.2.10.2 vikramā́ya svā́hā
8.2.10.3 māyā-dhārā́ya svā́hā
8.2.10.4 nirādhārā́ya svā́hā
8.2.10.5 sarvādhārā́ya svā́hā
8.2.10.6 dharā́-dharāya svā́hā
8.2.10.7 mahā́-víṣṇave svā́hā
8.2.10.8 sadā́-víṣṇave svā́hā
8.2.10.9 mā́dhavāya svā́hā
8.2.10.10 madhusūdanā́ya svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one who is the bliss of desire, <s>svāhā</s>! To the valiant one (<s>Vikrama</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the bearer of <s>māyā</s> (illusion), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one without support, <s>svāhā</s>! To the support of all, <s>svāhā</s>! To the bearer of the earth, <s>svāhā</s>! To the great <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the eternal <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Mādhava</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Madhusūdana</s> (slayer of the demon Madhu), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.2.11.1 niṣkalaṅkā́ya svā́hā
8.2.11.2 nirā́bhāsā́ya svā́hā
8.2.11.3 niṣprápañcāya svā́hā
8.2.11.4 nirañjanā́ya svā́hā
8.2.11.5 víśva-bhuje svā́hā
8.2.11.6 víśva-kartre svā́hā
8.2.11.7 puṇya-kīrtáye svā́hā
8.2.11.8 purā́tanā́ya svā́hā
8.2.11.9 áto devā́ idáṃ víṣṇuḥ
8.2.11.10 bhū́s svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the unblemished one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one without false appearance, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one beyond phenomenal expansion, <s>svāhā</s>! To the untainted one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the enjoyer of the universe, <s>svāhā</s>! To the maker of the universe, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of meritorious fame, <s>svāhā</s>! To the ancient one, <s>svāhā</s>! [Vedic incipits:] 'Therefore the gods...' 'This is <s>Viṣṇu</s>...' <s>Bhūḥ</s> (earth), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text: Śrī́-śátā́ṣṭákám
children.translated_text: The Hundred-and-Eight [Names] of <s>Śrī</s> (<s>Śrī-śatāṣṭakam</s>)

children.text:
8.3.1.1 padma-priyā́yai svā́hā
8.3.1.2 padmínyai svā́hā
8.3.1.3 padma-hastā́yai svā́hā
8.3.1.4 padmālayā́yai svā́hā
8.3.1.5 padma-pādā́yai svā́hā
8.3.1.6 padmā́kṣyai svā́hā
8.3.1.7 padma-vāsínyai svā́hā
8.3.1.8 padmá-patrā́kṣa-daivatāyai svā́hā
8.3.1.9 padmāṅkā́yai svā́hā
8.3.1.10 padma-dohínyai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one who loves lotuses (<s>Padmapriyā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the lotus-woman (<s>Padminī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>! To the lotus-handed one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose abode is the lotus, <s>svāhā</s>! To the lotus-footed one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the lotus-eyed one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one dwelling in the lotus, <s>svāhā</s>! To the goddess of the lotus-eyed lord, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one marked with the lotus, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who milks the lotus, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.2.1 śrī-dévyai svā́hā
8.3.2.2 jñāna-rūpā́yai svā́hā
8.3.2.3 sukha-dā́yai svā́hā
8.3.2.4 sutŕ̥ptikāyai svā́hā
8.3.2.5 púṣṭi-pradāyai svā́hā
8.3.2.6 mahā́-lákṣmyai svā́hā
8.3.2.7 lakṣmī́-pū́rvāyai svā́hā
8.3.2.8 abhivŕ̥ddhi-dāyai svā́hā
8.3.2.9 pramoda-sambhavā́yai svā́hā
8.3.2.10 lakṣmī́ṃ-bharāyai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the goddess <s>Śrī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose form is knowledge, <s>svāhā</s>! To the giver of happiness, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of perfect satisfaction, <s>svāhā</s>! To the bestower of nourishment, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Mahālakṣmī</s> (the great Lakṣmī), <s>svāhā</s>! To the one preceded by <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the giver of increase, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one born of delight, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who bears <s>Lakṣmī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.3.1 svātmáṃ-bharāyai svā́hā
8.3.3.2 vr̥ddhyaí svā́hā
8.3.3.3 samúdvahāyai svā́hā
8.3.3.4 vidā́yai svā́hā
8.3.3.5 suvā́ce svā́hā
8.3.3.6 icchā́-vídhā́yinyai svā́hā
8.3.3.7 puṇyāṃgā́yai svā́hā
8.3.3.8 puṇya-svarū́pā́yai svā́hā
8.3.3.9 udváhāyai svā́hā
8.3.3.10 satyákā́yai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one who sustains her own Self, <s>svāhā</s>! To prosperity, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who uplifts, <s>svāhā</s>! To wisdom, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of beautiful speech, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who ordains according to will, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of meritorious limbs, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose form is merit, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who elevates, <s>svāhā</s>! To the truthful one, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.4.1 puṇyātmá-hŕ̥dayāvāsāyai svā́hā
8.3.4.2 púṇyá-vákṣá-sthálā́láyāyai svā́hā
8.3.4.3 puṇyá-netrā́yai svā́hā
8.3.4.4 puṇyá-dā́tryai svā́hā
8.3.4.5 nityá-púṇyāyai svā́hā
8.3.4.6 supuṇyakā́yai svā́hā
8.3.4.7 paramodā́yai svā́hā
8.3.4.8 bhadrá-tā́rāyai svā́hā
8.3.4.9 sādhya-sárvā́rtha-sādhinyai svā́hā
8.3.4.10 kāntí-prádāyai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one who dwells in the heart of the meritorious Self, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one whose abode is on the meritorious chest, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one with meritorious eyes, <s>svāhā</s>! To the bestower of merit, <s>svāhā</s>! To the eternally meritorious one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the supremely meritorious one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of supreme delight, <s>svāhā</s>! To the auspicious star, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who accomplishes all goals of the righteous, <s>svāhā</s>! To the bestower of radiance, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.5.1 sarvanandā́yai svā́hā
8.3.5.2 viṣṇu-saṅkálpa-saṃbhavāyai svā́hā
8.3.5.3 śóbhanāṃgāyai svāhā
8.3.5.4 śruti-prāpyā́yai svā́hā
8.3.5.5 bhogā́yai svā́hā
8.3.5.6 bhóga-pratiṣṭhitāyai svā́hā
8.3.5.7 sarva-bhogā́yai svā́hā
8.3.5.8 dhāríṇyai svā́hā
8.3.5.9 bhóga-dāyai svā́hā
8.3.5.10 púṇyavatyai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the one who is the bliss of all, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one born of <s>Viṣṇu</s>'s will, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one of beautiful limbs, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one attainable through the <s>Vedas</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To enjoyment, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one established in enjoyment, <s>svāhā</s>! To all enjoyment, <s>svāhā</s>! To the sustaining one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the giver of enjoyment, <s>svāhā</s>! To the meritorious one, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.6.1 vasuṃ-dharā́yai svā́hā
8.3.6.2 vasu-káryai svā́hā
8.3.6.3 lóka-mātre svā́hā
8.3.6.4 prasā́dinyai svā́hā
8.3.6.5 saṃkalpa-tr̥ptyai svā́hā
8.3.6.6 sáṃtr̥ptyai svāhā
8.3.6.7 subrahmaṇyā́yai svā́hā
8.3.6.8 mahā́-nadyai svā́hā
8.3.6.9 saṃkḷpta-sā́dhinyai svā́hā
8.3.6.10 brahmáṇyai svā́hā
children.translated_text: To the bearer of wealth, <s>svāhā</s>! To the maker of wealth, <s>svāhā</s>! To the mother of the worlds, <s>svāhā</s>! To the gracious one, <s>svāhā</s>! To the satisfaction of resolve, <s>svāhā</s>! To complete satisfaction, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one devoted to <s>Brahman</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the great river, <s>svāhā</s>! To the one who fulfills intentions, <s>svāhā</s>! To the holy one, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.7.1 kálpa-sādhinyai svā́hā
8.3.7.2 sugandhínyai svā́hā
8.3.7.3 bhógavatyai svā́hā
8.3.7.4 rudrā́ṇyai svā́hā
8.3.7.5 dīpti-kāríṇyai svā́hā
8.3.7.6 tr̥ptyaí svā́hā
8.3.7.7 jayá-káryai svā́hā
8.3.7.8 dī́ptyai svā́hā
8.3.7.9 púṣṭyai svā́hā
8.3.7.10 parama-púṣṭi-dāyai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To the one who accomplishes the <s>kalpa</s> (ritual ordinance), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the fragrant one, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one rich in enjoyment (<s>Bhogavatī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Rudrāṇī</s> (consort of Rudra), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who causes radiance, <s>svāhā</s>!
To Satisfaction (<s>Tṛpti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who brings Victory, <s>svāhā</s>!
To Splendor (<s>Dīpti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To Nourishment (<s>Puṣṭi</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the giver of supreme nourishment, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.8.1 śā́ntyai svā́hā
8.3.8.2 vidyā́-dharyai svā́hā
8.3.8.3 vidyā-rūpā́yai svā́hā
8.3.8.4 íṣṭa-sādhinyai svā́hā
8.3.8.5 nityānapāyínyai svā́hā
8.3.8.6 ramyā́yai svā́hā
8.3.8.7 kalyāná-gúṇá[*934] gúmphitāyai[*935] svā́hā
8.3.8.8 bhū́ti-dā́yai svā́hā
8.3.8.9 śrī́-karyai svā́hā
8.3.8.10 dévyai svā́hā
[*934] Text: kalyāṇá-gúṇá
[*935] Text: gumbhitāyai
children.translated_text:
To Peace (<s>Śānti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the bearer of knowledge, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of knowledge-form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who accomplishes what is desired, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who is eternally unfailing, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the delightful one, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one strung with auspicious qualities, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the giver of prosperity (<s>Bhūti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who creates <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Goddess (<s>Devī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.9.1 vibhū́tyai svā́hā
8.3.9.2 háṃsa-vāhinyai svā́hā
8.3.9.3 prahlādínyai svā́hā
8.3.9.4 prakŕ̥tyai svā́hā
8.3.9.5 cid-rūpā́yai svā́hā
8.3.9.6 cítta-vāsinyai svā́hā
8.3.9.7 sarvāyuṣā́ṇā́m-ā́yur-me pāhi svā́hā
8.3.9.8 sárvaíśváryai svā́hā
8.3.9.9 sátyai svā́hā
8.3.9.10 sárvadāyínyai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To Splendor (<s>Vibhūti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one whose vehicle is the swan (<s>Haṃsa-vāhinī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who gives delight (<s>Prahlādinī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Prakṛti</s> (Primordial Nature), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of consciousness-form (<s>Cid-rūpā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who dwells in the mind, <s>svāhā</s>!
Protect my life-span among all life-spans, <s>svāhā</s>!
To all sovereignty, <s>svāhā</s>!
To Truth (<s>Satya</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who gives all (<s>Sarvadāyinī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.10.1 dhārā́ṅgyai[*936] svā́hā
8.3.10.2 prayojaná-karāyai svā́hā
8.3.10.3 pradhāna-kā́riṇyai svā́hā
8.3.10.4 samŕ̥ddhyai svā́hā
8.3.10.5 púṇya-vardhinyai svā́hā
8.3.10.6 śrī-vaíṣṇávyai svā́hā
8.3.10.7 jayā́yai svā́hā
8.3.10.8 toyā́yai svā́hā
8.3.10.9 santā́na-kā́ríṇyai svā́hā
8.3.10.10 víṣṇu-patnyai svā́hā
[*936] 1946 edition: údārā́ṅgyai; 1984 edition: dhārā́ṅgyai
children.translated_text:
To the one of streaming limbs, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who accomplishes the purpose, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who is the chief agent, <s>svāhā</s>!
To Prosperity (<s>Samṛddhi</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who increases merit, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Śrī Vaiṣṇavī</s> (the auspicious one of <s>Viṣṇu</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To Victory (<s>Jayā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To Water (<s>Toyā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who creates lineage, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the consort of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.3.11.1 mahā́-bhū́tyai svā́hā
8.3.11.2 vítta-dāyai svā́hā
8.3.11.3 vr̥ṣa-vāhínyai svā́hā
8.3.11.4 varāṅgánā́yai svā́hā
8.3.11.5 divyā́ṅgyai svā́hā
8.3.11.6 sarva-bhūtá-hítá-pradāyai svā́hā
8.3.11.7 svāhā́yai svā́hā
8.3.11.8 svadhā́yai svā́hā
8.3.11.9 śa(g)ṃ sā́niyacchát
8.3.11.10 bhūya ā́tma-vr̥tyā́
children.translated_text:
To Great Prosperity (<s>Mahā-bhūti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the giver of wealth, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one whose vehicle is the bull, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the most excellent woman, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of divine limbs, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who grants welfare to all beings, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Svāhā</s> (the Oblation-goddess), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Svadhā</s> (the Ancestral-offering goddess), <s>svāhā</s>!
She who constantly bestows auspiciousness —
Again, through self-sustaining activity —

children.text: Máhī́-śátā́ṣṭákám
children.translated_text: The <s>Mahī-śatāṣṭaka</s> (the hundred-and-eight [names] of the Earth Goddess).

children.text:
8.4.1.1 kamálā́yai svā́hā
8.4.1.2 kamálāvāsāyai svā́hā
8.4.1.3 kañja-netrā́yai svā́hā
8.4.1.4 mátyai svā́hā
8.4.1.5 dhŕ̥tyai svā́hā
8.4.1.6 viśokā́yai svā́hā
8.4.1.7 haríṇyai svā́hā
8.4.1.8 paúṣṇyai svā́hā
8.4.1.9 kṣóṇyai svā́hā
8.4.1.10 máhyai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To <s>Kamalā</s> (the Lotus-goddess), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who dwells in the lotus, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the lotus-eyed one, <s>svāhā</s>!
To Intelligence (<s>Mati</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To Steadfastness (<s>Dhṛti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Sorrowless One (<s>Viśokā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Golden One (<s>Hariṇī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Pauṣṇī</s> (she of <s>Pūṣan</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Earth (<s>Kṣoṇī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Great One (<s>Mahī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.2.1 atálā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.2 nitálā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.3 vitálā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.4 sutálā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.5 rasā́tálā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.6 mahātalā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.7 tala-rūpā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.8 talā́tálā́yai svā́hā
8.4.2.9 bhū́myai svā́hā
8.4.2.10 bhū-tala-rūpā́yai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To <s>Atala</s> (the netherworld), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Nitala</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Vitala</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Sutala</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Rasātala</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Mahātala</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of netherworld-form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Talātala</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Earth (<s>Bhūmi</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of earth-surface form, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.3.1 lóka-rūpāyai svā́hā
8.4.3.2 upasaṃhitā́yai svā́hā
8.4.3.3 prakŕ̥tyai svā́hā
8.4.3.4 vikŕ̥tyai svā́hā
8.4.3.5 viśva-rūpā́yai svā́hā
8.4.3.6 víśva-sādhinyai svā́hā
8.4.3.7 dharítryai svā́hā
8.4.3.8 mahátryai svā́hā
8.4.3.9 dhā́tryai svā́hā
8.4.3.10 nadī-rūpā́yai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To the one of world-form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who is gathered together, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Prakṛti</s> (Primordial Nature), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Vikṛti</s> (Modification), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of universal form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who accomplishes all, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Sustainer (<s>Dharitrī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Great One (<s>Mahatrī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Nurse (<s>Dhātrī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of river-form, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.4.1 sarásvatyai svā́hā
8.4.4.2 ātmám-bharā́yai svā́hā
8.4.4.3 vardhínyai svā́hā
8.4.4.4 kāśyápyai svā́hā
8.4.4.5 mahátyai svā́hā
8.4.4.6 sthirā́yai svā́hā
8.4.4.7 dharā-dhará-sámā́dhārāyai svā́hā
8.4.4.8 bhúve svā́hā
8.4.4.9 dharā-dhará-rū́píṇyai svā́hā
8.4.4.10 vasuṃ-dharā́yai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To <s>Sarasvatī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Self-sustaining One (<s>Ātmambharā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who increases (<s>Vardhinī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the daughter of <s>Kaśyapa</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Great One, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Firm One (<s>Sthirā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one whose support is the mountain-bearer, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Earth (<s>Bhu</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of mountain-bearer form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Treasure-bearer (<s>Vasuṃdharā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.5.1 vasú-karāyai svā́hā
8.4.5.2 vasúdhā́yai svā́hā
8.4.5.3 dhaná-várdhínyai svā́hā
8.4.5.4 phala-rūpā́yai svā́hā
8.4.5.5 manó-rūpiṇyai svā́hā
8.4.5.6 búddhi-rūpiṇyai svā́hā
8.4.5.7 citta-rūpíṇyai svā́hā
8.4.5.8 ahaṅkārá-rū́piṇyai svā́hā
8.4.5.9 bhūta-pañcáká-rū́pāyai svā́hā
8.4.5.10 pŕ̥thvyai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To the one who creates wealth, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Wealth-giver (<s>Vasudhā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who increases riches, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of fruit-form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of mind-form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of intellect-form (<s>Buddhi-rūpiṇī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of thought-form (<s>Citta-rūpiṇī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of ego-form (<s>Ahaṅkāra-rūpiṇī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of the five-element form (<s>Bhūta-pañcaka-rūpā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Earth (<s>Pṛthvī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.6.1 sāgara-rūpíṇyai svā́hā
8.4.6.2 ambhúdhi-vardhinyai svā́hā
8.4.6.3 sarvā́yai svā́hā
8.4.6.4 sárva-kāma-pradāyai svā́hā
8.4.6.5 pr̥thā́yai svā́hā
8.4.6.6 kāmā́yai svā́hā
8.4.6.7 manó-harāyai svā́hā
8.4.6.8 siddhā́yai svā́hā
8.4.6.9 sárva-maṃgala[*937]-kāriṇyai svā́hā
8.4.6.10 śyāmā́ṅgyai svā́hā
[*937] Text: -maṃgaḷa
children.translated_text:
To the one of ocean-form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who swells the waters, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the All (<s>Sarvā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the giver of all desires, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Pṛthā</s> (the Earth), <s>svāhā</s>!
To Desire (<s>Kāmā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the mind-captivating one, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Accomplished One (<s>Siddhā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who creates all auspiciousness, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the dark-limbed one, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.7.1 sánnibhāyai svā́hā
8.4.7.2 mahā-cātaka-vāhínyai svā́hā
8.4.7.3 utpálá-hástāyai svā́hā
8.4.7.4 puṇḍarīká-vílócánāyai svā́hā
8.4.7.5 puṇḍarīkā́kṣa-dayitāyai svā́hā
8.4.7.6 viśvam-bhárá-kúlā́yinyai svā́hā
8.4.7.7 haréḥ príyátamāyai svā́hā
8.4.7.8 vāsasthalā́yai svā́hā
8.4.7.9 atíkā́ntikāyai svā́hā
8.4.7.10 ādí-mū́rtyai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To the Resplendent One, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one whose vehicle is the great <s>cātaka</s> (rain-bird), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one with a blue lotus in hand, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the lotus-eyed one (<s>Puṇḍarīka-vilocanā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the beloved of the Lotus-eyed One (<s>Puṇḍarīkākṣa</s>, Viṣṇu), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who is the nest of the World-sustainer (<s>Viśvambhara</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the most beloved of <s>Hari</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the abode (<s>Vāsasthalā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the supremely beautiful one, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Primordial Form (<s>Ādi-mūrti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.8.1 priyā́yai svā́hā
8.4.8.2 nityā́yai svā́hā
8.4.8.3 nandínyai svā́hā
8.4.8.4 satyá-rū́piṇyai svā́hā
8.4.8.5 satyá-príyāyai svā́hā
8.4.8.6 hiraṇyākṣā́ntakāriṇyai svā́hā
8.4.8.7 jīvá-vrā́tá-sád-ā́dhā́rāyai svā́hā
8.4.8.8 mahā́-lákṣmī́-príyāyai svā́hā
8.4.8.9 vara-prasā́dínyai svā́hā
8.4.8.10 ramyā́yai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To the Beloved (<s>Priyā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Eternal (<s>Nityā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Joyful One (<s>Nandinī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of truth-form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who loves truth, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the destroyer of <s>Hiraṇyākṣa</s> (the Golden-eyed demon), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the true support of the host of living beings, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the beloved of <s>Mahā-Lakṣmī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who bestows excellent boons, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Delightful One, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.9.1 vipulā́yai svā́hā
8.4.9.2 vara-módinyai svā́hā
8.4.9.3 vará-rū́pāyai svā́hā
8.4.9.4 puṇyāṅgā́yai svā́hā
8.4.9.5 puṇyávatyai svā́hā
8.4.9.6 abdhí-mékhalāyai svā́hā
8.4.9.7 iṣṭa-pradā́yai svā́hā
8.4.9.8 yajñā́ṅgyai svā́hā
8.4.9.9 prakŕ̥tyai svā́hā
8.4.9.10 íṣṭa-sādhinyai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To the Vast One (<s>Vipulā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who gives excellent joy, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of excellent form, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of meritorious limbs, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Meritorious One (<s>Puṇyavatī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one girdled by the ocean, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the giver of the desired, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one whose limbs are the sacrifice, <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Prakṛti</s> (Primordial Nature), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who accomplishes what is desired, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.10.1 ātmám-bhárā́yai svā́hā
8.4.10.2 sarvá-sáhāyai svā́hā
8.4.10.3 nirnidrā́yai svā́hā
8.4.10.4 níṣkr̥tyai svā́hā
8.4.10.5 sthítyai svā́hā
8.4.10.6 svāhā́yai svā́hā
8.4.10.7 svadhā́yai svā́hā
8.4.10.8 yajña-yajñā́yai svā́hā
8.4.10.9 br̥hátyai svā́hā
8.4.10.10 óṅ-kā́ra-rūpiṇyai svā́hā
children.translated_text:
To the Self-sustaining One (<s>Ātmambharā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who endures all, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Sleepless One (<s>Nirnidrā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To Expiation (<s>Niṣkṛti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To Stability (<s>Sthiti</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Svāhā</s> (the Oblation-goddess), <s>svāhā</s>!
To <s>Svadhā</s> (the Ancestral-offering goddess), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Sacrifice of Sacrifices (<s>Yajña-yajñā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Vast One (<s>Bṛhatī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one of <s>Oṃkāra</s>-form, <s>svāhā</s>!

children.text:
8.4.11.1 svāhā-kārā́yai svā́hā
8.4.11.2 svadhā-kārā́yai svā́hā
8.4.11.3 veda-vidyā́yai svā́hā
8.4.11.4 surū́piṇyai svā́hā
8.4.11.5 mahā-dévyai svā́hā
8.4.11.6 mahā-mānyā́yai svā́hā
8.4.11.7 sárva-siddhyai svā́hā
8.4.11.8 dhanur[*938]-dharā́yai svā́hā
8.4.11.9 táyādityā́
8.4.11.10 tat trīṇy[*939] eṣā́
[*938] Text: thanur-
[*939] cf. VMP 6.33.5
children.translated_text:
To the one who is the <s>svāhā</s>-utterance, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the one who is the <s>svadhā</s>-utterance, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Knowledge of the <s>Vedas</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Beautiful-formed One, <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Great Goddess (<s>Mahā-devī</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Greatly Honored One, <s>svāhā</s>!
To All Perfection (<s>Sarva-siddhi</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
To the Bow-bearer (<s>Dhanur-dharā</s>), <s>svāhā</s>!
Through her the <s>Ādityas</s> —
Those three she [sustains] —

children.text:
8.1.191.1 nārāyaṇā́ya vidmáhe vāsudevā́ya dhīmahi
tán no vísṇuḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.191.2 mahā-devyaí ca vidmáhe viṣṇu-patnyaí ca dhīmahi
tán no lakṣmīḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.191.3 dhanur[*940]-dharā́yai vidmáhe sarva-siddhyaí ca dhīmahi
tán no dharā pracodáyāt[*941]
8.1.191.4 śrī-bhū-sakhyaí ca vidmáhe viṣṇu-patnyaí ca dhīmahi
tán no nīlāḥ[*942] pracodáyāt
8.1.191.5 lokādhyakṣā́ya vidmáhe dharādhyakṣā́ya dhīmahi
tán naḥ kūrmaḥ pracodáyāt
[*940] Text: thanur-
[*941] cf. VMP 6.10.6
[*942] Text: nīḷāḥ

8.1.192.1 bhū-varāhā́ya vidmáhe hiraṇya-garbhā́ya dhīmahi
tán naḥ kroḍaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.192.2 vajra-nákhāya vidmáhe tīkṣṇa-da(gg)ṃṣṭrā́ya dhīmahi
tán no nārasi(g)ṃhaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.192.3 vāg-īśvarā́ya vidmáhe hayagrīvā́ya dhīmahi
tán no ha(g)ṃsaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.192.4 vedāntāṃgā́ya vidmáhe hayagrīvā́ya dhīmáhí
tán no hayagrīvaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.192.5 haṃsa-haṃsā́ya vidmáhe parama-haṃṣā́ya dhīmáhí
tán no haṃsaḥ pracodáyāt

8.1.193.1 dāśarathā́ya[*943] vidmáhé sītā-vallabhā́ya dhīmahi
tán no rāmaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.193.2 dhanur-dharā́ya vidmáhe rāma-bhadrā́ya dhīmahi
tán no rāmaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.193.3 sudarśanā́ya vidmáhe heti-rājā́ya dhīmahi
tán naś cakraḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.193.4 jvālā-cakrā́ya vidmáhe mahā-cakrā́ya dhīmahi
tán naś cakraḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.193.5 dāmodarā́ya vidmáhe vāsudevā́ya dhīmahi
tán naḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ pracodáyāt
[*943] Text: dāśaradhā́ya
children.translated_text: 8.1.193.1 We know the son of <s>Daśaratha</s>; we meditate upon the beloved of <s>Sītā</s> — may <s>Rāma</s> inspire us! 8.1.193.2 We know the bow-bearer; we meditate upon auspicious <s>Rāma</s> — may <s>Rāma</s> inspire us! 8.1.193.3 We know the beautiful-to-behold one; we meditate upon the king of weapons — may the <s>Cakra</s> (discus) inspire us! 8.1.193.4 We know the flame-discus; we meditate upon the great discus — may the <s>Cakra</s> inspire us! 8.1.193.5 We know <s>Dāmodara</s>; we meditate upon <s>Vāsudeva</s> — may <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> inspire us! [Footnote 943: Text reads dāśaradhāya.]

children.text:
8.1.194.1 tát-púruṣāya vidmáhe suparṇa-pakṣā́ya dhīmahi
tán no garuḍaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.194.2 viṣvaksenā́ya vidmáhe vetra-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán naś śāntaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.194.3 vedātmanā́ya vidmáhe hiraṇya-garbhā́ya dhīmahi
tán no brahma pracodáyāt
8.1.194.4 tát-púruṣāya vidmáhe mahā-devā́ya dhīmahi
tán no rudraḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.194.5 tát-púruṣāya vidmáhe vakra-tuṇḍā́ya dhīmahi
táṃ no dantiḥ[*944] pracodáyāt
[*944] MahānU (US): dantī; TA, MahānU (SV): dantiḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.194.1 We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate upon the fair-winged one — may <s>Garuḍa</s> inspire us! 8.1.194.2 We know <s>Viṣvaksena</s>; we meditate upon the cane-handed one — may the Peaceful One inspire us! 8.1.194.3 We know the <s>Veda</s>-souled one; we meditate upon <s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> (the Golden Embryo) — may <s>Brahman</s> inspire us! 8.1.194.4 We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate upon <s>Mahādeva</s> — may <s>Rudra</s> inspire us! 8.1.194.5 We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate upon the curved-trunked one — may the Tusked One (<s>Danti</s>, i.e. <s>Gaṇeśa</s>) inspire us! [Footnote 944: Variant readings in MahānU and TA.]

children.text:
8.1.195.1 tát-púrúṣā́ya vidmáhe mahā-senā́ya dhīmahi
tán naṣ ṣaṇ-mukhaḥ[*945] pracodáyāt
8.1.195.2 bhāskarā́ya vidmáhe mahad-dyuti-karā́ya[*946] dhīmahi
tán no ādityaḥ[*947] pracodáyāt
8.1.195.3 vaiśvānarā́ya vidmáhe lālīlā́ya[*948] dhīmahe
táṃ no agniḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.195.4 kātyāyanā́ya[*949] vidmáhe kanya-kumā́ri[*950] dhīmahi
tán no durgiḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.195.5 táth savitúr váreṇyaṃ bhárgo devásya dhīmahi
dhíyo yó naḥ pracodáyāt
[*945] MahānU (US): ṣaṣṭaḥ (SV): ṣaṇ-mukhaḥ
[*946] VMP: maha-dyuti-karā́ya; MahānU (SV): mahad-dyuti-karā́ya; (US): divākarāya
[*947] MahānU (US): sūryaḥ
[*948] MahānU (US): lālelāya
[*949] MahānU (US): kātyāyanyai; (SV): kātyāyānāya
[*950] MahānU (US): kanyā-kumāryai
children.translated_text: 8.1.195.1 We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate upon the great general (<s>Mahāsena</s>) — may the Six-faced One (<s>Ṣaṇmukha</s>, i.e. <s>Skanda</s>) inspire us! 8.1.195.2 We know the Sun-maker (<s>Bhāskara</s>); we meditate upon the maker of great radiance — may <s>Āditya</s> inspire us! 8.1.195.3 We know <s>Vaiśvānara</s>; we meditate upon <s>Lālīla</s> — may <s>Agni</s> inspire us! 8.1.195.4 We know <s>Kātyāyanī</s>; we meditate upon the virgin maiden (<s>Kanyā-kumārī</s>) — may <s>Durgā</s> inspire us! 8.1.195.5 We meditate upon that excellent splendor of the divine <s>Savitṛ</s> — may he inspire our thoughts! [Footnotes 945-950: Variant readings in MahānU, VMP, and US editions.]

children.text:
8.1.196.1 śabda-rāśā́ya vidmáhe vāyu-putrā́ya dhīmahi
táṃ no hanumat pracodáyāt
8.1.196.2 tát-púruṣāya vidmáhe cakra-tuṇḍā́ya dhīmahi
táṃ no nandiḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.196.3 vārdhi-jā́tā́ya vidmáhe mahā-śaṅkhā́ya dhīmahi
tán naś śaṅkhaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.196.4 ojo-balā́ya vidmáhe atyucchrayā́ya dhīmahi
táṃ no dhvajaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.196.5 mahā-bhūtā́ya vidmáhe viṣṇu-bhaktā́ya dhīmahi
tán naś śrī-bhūtaḥ pracodáyāt
children.translated_text: 8.1.196.1 We know the lord of sound-masses; we meditate upon the son of <s>Vāyu</s> — may <s>Hanumat</s> inspire us! 8.1.196.2 We know that <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate upon the discus-trunked one — may <s>Nandi</s> inspire us! 8.1.196.3 We know the ocean-born one; we meditate upon the great conch — may the <s>Śaṅkha</s> (Conch) inspire us! 8.1.196.4 We know the one of vigor and strength; we meditate upon the most exalted one — may the <s>Dhvaja</s> (Banner) inspire us! 8.1.196.5 We know the great being; we meditate upon the devotee of <s>Viṣṇu</s> — may <s>Śrī-bhūta</s> (the Auspicious Being) inspire us!

children.text:
8.1.197.1 deva-rājā́ya vidmáhe vajra-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán naś śakraḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.2 ruda-netrā́ya vidmáhe śakti-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán no vahniḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.3 vaivasvatā́ya vidmáhe daṇḍa-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán no yamaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.4 niśā-carā́ya vidmáhe khaḍga-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán no nirr̥tiḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.5 sudhīśvarā́ya vidmáhe pāśa-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán no varuṇaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.6 jagat-prāṇā́ya vidmáhe yaṣṭi-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán no vāyuḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.7 rāja-rājā́ya vidmáhe dhanādhyakṣyā́ya dhīmahi
tán nas somaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.8 ruda-sakhā́ya vidmáhe vaiśravaṇā́ya dhīmahi
tán naḥ kuberaḥ pracodáyāt
8.1.197.9 yakṣeśvarā́ya vidmáhe gadā-hastā́ya dhīmahi
tán no yakṣaḥ pracodáyāt[*951]
[*951] mahā́-devā́ya vidmáhe śūla-hastā́ya dhīmahi tán naś śivaḥ pracodáyāt
children.translated_text: 8.1.197.1 We know the king of the gods; we meditate upon the thunderbolt-handed one — may <s>Śakra</s> (<s>Indra</s>) inspire us! 8.1.197.2 We know the weeping-eyed one; we meditate upon the spear-handed one — may <s>Vahni</s> (<s>Agni</s>) inspire us! 8.1.197.3 We know the son of <s>Vivasvat</s>; we meditate upon the staff-handed one — may <s>Yama</s> inspire us! 8.1.197.4 We know the night-wanderer; we meditate upon the sword-handed one — may <s>Nirṛti</s> inspire us! 8.1.197.5 We know the lord of good wisdom; we meditate upon the noose-handed one — may <s>Varuṇa</s> inspire us! 8.1.197.6 We know the life-breath of the world; we meditate upon the rod-handed one — may <s>Vāyu</s> inspire us! 8.1.197.7 We know the king of kings; we meditate upon the superintendent of wealth — may <s>Soma</s> inspire us! 8.1.197.8 We know the friend of <s>Rudra</s>; we meditate upon the son of <s>Viśravas</s> — may <s>Kubera</s> inspire us! 8.1.197.9 We know the lord of <s>Yakṣas</s>; we meditate upon the mace-handed one — may the <s>Yakṣa</s> inspire us! [Footnote 951: Additional verse — 'We know <s>Mahādeva</s>; we meditate upon the trident-handed one — may <s>Śiva</s> inspire us!']

children.text: 8.0.32 prácodáyāt tán no ha(g)ṃsaḥ pracodáyāt kŕ̥ṣṇáḥ prácodáyād dántíḥ prácodáyād dhíyo yó naḥ prácodáyāc chrī́-bhū́táḥ prácodáyāt tán no varuṇaḥ prácodáyād aṣṭaú ca
children.translated_text: 8.0.32 [Catch-words:] '...may inspire us; may the Swan inspire us; may <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> inspire us; may the Tusked One inspire us; may he inspire our thoughts; may <s>Śrī-bhūta</s> inspire us; may <s>Varuṇa</s> inspire us' — and eight [additional mantras].

children.text:
8.1.198.1 námo bráhmaṇe námo ástv agnáye námaḥ pr̥thivyaí náma óṣadhībhyaḥ
námo vācé námo vācás-pátaye námo víṣṇave br̥haté karomi
8.1.198.2 óṃ śā́ntiś śā́ntiś śā́ntiḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.198.1 Homage to <s>Brahman</s>! Homage to <s>Agni</s>! Homage to the Earth! Homage to the herbs! Homage to Speech! Homage to the Lord of Speech! Homage to <s>Viṣṇu</s> — the great one, I perform! 8.1.198.2 <s>Oṃ</s>, peace, peace, peace!

children.text: 8.0.33 námo bráhmaṇe trī́ṇi
children.translated_text: 8.0.33 [Catch-words:] 'Homage to <s>Brahman</s>' — and three [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.199.1 tác chaṃ yór[*952] ā́ vr̥ṇīmahe gātúṃ yajñā́ya gātúṃ yajñá-pataye daívī svastír astu naḥ svastír mā́nuṣebhyaḥ
ūrdhváṃ jigātu bheṣajám, śáṃ no astu dvi-páde śaṃ catus-pade, óṃ śā́ntiś śā́ntiś śā́ntiḥ
[*952] RVKh: chaṃyyor
children.translated_text: 8.1.199.1 That bliss and joy we choose — a path for the sacrifice, a path for the lord of sacrifice; may divine well-being be ours, well-being for humans! May the remedy rise upward; may there be bliss for the two-footed and bliss for the four-footed. <s>Oṃ</s>, peace, peace, peace!

children.text: 8.0.34 tác chaṃyór ā́ vŕ̥ṇī́máhe náva
children.translated_text: 8.0.34 [Catch-words:] 'That bliss and joy we choose' — and nine [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.200.1 námo vācé yā́ coditā́ yā́ cā́nūditā tásyai vācé námo námo vācé námo vācás-pátaye náma ŕ̥ṣibhyo mantra-kŕ̥dbhyo mántra-patibhyo mā́ mā́m ŕ̥ṣayo mantra-kŕ̥to mantra-pátayaḥ párādur mā́hám ŕ̥ṣīn mantra-kŕ̥to mantra-patīs párādāṃ vaiśvadevī́ṃ vā́cam udyāsa(g)ṃ śivā́m ádastāṃ júṣṭāṃ devébhyaś śárma me dyaúś śárma pr̥thivī́ śárma víśvam idáṃ jágat
śárma candráś ca sū́ryaś ca śárma brahma-prajā-patī́
8.1.200.2 bhūtáṃ vadiṣye bhúvanaṃ vadiṣye téjo vadiṣye yáśo vadiśye tápo vadiṣye bráhma vadiṣye satyáṃ vadiṣye tásmā ahám idám upastáraṇam úpastr̥ṇa upastáraṇaṃ me prajā́yai paśūnā́ṃ bhūyād upastáraṇam aháṃ prajā́yai paśūnā́ṃ bhūyāsaṃ prā́ṇāpānau mr̥tyór mā pātaṃ prā́ṇāpānau mā́ mā hāsiṣṭaṃ mádhu maniṣye mádhu janiṣye mádhu vakṣyāmi mádhu vadiṣyāmi mádhumatīṃ devébhyo vā́cam udyāsa(g)ṃ śúśrūṣéṇyāṃ manuṣyebhyas táṃ mā devā́ avantu śobhā́yai pitáró ínu madantu óṃ śā́ntiś śā́ntiś śā́ntiḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.200.1 Homage to Speech, both that which is uttered and that which is unuttered — homage to that Speech! Homage to Speech! Homage to the Lord of Speech! Homage to the <s>Ṛṣis</s>, the makers of <s>mantras</s>, the lords of <s>mantras</s>! May the <s>Ṛṣis</s>, the <s>mantra</s>-makers, the <s>mantra</s>-lords, not abandon me; may I not abandon the <s>Ṛṣis</s>, the <s>mantra</s>-makers, the <s>mantra</s>-lords! May I utter the universal speech (<s>vaiśvadevī vāk</s>), auspicious, without biting, pleasing to the gods! May heaven be my shelter, may earth be my shelter, may this entire universe be my shelter; may the moon and the sun be my shelter, may <s>Brahman</s> and <s>Prajāpati</s> be my shelter! 8.1.200.2 I shall speak what has been; I shall speak of the world; I shall speak of splendor; I shall speak of fame; I shall speak of austerity; I shall speak of <s>Brahman</s>; I shall speak the truth. Therefore I spread this as a foundation — may this foundation be for my offspring and cattle; may I become a foundation for offspring and cattle! May <s>Prāṇa</s> (inbreath) and <s>Apāna</s> (outbreath) protect me from death! May <s>Prāṇa</s> and <s>Apāna</s> not forsake me! I shall think sweetness; I shall produce sweetness; I shall carry sweetness; I shall speak sweetness! May I utter sweet speech to the gods, speech that humans will wish to hear! May the gods favor me for that glory; may the ancestors delight in me! <s>Oṃ</s>, peace, peace, peace!

children.text: 8.0.35 námo vācé catvā́ri
children.translated_text: 8.0.35 [Catch-words:] 'Homage to Speech' — and four [mantras].

children.text:
8.1.201.1 śáṃ no mitráś śáṃ váruṇaḥ śáṃ no bhavatv aryamā́
śáṃ na índro bŕ̥haspátiḥ śáṃ no víṣṇur urukramáḥ
8.1.201.2 námo brahmaṇe
8.1.201.3 námas te vāyo
8.1.201.4 tvám evá pratyákṣaṃ bráhmāsi
8.1.201.5 tvā́m evá pratyákṣaṃ bráhma vadiṣyāmi
8.1.201.6 r̥táṃ vadiṣyāmi
8.1.201.7 satyáṃ vadiṣyāmi
8.1.201.8 tán mām avatu
8.1.201.9 tád vaktā́ram avatu
8.1.201.10 ávatu mā́m
8.1.201.11 ávatu vaktā́ram
8.1.201.12 óṃ śā́ntiś śántiś śā́ntiḥ
children.translated_text: 8.1.201.1 May <s>Mitra</s> be gracious to us, may <s>Varuṇa</s> be gracious, may <s>Aryaman</s> be gracious to us; may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Bṛhaspati</s> be gracious to us; may <s>Viṣṇu</s> of wide strides be gracious to us! 8.1.201.2 Homage to <s>Brahman</s>! 8.1.201.3 Homage to you, O <s>Vāyu</s>! 8.1.201.4 You indeed are the directly perceived <s>Brahman</s>. 8.1.201.5 You indeed I shall call the directly perceived <s>Brahman</s>. 8.1.201.6 I shall speak cosmic order (<s>Ṛta</s>). 8.1.201.7 I shall speak truth (<s>Satya</s>). 8.1.201.8 May that protect me. 8.1.201.9 May that protect the speaker. 8.1.201.10 May it protect me. 8.1.201.11 May it protect the speaker. 8.1.201.12 <s>Oṃ</s>, peace, peace, peace!

children.text:
8.0.36 satyáṃ vadiṣyāmi páñca ca
8.1.202.1 śáṃ no vā́taḥ pavatāṃ mātaríśvā[*953] śáṃ nas tapatu sū́ryaḥ
8.1.202.2 áhāni śáṃ bhavantu naś śá(g)ṃ rā́triḥ práti dhīyatām
8.1.202.3 śám uṣā́ no vyucchatu śám ādityá údetu naḥ
8.1.202.4 śivā́ naś śántamā bhava sumr̥ḍīkā́ sárasvatī
mā́ te vyoma saṃdŕ̥śi
8.1.202.5 íḍāyai vā́stv asi vā́stumád vāstumánto bhūyāsma mā́ vā́stoś cith sma hy avāstús sá bhuyād yo 'smān dveṣṭi yáñ ca vayáṃ dviṣmáḥ
8.1.202.6 pratiṣṭhā́si pratiṣṭhā́vanto bhūyāsma mā́ pratiṣṭhā́yāś cith sma hy apratiṣṭhás sá bhūyād yo 'smān dveṣṭi yáñ ca vayáṃ dviṣmáḥ
8.1.202.7 ā́ vāta vāhi bheṣajáṃ ví vāta vāhi yád rápaḥ
tvá(g)ṃ hí viśvá-bheṣajo devā́nāṃ dūtá ī́yase
8.1.202.8 dvā́v imaú vā́tau vāta ā́ síndhor ā́ parāvátaḥ
dákṣaṃ me[*954] anyá ā vā́tu párānyó vātu yád rápaḥ[*955]
[*953] VS omits
[*954] RV: te
[*955] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 203. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 202.
children.translated_text: 8.0.36 [Catch-words:] 'I shall speak truth' — and five [mantras]. 8.1.202.1 May <s>Vāta</s> (<s>Mātariśvan</s>) blow auspiciously for us; may the sun shine auspiciously for us! 8.1.202.2 May the days be auspicious for us; may the night be established auspiciously! 8.1.202.3 May the dawn shine auspiciously for us; may the sun rise auspiciously for us! 8.1.202.4 Be auspicious to us, O <s>Sarasvatī</s>, most gracious, most beneficent — may we not behold your [wrathful] expanse! 8.1.202.5 You are the dwelling-place of <s>Iḍā</s> — may we who have dwellings be blessed with dwellings! May he be without dwelling who hates us and whom we hate. 8.1.202.6 You are a firm foundation — may we who have foundations be blessed with foundations! May he be without foundation who hates us and whom we hate. 8.1.202.7 O <s>Vāta</s>, blow forth the remedy; O <s>Vāta</s>, blow away whatever harm! For you are the universal remedy; you travel as the messenger of the gods. 8.1.202.8 These two winds blow — from the [river] <s>Sindhu</s>, from afar; may the one blow vigor to me, may the other blow away whatever harm! [Footnotes 953-955: Variant readings from VS, RV; VMP verse division differs.]

children.text:
8.1.203.1 yád adó vāta te gr̥he 'mr̥tasya nidhír hitáḥ
táto no dehi jīváse táto no dhehi bheṣajám
8.1.203.2 táto no máha ā́vaha vā́ta ā́ vātu bheṣajám
śaṃbhū́r mayobhū́r nó hr̥dé prá ṇa ā́yū(g)ṃṣi tāriṣat
8.1.203.3 índrasya gr̥ho 'si táṃ tvā prápadye ságus sā́śvaḥ
sahá yán me ásti téna
8.1.203.4 bhū́ḥ prápadye bhuvaḥ prápadye súvaḥ prápadye bhū́r bhúvas súvaḥ prápadye vāyúṃ prápadyé ínārtāṃ devátāṃ prápadyé 'śmānam ākhaṇáṃ prápadye prajā́-pater brahma-kośáṃ bráhma prápadya óṃ prápadye
8.1.203.5 antárikṣaṃ ma urv antaraṃ br̥hád agnáyaḥ párvatāś ca yáyā vā́tas svastyā́ svastimā́n táyā svastyā́ svastimā́n asāni
8.1.203.6 prā́ṇāpānau mr̥tyór mā pātaṃ prā́ṇāpānau mā́ mā hāsiṣṭaṃ
8.1.203.7 máyi medhā́ṃ máyi[*956] prajā́ṃ máyy agnís téjo dadhātu máyi medhā́ṃ máyi prajā́ṃ máyī́ndra indriyáṃ dadhātu máyi medhā́ṃ máyi prajā́ṃ máyi sū́ryo bhrā́jo dadhātu
[*956] TS omits
children.translated_text: (8.1.203.1) O <s>Vāta</s> (Wind), in your house a treasure of immortality is placed — from that, give us life; from that, give us healing! (8.1.203.2) From that, bring us great [wealth], O <s>Vāta</s>; may healing blow upon us — O beneficent one, source of happiness, to our heart — may he extend our lifespans! (8.1.203.3) You are the house of <s>Indra</s> — I take refuge in you; with cattle, with horses, together with whatever is mine. (8.1.203.4) I take refuge in <s>Bhūḥ</s> (Earth); I take refuge in <s>Bhuvaḥ</s> (Atmosphere); I take refuge in <s>Suvaḥ</s> (Heaven); I take refuge in <s>Bhūḥ Bhuvaḥ Suvaḥ</s>; I take refuge in <s>Vāyu</s>; I take refuge in the deity of the afflicted; I take refuge in the splitting stone; I take refuge in the <s>Brahma</s>-treasure of <s>Prajāpati</s>; I take refuge in <s>Brahman</s>; <s>Oṃ</s>, I take refuge! (8.1.203.5) May the atmosphere be spacious for me, wide and great — the fires and the mountains — by that well-being by which the wind is well, by that well-being may I be well! (8.1.203.6) O <s>Prāṇa</s> and <s>Apāna</s> (in-breath and out-breath), protect me from death! O <s>Prāṇa</s> and <s>Apāna</s>, do not abandon me! (8.1.203.7) May <s>Agni</s> place in me wisdom, in me progeny, in me splendor; may <s>Indra</s> place in me wisdom, in me progeny, in me vitality; may <s>Sūrya</s> place in me wisdom, in me progeny, in me radiance!

children.text:
8.1.204.1 dyubhír aktúbhiḥ pári pātam asmā́n áriṣṭebhir aśvinā saúbhagebhiḥ
tán no mitró váruṇo māmahantām áditis síndhuḥ pr̥thivī́ utá dyaúḥ
8.1.204.2 káyā naś citrá ā́ bhuvad ūtī́ sadā́vr̥dhas sákhā
káyā śáciṣṭhayāvr̥tā́
8.1.204.3 kás tvā satyó mádānāṃ má(g)ṃhiṣṭho mathsad[*957] ándhasaḥ
dr̥ḍhā́ cid ārúje vásu
8.1.204.4 abhī́ ṣú ṇas sákhīnām avitā́ jaritr̥̄ṇā́m
śatáṃ bhavāsy ūtíbhiḥ
8.1.204.5 váyas suparṇā́ úpa sedur índraṃ priyá-medhā ŕ̥ṣayo nā́dhamānāḥ
ápa dhvāntám ūrṇuhí pūrdhí cákṣur mumugdhy asmān nidháyeva baddhā́n
[*957] RV: matsad
children.translated_text: (8.1.204.1) With days and nights, protect us, O <s>Aśvins</s>, with unharmed and auspicious [offerings] — may <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, the River, the Earth, and the Sky grant us that! (8.1.204.2) How shall the wondrous one, the ever-growing friend, come to us with aid? How with the most powerful [help]? (8.1.204.3) Who among those truly intoxicated shall most generously be stirred by the pressed juice? He breaks open even firm [citadels] for wealth. (8.1.204.4) May he, the helper of our friends, the [protector] of singers, be with a hundred aids! (8.1.204.5) Like birds, the fair-winged ones settled upon <s>Indra</s> — the beloved-minded <s>Ṛṣis</s>, in their need; dispel the darkness, fill the eye — release us like those bound in confinement!

children.text:
8.1.205.1 śáṃ no devī́r abhíṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītáye
  śáṃ yór abhí sravantu naḥ
8.1.205.2 ī́śānā vā́ryāṇāṃ kṣáyantīś carṣaṇīnā́m
  apó yācāmi bheṣajám
8.1.205.3 sumitrā́ na ā́pa óṣadhayas santu durmitrā́s tásmai bhūyāsur yo 'smān dveṣṭi yáṃ ca vayáṃ dviṣmáḥ
8.1.205.4 ā́po hí ṣṭhā́ mayo-bhúvas tā́ na ūrjé dadhātana
mahé ráṇāya cákṣase
8.1.205.5 yó vaś śivátamo rásas tásya bhājayatehá naḥ
uśatī́r iva mātáraḥ
8.1.205.6 tásmā áraṃ gamāma vo yásya kṣáyāya jínvatha
ā́po janáyathā ca naḥ[*958]
[*958] VMP divides this verse making the second line the first line of chapter 206. The numbering is adjusted so that the complete verse comes at the end of chapter 205.
children.translated_text: (8.1.205.1) May the divine waters be for our well-being, for drinking — may welfare and happiness flow upon us! (8.1.205.2) O [waters], sovereign over desirable things, ruling over peoples — I ask from the waters healing! (8.1.205.3) May the waters and herbs be friendly to us; may they be hostile to him who hates us and whom we hate! (8.1.205.4) For you, O waters, are the source of happiness — grant us nourishment, and great delight to behold! (8.1.205.5) That most auspicious essence of yours — make us partakers of it here, like loving mothers! (8.1.205.6) We would readily approach you, for whose dwelling you give life — O waters, bring us forth! [Editorial note: VMP divides this verse at the chapter break.]

children.text:
8.1.206.1 pr̥thivī́ śāntā́ sāgnínā śāntā́ sā́ me śāntā́ śúca(g)ṃ śamayatu
antárikṣa(g)ṃ śāntáṃ tád vāyúnā śāntáṃ tán me śāntá(g)ṃ śúca(g)ṃ śámayatu
8.1.206.2 dyaúś śāntā́ sā́dityéna śāntā́ sā́ me śāntā́ śúca(g)ṃ śamayatu
8.1.206.3 pr̥thivī́ śā́ntir antárikṣa(g)ṃ śā́ntir dyaúś śā́ntir
8.1.206.4 díśaś śā́ntir avāntara-diśā́ś śā́ntir agníś śā́ntir vāyúś śā́ntir ādityáś śā́ntiś candrámāś śā́ntir nákṣatrāṇi śā́ntir
8.1.206.5 ā́paś śā́ntir óṣadhayaś śā́ntir vánas-pátayaś śā́ntir
8.1.206.6 gaúś śā́ntir ajā́ śāntir áśvaś śā́ntiḥ púruṣaś śā́ntir bráhmā śā́ntir brāhmanáś śā́ntiś śā́ntir evá śā́ntiś śā́ntir me astu śā́ntiḥ
8.1.206.7 táyāhá(g)ṃ śāntyā́ sarva-śāntyā́ máhyaṃ dvi-páde cátuṣ-pade ca śā́ntiṃ karomi śā́ntir me astu śā́ntiḥ
8.1.206.8 éha śrī́ś ca hrī́ś ca dhŕ̥tiś ca tápo medhā́ pratiṣṭhā́ śraddhā́ satyáṃ dhármaś caitā́ni móttiṣṭhantam ánū́ttiṣṭhantu mā́ mā(g)ṃ śrī́ś ca hrī́ś ca dhŕ̥tiś ca tápo medhā́ pratiṣṭhā́ śraddhā́ satyáṃ dhármaś caitā́ni mā mā́ hāsiṣuḥ
8.1.206.9 údā́yuṣā svāyúṣód óṣadhīnā(g)ṃ rásenótparjányasya śúṣmeṇódasthām amŕ̥tā(g)ṃ ánu
8.1.206.10 tác cákṣur devá-hitaṃ purástāc[*959] chukrám uccárat
páśyema śarádaś śatáṃ jī́vema śarádaś śatáṃ nándāma śarádaś śatáṃ módāma śarádaś śatáṃ bhávāma śarádaś śatá(g)ṃ śr̥ṇávāma śarádaś śatáṃ prábravāma śarádaś śatám ájītās syāma śarádaś śatáṃ jyók ca sū́ryaṃ dr̥śé
8.1.206.11 yá údagān maható 'rṇávād vibhrā́jamānas sarirásya mádhyāth sá mā vr̥ṣabhó lohitākṣás sū́ryo vipaścín mánasā punātu
8.1.206.12 bráhmaṇaś ścótany[*960] asi bráhmaṇa āṇī́ stho bráhmaṇa āvápanam asi dhāritéyáṃ pr̥thivī́ bráhmaṇā mahī́ dhāritám enena mahád antárikṣaṃ dívaṃ dādhāra pr̥thivī́(g)ṃ sá-devāṃ yád aháṃ véda tád aháṃ dhārayāṇi mā́ mád védó 'dhi vísrasat
8.1.206.13 medhā-manīṣé mā́viśatā(g)ṃ samī́cī bhūtásya bhávyasyā́varuddhyai sárvam ā́yur ayāṇi sárvam ā́yur ayāṇi
8.1.206.14 ābhír gīrbhír yád áto na ūnám ā́pyāyaya harivo várdhamānaḥ
yadā́ stotŕ̥bhyo máhi gotrā́ rujā́si bhūyiṣṭha-bhā́jo ádha te syāma
8.1.206.15 bráhma prā́vādiṣma tán no mā́ hāsīt
óṃ śā́ntiś śā́ntiś śā́ntiḥ
[*959] RV omits
[*960] VMP: bráhmaṇa ścótany
children.translated_text: (8.1.206.1) The earth is at peace — it is at peace through <s>Agni</s> — may that peace quench my sorrow; the atmosphere is at peace — it is at peace through <s>Vāyu</s> — may that peace quench my sorrow. (8.1.206.2) The sky is at peace — it is at peace through <s>Āditya</s> — may that peace quench my sorrow. (8.1.206.3) The earth is peace; the atmosphere is peace; the sky is peace. (8.1.206.4) The directions are peace; the intermediate directions are peace; <s>Agni</s> is peace; <s>Vāyu</s> is peace; <s>Āditya</s> is peace; the Moon is peace; the stars are peace. (8.1.206.5) The waters are peace; the herbs are peace; the trees are peace. (8.1.206.6) The cow is peace; the goat is peace; the horse is peace; man is peace; <s>Brahman</s> is peace; the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> is peace — peace alone is peace — may there be peace for me, peace! (8.1.206.7) By that peace, by the peace of all, I make peace for myself, for the two-footed and the four-footed — may there be peace for me, peace! (8.1.206.8) Here may <s>Śrī</s> (glory), <s>Hrī</s> (modesty), <s>Dhṛti</s> (steadfastness), austerity, wisdom, firm establishment, faith, truth, and <s>dharma</s> — may these not depart when I arise; may they arise with me; may <s>Śrī</s>, <s>Hrī</s>, <s>Dhṛti</s>, austerity, wisdom, firm establishment, faith, truth, and <s>dharma</s> — may these not abandon me! (8.1.206.9) We have risen with lifespan, with our own lifespan, with the sap of herbs, with the vigor of <s>Parjanya</s> (the rain-god) — we have risen following the immortal. (8.1.206.10) That eye, placed by the gods in the east, the bright one rising — may we see a hundred autumns; may we live a hundred autumns; may we rejoice a hundred autumns; may we delight a hundred autumns; may we flourish a hundred autumns; may we hear a hundred autumns; may we speak a hundred autumns; may we be unconquered a hundred autumns — and long may we see the sun! (8.1.206.11) He who rose from the great ocean, shining forth from the midst of the waters — may that bull, the red-eyed <s>Sūrya</s>, the wise one, purify me with [his] mind! (8.1.206.12) You are the drop of <s>Brahman</s>; you are the axle of <s>Brahman</s>; you are the sowing-ground of <s>Brahman</s>. This great earth is upheld by <s>Brahman</s>; by it the great atmosphere is upheld; heaven upholds the earth with its gods — what I know, may I uphold; may knowledge not slip away from me! (8.1.206.13) O wisdom and discernment, enter me together, for the attainment of what is and what shall be — may I complete my entire lifespan, may I complete my entire lifespan! (8.1.206.14) With these hymns, whatever is deficient in us, fill up, O bay-horse lord, ever growing — when you break open the great enclosure for the praisers, may we be among those of greatest share! (8.1.206.15) We have proclaimed <s>Brahman</s> — may it not abandon us! <s>Oṃ</s>, peace, peace, peace!
